Description:
Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities for process improvement, recommend enhancements to business processes and system functionalities

Skills and attributes for success
In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
Ability to work virtually with global teams

To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience preferably in Talent

Position: ADF, Databricks, PySpark Engineer

Support data warehousing and analytics initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation and maintain deployment artifacts.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.

Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

Description:
EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline Clients & Industries
Role Type C&I Business Operations Coordinator
Business unit specific description Clients & Industries GDS Europe West
Join our GDS Clients & Industries and you will help support the important business enablement functions that keep our organization running strong. As an Operations professional, you will work across teams both onshore and offshore to provide the knowledge, resources and tools that help EY deliver exceptional quality service to our clients, win in the marketplace and support EY's growth and profitability.
With so many offerings, you can develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That's how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
The practice also works closely with the Region/Service Line/BD team with the project management / coordination activities. The role requires a comparable work experience, strong skills, work ethic and attention to detail for as the team has a high focus on accuracy and timeliness.
Responsibilities
Maintain pipeline hygiene and ensure the accuracy of sales and revenue data.
Support account management activities and stakeholder engagement.
Prepare business reports, forecasts, and performance updates.
Collaborate with teams to resolve data issues and improve reporting quality.
Provide insights to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and client discussions.
Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and digital tools.
Skills and attributes for success
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, preparation of newsletters, managing surveys etc.
Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

Job Title
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
Job Summary
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.

We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.
Role Details
Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE
Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate
Responsibilities
The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.
Meetings Management - Working closely with the project teams and other stakeholders in scheduling/organizing the meeting or conference call
Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets
Workshop or Area visit Plan - Help in planning the agenda, for workshops/area visits by handling the logistics of stay, food and printing, etc.
Documentation - Recording the minutes of the meeting with clear emphasis on the key action points from the meeting. Maintaining the project database and ensure all documentations are captured and organized for ease of access.

Enjoys problem solving

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
SAP CPI Consultant JD
About the Role
We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.
Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,
Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc
Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI,CLOUD PLATFORM,INTEGRATION SUITE,IFLOWS,GROOVY SCRIPT,ODATA,ODATA

Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

Description:
Role Overview
The role involves developing and maintaining relationships with leading architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients, including HNI and UHNI customers.

This is a relationship-driven business development role, rather than a conventional field sales position. The selected candidates will represent a premium brand, identify high-value projects, develop market connections, coordinate client visits, and nurture business opportunities through to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Identify and develop business opportunities in luxury residential projects, villas, hospitality, and premium commercial interiors.
Conduct regular market visits to architect studios, design firms, project sites, and client locations.
Promote MCI's premium collections of natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, and surface solutions.
Generate leads through networking, market mapping, referrals, industry contacts, and architect/designer databases.
Understand project requirements and coordinate with architects and designers to recommend suitable products.
Arrange and coordinate visits to MCI's Experience Centre for architects, designers, and prospective clients, wherever applicable.
Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospects and project stakeholders to convert opportunities into business.
Track enquiries, quotations, samples, project requirements, and lead conversion status.
Develop and maintain an updated database of architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium customers.
Support the development of the assigned market and achievement of business targets.
Maintain disciplined daily and weekly activity reports, lead updates, and follow-up records.
Represent MCI professionally at client meetings, exhibitions, industry events, and design-related networking activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, upcoming projects, and emerging business opportunities.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
Natural stone, marble, granite, and imported stone
Premium tiles, sanitaryware, and surface materials
Luxury furniture, modular kitchens, and premium interiors
Architectural products, high-end lighting, and home automation
Luxury real estate, project sales, and premium construction materials
Other premium product segments involving regular interaction with architects, interior designers, builders, and developers

Experience in natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, or premium surface materials will be an added advantage.
Freshers are also welcome if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, professionalism, a willingness to learn, and an interest in architecture and luxury interiors.

Required Skills & Qualities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Confident, energetic, well-groomed, and professionally presentable.
Strong relationship-building, networking, and negotiation skills.
Genuine interest in luxury interiors, architecture, and premium products.
Ability to engage effectively with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and reporting discipline.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and travel within the assigned market.
Knowledge of the local market and established industry contacts will be an advantage.
Fluency in English and the relevant local language is essential. Hindi proficiency will be an added advantage.

Salary Range:
- Freshers: 20,000 30,000 per month
- Experienced candidates: 25,000 40,000 per month
Final compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, communication skills, market exposure, relevant industry knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

Interested Candidates
Candidates who are passionate about premium products, relationship management, and business development in the luxury architecture and interior-design segment are encouraged to apply.

Description:
As a Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical and operational oversight of assigned vessels, ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-efficient ship management. The role plays a critical part in connecting ship and shore by acting as the primary technical point of contact for vessels, clients, and external stakeholders, while supporting BSM s strategic objectives, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of fleet performance.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver contractual ship management services in line with customer agreements, ensuring vessels meet required technical and operational standards
Act as the primary technical contact for Masters and Chief Engineers, providing guidance on safety, maintenance, drydock planning, critical equipment, and non-routine repairs
Maintain close communication with clients on technical, operational, and budgetary matters, building effective working relationships
Monitor vessel machinery, equipment performance, and maintenance execution to enhance safety, reliability, energy efficiency, and operational performance
Develop, implement, and monitor maintenance, repair, and drydocking plans, ensuring timely execution within approved budgets
Prepare, control, and report technical and OPEX budgets for assigned vessels
Ensure vessels maintain valid certification and comply with all applicable maritime legislation
Plan, conduct, and follow up on vessel visits, inspections, audits, and surveys
Coach, mentor, and support shipboard personnel, including performance reviews, interviews, and contribution to career development
Qualifications Experience
Bachelor s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, or a valid Chief Engineer s Certificate
Minimum of three years sailing experience as a senior officer, or three years shore-based experience as a technical superintendent within a ship management or owning company
Sailing or management experience with VLGC vessels is essential
Skills Competencies
Leadership and people management skills with a coaching and mentoring mindset
High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability
Team-oriented, proactive, and safety-focused approach
Fluency in English and solid computer literacy
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training.
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
Diverse workforce.
Technology-driven company.
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family

Work Experience: 9 to 13 years

Certifications related to Data Privacy such as CIPP, CIPT, CIPM etc.
Functional and non-functional privacy requirements definition and documentation experience
Worked on tools like Onetrust, Trustarc, Servicenow

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations
- Assists the Director of Engineering in administering fire prevention programs and emergency preparedness.

JOB DESCRIPTION
AVIT Meeting Room
Operations L3 Lead
Role Overview
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities
Operational Leadership
Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.
Advanced Incident and Problem Management
Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.
Service Reliability and Monitoring
Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.
Device Lifecycle Operations
Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.
Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management
Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.
Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.
Technology and Service Environment
Area Indicative Environment
Meeting-room platforms : Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
Operations tooling : ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
Technical domains : Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
Service practices: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
Candidate Profile
Required Experience and Knowledge
Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

Description:
Job Summary
Discipline: BMC-Technology Enablement
Role Type: UX UAT tester
The opportunity
We are looking for passionate professionals who will be responsible for user acceptance testing of various Marketing technology products used within BMC.
Responsibilities
Support the UX UAT lead and contribute to the overall validation of usability and user experience deliverables.
Execute UAT activities with emphasis on design consistency, accessibility, and responsiveness, ensuring products meet both functional and UX standards.
Test end-to-end user journeys across all major desktops, tablets, and mobile browsers, validating layout, navigation, and interaction patterns.
Log defects and issues related to usability, accessibility, design or branding fidelity, escalating them to the UAT lead for resolution tracking.
Contribute to the development, enforcement, and adherence of UX testing standards and procedures.
Assist in creating and executing UX-focused test scripts and scenarios, covering different interaction flows and breakpoints.
Coordinate defect tracking, resolution, and retesting with attention to UX impact and user journey continuity.
Support the preparation of UAT UX deliverables (e.g., usability observations, step-by-step guides).
Skills and attributes for success
Working knowledge of Enterprise CMS (AEM - Adobe Manager Suit, Wordpress or other related CMS) Troubleshoot issues and support development of solutions by analysing test results and presenting findings.
Experience of end-to-end marketing technology platforms i.e. email marketing, web publishing, social media management, video hosting, automation processes, mobile operating systems.
Should be comfortable in a global and virtual teaming environment, should be excellent in both written and verbal communication with stakeholders across geography. (Clients are from UK)
To qualify for the role, you must have
2+ years of UX UAT experience
Working experience of AEM (Preferred but not essential)
Able to demonstrate experience in UX validation, QA and/or UAT processes, methodologies and tools.
Experience in writing and executing test cases and scripts
Ability to interpret wireframes, design specifications, and functional requirements to validate design fidelity.
Familiarity with mobile operating systems, browsers, and responsive design testing.
Fluency with MS Office Tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
Background in digital design or exposure to design workflows, with a good design eye to spot inconsistencies in layout, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
Enthusiasm to learn new things in a fast-moving environment.
Proven ability to manage time effectively, prioritize work to meet aggressive deadlines, and deliver high quality output through attention to detail.
Comfortable in a global and virtual cross-teaming environment
Strong verbal communication
Ideally, youll also have
Ability to think strategically/end-to-end with result-oriented mindset
Ability to build rapport within the firm and win the trust of the clients
Technologies and Tools
Content management system (AEM, Wordpress etc)
Marketing automation platforms (Marketo, Sprinklr, Hubspot etc) - Optional
MS Office tools (Word, Excel, IE); web/production technologies such as HTML, XML, JavaScript, and CSS
What we look for
A professional who has technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Self-motivated individual who strives to learn new technology and help improve the existing standard testing process
Professional who is willing to work with cross functional team to work with Product managers and EY IT team

People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human across multiple media platforms.
As a Supervising Associate Art Director, you own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on-brand, user-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post-production
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
Stay up-to-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Lead project discussions with customers with a customer-centric mindset
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Mentor junior team members on best design practices
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
Proven track record of delivering high-quality output on time and within budget
An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Understanding of current and future visual trends

Bachelors degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline) *

Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media

Self-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
Experience working with global clients

DE NCLC Senior Technology Consulting
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant with strong capabilities in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex. The resource will be part of the Enterprise Content Management and Modern Workplace team, delivering solutions to clients across regions.
The opportunity
We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.
Your key responsibilities
Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current-state environments and modernization objectives.
Design and deliver SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions using SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP and PowerShell.
Plan and execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams workloads, with appropriate assessment, remediation, testing and cutover activities.
Assess and modernize Nintex workflows and forms, including Nintex for SharePoint and Nintex Automation Cloud.
Prepare technical designs, migration plans, mapping documents, test scripts, deployment guides and operational handover documentation.
Troubleshoot migration, workflow, solution and integration issues, escalating risks and dependencies when required.
Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, security requirements, governance processes and technical design principles.
Support estimates, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical discussions with stakeholders.
Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Skills and attributes
5-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
Strong hands-on experience with SPFx, TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.
Experience in Microsoft 365 migrations covering SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, including discovery, assessment, remediation, migration execution, validation and cutover.
Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.
Good to have Skills
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
Soft Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
Self-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
Good presentation and client-facing skills
Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams
Collaborative team player with a positive and constructive approach
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
A minimum of 5 years of relevant Microsoft 365, SharePoint, migration or modernization experience.
Demonstrable hands-on expertise in SPFx and Microsoft 365 migration delivery.
Practical experience with Nintex workflows and forms.
Strong consulting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.
Ideally, you'll also have
Experience in a professional services or consulting organization.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and translate complex requirements into manageable deliverables.
Ability to operate independently with minimum supervision and support junior team members.

Job Summary I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer The opportunity
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly.
The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions.

Description:
Job Title: Report Advisor Financials Product Line
Function: Finance
Sub-function: Reporting & Data Analytics FP&A
Duration: Permanent
Job Summary
The Report Advisor reports to the product lines senior report advisor and focuses primarily on the end-user and key influential stakeholder groups who either use or have an interest in the solutions. Together with the Product Line lead the Report Advisors represents the face of one reporting product line within the Reporting and Data Analytics sub-function (R&DA). A reporting product line represents a set of reporting and analysis tools and reports that are designed for a certain R&DA customer group to manage and operate their own responsibility within EY. The Financials product line is focused on business management roles as well as their appropriate Finance teams managing certain organizational entities from a Profit & Loss Statement as well as from employee & utilization perspective. Essentials for Financials, Profit & Loss statements as well as People Flash reporting are the primary reporting tools within this product line. The main responsibility is to increase the usage and adoption of the tools, understand changing business needs and feed them into continuous improvement process of the solution, supporting improvements and spreading a positive message while interacting with the different stakeholders.
The Reporting and Data Analytics sub-function is a leading-edge organization providing powerful analytical solutions to evolve our ability to provide insights to the business. The R&DA ensures that EY is keeping pace with the many analytical and technological changes taking place in the business world, evolving our tools and the way we consume information, to best support the client serving as well as corporate responsibilities in a rapidly changing business world.
Your key responsibilities
Work hand-in-hand with the senior report advisor as well as functional and technical support teams
Support shaping the vision of the product offering in collaboration with product line lead and senior report advisor based on the overall Finance and R&DA strategy
Focus on adoption and awareness of the solutions to increase usage
Establish, maintain and leverage a reliable network with actual target audience as well as various stakeholder groups to gain insights on what the business needs and what is changing
Identify potential enhancements or new critical topics based on interactions with the networks
Act as a change agent and a spokesperson for the entire offering within the product line and focus on the intended user of the tool and be visible and approachable
Share insights on current state of solutions, how they are being used and take an active role in the discussions on future enhancements
Partner with more technically oriented Business Analysts within the product line team to drive towards user friendly, business focused and consistent solutions, designs and visualizations
Actively support global training activities, support regional efforts and manage customer communities
Prepare product line communications about upcoming updates, enhancements or issues, in alignment with R&DAs overarching communication strategy
Partner and regularly discuss with other product lines to ensure consistency, leverage new developments, ideas or change in technology but also share best practices regarding communication, networks and training
Prepare and actively collaborate in meetings with other functions, local teams or within the R&DA to solve open topics, propose innovate solutions and link the product line team into other initiatives, campaigns or projects
Skills and attributes for success
Have conversations based on business processes and questions and with EYs strategy in mind
Communicates clearly, assertive and focused on mutually beneficial outcomes
Good presenter and trainer act as an influencer or sales person
Overarching knowledge around the product line offering, EYs business concepts and rules as well as the strategic objectives
Establishes and maintains good relationships within the R&DA, Finance, other functions and Operational Leads as well as stakeholder groups
Very structured mindset
Overview of EYs end-to-end processes and customers need to go through and that are critical in reporting (e.g. financial accounting rules and month-end close activities, controlling, headcount management/utilization, planning) as well EYs key management structures
Ability to navigate challenging and complex environments with support of the senior report advisor
Transform the message from what the solutions shows to how to use the information, how to generate insights and what actions should be taken next
Fluent English skills
Having the ability to have business conversation in a secondary language, primarily Spanish or Japanese, would be beneficial but not mandatory
What we look for
Ability to influence and inspire change
Global and inclusive mindset
Personality with confidence and credibility
Innovative mindset being open to new ideas and promoting team members to think outside the box
Good knowledge of business processes and end-user needs and their ways of managing their responsibilities
Challenging customers insightfully to improve process, approach or results
Proposing options and making recommendations based on stakeholder feedback
Driving change efforts and adoption through building and maintaining relationships with end-users, stakeholders and leadership
Resolving competing priorities respectful and effectively
Ability to work both autonomously to achieve project goals, as well as in a team environment with limited direction and supervision
Using appropriate resources to increase team strengths and decrease costs while meeting deadlines
Appreciation and respect of varying cultures both corporate and geographical
Experience
To qualify for the role you must have
5 plus years of experience in a finance or markets/business development department or change management programs
Relevant business experience
Good network within EY would be beneficial but isnt mandatory
