Description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Seeking an experienced professional in learning design and development to join our team as a Global Learning Design and Development Instructional Designer, Assistant Director.
EY's Global Learning function designs, develops and deploys technical and non-technical learning for EY professionals across the world. In the Design and development team, we are applying learning science and proven technology in the development and curation of the best learning content.
We are looking for a colleague to join our virtual team working from over 20 geographical locations across the world. We offer flexible working, the chance to work in a multicultural and multinational environment, and best in class teaming and collaboration.
The opportunity
This position is responsible for the design of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The instructional designer will be aligned primarily to a particular service line, All EY, or function portfolio. The instructional designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency and quality. In addition, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, SMRs, learning and performance consultants, developers, deployment teams and vendors.
Your key responsibilities
Follow EY's evidence-based learning design processes to define and design individual learning items and programs on time, to budget and quality standards
Conduct skill needs and task analyses
Plan and document learning solutions and gain approvals from design leaders, learning and performance consultants and content owners; identify existing materials that can be curated and integrated into the learning journey
Write performance objectives that meet EY quality standards
Write design specifications using standard templates to ensure alignment of objectives with assessments, practice, presentation, overviews, integration and motivation elements; write specifications for configuring effective collaborative learning instances
Conduct quality assurance checks with SMRs, technical reviewers, CPE approvers and deployment teams; utilize their feedback to revise design documents
Write innovative eLearning pages and storyboards, audio/video scripts, facilitator and participant guides, job aids and other materials; test prototype products with sample audiences
Write engaging instructional materials including assessments and quizzes, practice exercises with appropriate feedback, simulations, demonstrations, case studies, worked examples, procedural steps, descriptions of concepts/processes/principles, opportunities for reflection and self-explanation, overviews
Conduct design quality reviews on new and existing learning solutions using the EY Design Quality Checklist
Ensure quality of learning content and proofread learning materials to ensure consistency (e.g. ensure references between leader guides and participant materials add-up, checking formatting, confirming timings in leader guides etc.)
Draft deployment plans and consult with regional deployment teams to revise the learning design as necessary
Collaborate closely with developers to ensure finished materials are authored as specified
Assist in pilots and make appropriate revisions to learning materials based on pilot results
Share instructional design best practices with other members of the design team in the spirit of continuous improvement
Skills and attributes for success
Strong knowledge of learning science and evidence-based design standards and practices to ensure that EY's learning content is of the highest quality and has the desired business impact
Strong interpersonal skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write effective instructional text, facilitator materials, audio and video scripts and other design documents
Strong collaboration skills enabling the designer to work effectively with content owners, SMRs, deployment teams, learning and performance consultants, CPE approvers and other members of the learning and talent teams to ensure that clients needs and expectations are met
Experience with learning management systems (SAP SuccessFactors preferred) and virtual classroom software (WebEx preferred)
Ability to use learning technology and tools, desktop applications and relevant knowledge tools
Act independently to complete all aspects of design activities
Review the work of internal or external developers to ensure adherence to the design and to EY design standards
Where applicable, coach instructional designers of third party providers to follow the EY design process; promote use of EY design standards, templates, and tools
Independently maintain and use (when appropriate) an internal network of contacts in other EY practices/departments that will enable personal effectiveness in the position
To qualify for the role you must have
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in designing courses and other learning items, preferably at a global level
Demonstrable experience in designing effective eLearning experiences, facilitator and participant guides (for the physical and virtual classroom), online and classroom simulations, video and audio media
Demonstrable experience designing eLearning that is accessible to people with disabilities
Experience with web-based applications and one or more learning management systems is desired
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools
Demonstrable experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients
Demonstrable experience managing change initiatives in global, matrix organizations (such as EY)
Demonstrable experience working in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results
Demonstrable experience using Articulate Storyline or similar course authoring programs is highly desired but not required
Demonstrable experience designing learning for mobile delivery is preferred but not required
Ideally, you'll also have
Professional qualification in instructional design or related discipline is preferred
Active membership in related professional bodies or industry groups is preferred, not required
Bachelors degree in education, psychology or related field is preferred, not required
Higher professional or masters qualification in a related discipline is preferred, not required
What we look for
An experienced instructional designer who can manage multiple, complex projects concurrently.

At Ey, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help Ey become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Ey Business Consulting Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant
At Ey, our objective is to help clients improve the performance and productivity of their Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O). With expertise in leading Enterprise Asset Management frameworks, you will help clients to effectively manage both the physical and non-physical assets through the entire lifecycle, maximising performance and productivity whilst reducing the total cost of operations / ownership.
The client base spans across industries and includes multinational companies in oil & gas, power & utilities, government, banking, consumer goods & retail, manufacturing etc.
The opportunity
We are looking for a passionate Senior Consultant with expertise in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) to join the group within our Business Consulting sub-service line and work with clients and project teams in EAM engagements. The role focuses on asset centric transformation covering governance, lifecycle strategy, performance optimization, and digital enablementhelping clients maximize asset value, optimize TOTEX, improve reliability, and strengthen decision-making across the asset lifecycle.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant, you will be part of a team of professionals with extensive consulting and industry experience. Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.
An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships. Travel may be required based on business/client requirement.
Typically, you will work across below EAM service offerings:
Governance and Assurance
Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting
Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization
Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning
Asset Performance & Reliability
Deliver asset performance optimization and reliability improvement initiatives
Design and improve maintenance management and reliability engineering frameworks
Support work management transformation, including planning, scheduling, and execution optimization
Optimize asset spares and inventory strategies to balance availability, cost, and risk
Asset Intelligence & Decision Enablement
Define asset data and information management strategies, including data governance and quality
Develop decision support frameworks and AI readiness roadmaps for EAM and assetintensive operations
Support selection, assessment, and optimization of EAM systems (e.g., SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle)
Drive IoT and sensorization use cases for condition monitoring and predictive insights
Support implementation of digital twins and BIM enabled asset management solutions
Your consulting and delivery responsibilities will be including and not limited to below:
Work closely with MENA clients to translate business and asset management challenges into practical, scalable EAM solutions
Lead and contribute to client workshops, diagnostics, and design sessions
Deliver highquality consulting outputs aligned to EY quality and delivery standards
Support business development and proposal efforts aligned to established EAM offerings
Coach junior team members and contribute to capability building within the EAM practice
Skills and attributes for success
Strong EAM domain knowledge across governance, lifecycle management, maintenance, and performance
Experience working across asset intensive industries (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cities and Municipalities, Facility Management, etc.)
Understanding of ISO 55001, ESG, and risk based asset management concepts
Exposure to AI, analytics, IoT, digital twins, and emerging asset technologies
Structured problem solving, client facing communication, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to translate strategy into operable processes, frameworks, and systems
To qualify for the role, you must have
48 years of experience in Enterprise Asset Management, Asset intensive Operations, or related consulting roles
Consulting experience in asset performance improvement, governance, cost optimization, or process design
Exposure to EAM systems (SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle, Asset investment planning tool, etc.)
Experience developing process documentation, frameworks, and maturity assessments
MinimumBachelors degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management
Willingness to travel onsite for client assignments, if required
Willingness to work Sunday to Thursday and support MENA regions client timings
Ideally, you should also have
Project management skills
Customer handling, Report writing, Strong interpersonal communication skills, and experience in usage of analytical tools/ representations

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We are seeking a seasoned Technology Project Management professional to play a critical role in supporting and delivering complex technology and transformation initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with clients, internal teams, and leadership to plan, execute, and control projects, while ensuring strong governance, disciplined execution, and high-quality outcomes across the delivery lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
AI enabled PPM services.
Lead and solution Project management AI use cases for client engagement and create assets along with creating a GTM approach for them
Project Management and Delivery: Lead and support end-to-end project delivery across one or more workstreams, ensuring that scope, schedule, cost, quality, risks, and dependencies are actively managed throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and maintain integrated project plans, detailed schedules, milestone trackers, and dependency maps, while ensuring alignment with agreed delivery timelines and quality standards.
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a primary point of coordination between business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and leadership. Facilitate requirements workshops, planning sessions, and status reviews, ensuring expectations are clearly understood and proactively managed. Provide regular, structured communication on progress, risks, issues, and decisions.
Governance, Reporting, and Controls: Establish and maintain strong project governance artefacts including status reports, dashboards, RAID logs, decision registers, and action trackers. Support governance forums such as steering committees and working groups, ensuring accurate reporting, decision traceability, and follow-through on agreed actions.
Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and interdependencies, working with stakeholders to define mitigation strategies and escalation paths. Ensure risks and issues are tracked transparently and addressed in a timely manner to minimize delivery impact.
PMO Enablement and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and enhancement of PMO standards, templates, and delivery best practices. Support continuous improvement initiatives by bringing lessons learned and practical insights from project execution.
To Qualify for the Role You Must Have Education
Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
Experience
58 years of progressive experience in project management or PMO roles, with demonstrated experience delivering technology-enabled or transformation initiatives. Job Title: SAP Ariba Transformation Source to Settle Enablement Testing Specialist
Function: Supply Chain Services
Type of Role: Contractor
Job Summary
This position is within the Source to Settle Enablement (S2SE) team of SCS. S2SE's purpose is to build optimal source to settle solutions to drive financial success for EY and their clients. S2SE is responsible for managing key lifecycle activities from purchase requisitions to AP processing.
The Opportunity
EY is undergoing a S2P Gold Standard transformation, scaling a next generation digital solutions and operating model across the S2P lifecycle, with AI and data at the core. This includes an implementation of SAP/Ariba Procurement Suite at the core of the digital transformation.
Your key responsibilities
As the S2SE Testing Specialist, you will manage end-to-end testing activities for transformation initiatives, including test planning, design, execution, defect management, user acceptance testing, readiness reporting and hyper-care support. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate requirements, manage risks and support go-live readiness.
Develop test scenarios, scripts and cases aligned to business requirements, process documentation and expected outcomes.
Coordinate testing across SIT, functional, end-to-end, regression, UAT and security access phases.
Track testing progress, document evidence, monitor risks and support timely resolution of blockers.
Log, track and manage defects using approved tools, including triage support, fix validation and escalation of critical issues.
Collaborate with EY business users, Finance and SCS/S2SE teams to prepare, execute and track UAT activities, including objectives, responsibilities and sign-off.
Produce status reports, dashboards and leadership updates covering progress, defects, risks and go-live readiness.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test governance and defect management processes.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders in a complex transformation environment.
Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impacts and recommend practical improvements.
Inclusive and collaborative working style, with the ability to engage effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
Requirements
Bachelors degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software/application testing for transformation, technology, or enterprise application programs.
5+ years of experience leading testing activities for large-scale transformation programs, including test planning, test execution, defect management, UAT coordination, and testing status reporting.
Experience working with cross-functional business stakeholders and technology teams across onshore and offshore delivery models.
Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication and change leadership
Preferred qualifications
Experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, ERP, Procure to Pay or SAP Ariba environments. Emphasis on S2P platform experience including SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing Suite, Ariba SLP, Ariba Risk, Ariba Buying, Ariba Invoicing and Ariba Business Network.
Experience with HP ALM, Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail or equivalent test management tools.
Experience in Agile, hybrid or large-scale transformation delivery environments.
Testing, Agile or project management certification, such as ISTQB, SAFe, PMP or equivalent.
Microsoft Project to develop and manage plans
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft PowerPoint
Microsoft Visio
Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization.
Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently.
What we look for
We are looking for a collaborative professional who brings structure, quality discipline and practical judgment to complex transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams, managing ambiguity and helping stakeholders make informed decisions that support successful delivery.

Job Title
Assistant Director - Senior Art Director
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human across multiple media platforms.
Your key responsibilities
You understand the power of creative ideas and have a track-record of delivering memorable ideas that shape audience perception, engagement, and participation
You help coach and train the wider team, transforming GDS Creative Services capability from providing excellent design and execution services, to leading with brand-building and distinctive creative ideas and strategy
Have experience leading teams in creative agencies or in-house brand teams, championing high-visibility campaigns for top global brands (preferably B2B)
Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post-production
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
Stay up-to-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Lead project discussions with customers with a customer-centric mindset
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
Proven track record of delivering high-quality output on time and within budget
An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Understanding of current and future visual trends
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc.)
Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
At least 12 years of overall experience in a fast-paced global environment
Prior art direction experience in leading agencies
Ideally, you'll also have
Working knowledge of other key software and tools relevant to the industry
What we look for
Strong business acumen along with creative vision
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
Self-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced and knowledgeable Business Consultant to join our dynamic team. ITS professionals should be able to operate globally on internal programs that are critical to EYs strategy and ambition. As a Business Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic guidance and expert advice to our Executive Leadership in the areas of project management, change management, and design thinking. Your extensive experience in these fields will be invaluable as you collaborate with cross-functional teams, lead transformative projects, and drive organizational growth and innovation. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of project management methodologies, change management principles, and design thinking frameworks, along with exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
EY ES Internal Transformation Services
ITS (Internal Transformation Services) under EYs Enablement Service, is a team of seasoned consulting professionals that operate globally on internal transformation programs which are critical to EYs strategy and ambition. Our expertise is in the areas of Project Management, Strategy, Technology, Process Improvement, Organization Design, and Organizational Change Management.
Job Description Roles & Responsibilities
Collaborate with Executive Leadership to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide teams toward successful outcomes
Manage & engage senior stakeholder relationships at CxO, Partner, Functional Head levels
Perform rapid assessment of landscape for stakeholders and provide insights to accelerate action towards refining their current state
Bring diverse and thought-provoking perspective to transformations, including market trends, new and innovative ideas to drive data driven decision making
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and attention to detail
Drive and build upon a culture of continuous improvement by developing innovative idea
Conduct comprehensive analyses of organizations processes and systems
Provide strategic recommendations and action plans to drive business performance and transformation
Develop roadmaps for implementing project management, Organizational change management, and design thinking initiatives.
Lead and manage complex projects from initiation to closure, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with clients and stakeholders
Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies
Foster effective communication and collaboration among project teams and stakeholders
Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation initiatives
Conducting Change Impact Analysis and Change Readiness / Gap Assessment and give recommendations that are actionable on immediate and long-term basis
Build strong change network, drive change adoption, manage stakeholders with people centric approach, if needed work towards mindset shift and achieve cultural transformation
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management efforts and make adjustments as necessary
Apply design thinking principles and methodologies to identify innovative solutions to complex business problems
Conduct user research, gather insights, and define user personas and journeys.
Advocate for design thinking principles and foster a culture of creativity and experimentation within client organizations
Contribute to the development and enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks
Mentor and coach junior consultants, providing guidance and support in their professional growth
What will make you eligible for this role
Masters degree in business administration, management, or a related field
10+ Years of experience with at least 7+ years of management / business consulting experience
Advance MS Suite skills particularly, to develop engaging presentations and dashboards
Professional certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional), certification in Change Management or Design Thinking are highly desirable.
Deep understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and their practical application in different contexts.
Extensive knowledge of change management principles, models, and methodologies, with hands-on experience leading change initiatives.
Proficiency in design thinking frameworks and tools, with the ability to apply them effectively to solve complex business problems.
Awareness and experience of leveraging technology as enablers
Exceptional communication, presentation skills with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences
Good to have
Experience working in the Big 4 professional services firms and other global management consultancies is highly desirable
MBA or equivalent advanced education is preferable
Certification in Project Management, Organisational Change Management, Design Thinking, Facilitation will be an advantage

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and motivated ServiceNow Platform Engineer to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in ServiceNow administration, configuration, development, integrations, and platform governance, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that meet business requirements.
Key Responsibilities Platform Engineering & Administration
Administer and maintain the ServiceNow platform across development, test, and production environments.
Configure and support platform modules including ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, SPM, Employee Center, custom applications and domain separation.
Ensure platform stability, performance, availability, and security.

Evaluate new ServiceNow features and recommend adoption strategies.

Job Summary
I&O Platform Infrastructure Patching & Vulnerability Compliance Lead - Assistant Director | Enterprise Technology.
In EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for an experienced and authoritative Patching and Vulnerability Compliance Lead to own and drive patching compliance, vulnerability management and security posture reporting across EY's entire I&O Platform Infrastructure estate. This is a senior cross-tower leadership role with accountability that spans every platform discipline Windows, Linux, Storage, Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI), Backup, Network, Facilities and associated managed services.
The role sits at the intersection of infrastructure operations, cybersecurity and executive reporting, and is a key leadership position within EY's Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC). The successful candidate will serve as the firm's primary authority on infrastructure patching compliance, frontier AI risk response as it applies to infrastructure, and cross-tower SPI and SLA performance providing the visibility, governance and operational leadership needed to maintain a secure, compliant and well-managed global infrastructure estate.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Patching and Vulnerability Compliance Lead owns the end-to-end patching governance framework across all I&O platform towers, ensuring that vulnerability remediation commitments are met, compliance positions are accurately reported and exceptions are managed through a rigorous, risk-based process. This professional serves as the single point of accountability for patching SLA performance across Windows, Linux, Storage, HCI, Backup, Network and Facilities infrastructure domains.
Operating as a lead member of the Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC), this role drives the weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reporting cycle, chairs cross-tower patching forums, manages escalations from security and audit stakeholders, and leads the firm's response to frontier AI-related infrastructure risks ensuring that emerging AI-driven threat vectors are assessed, prioritized and remediated within agreed timelines. The Lead partners with tower engineering leads, security operations, risk and compliance teams, and senior I&O leadership to deliver a consistent, transparent and defensible compliance posture.
Skills and attributes for success
Broad knowledge of I&O Platform Infrastructure technologies across all towers, including:
Windows Server patching WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Windows Update for Business
Linux patching Red Hat Satellite, Ansible, YUM/DNF, APT-based tooling
Storage platform firmware and software lifecycle management
Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) patching Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix, VMware
Backup platform patching Commvault, Veeam, Veritas or equivalent
Network device patching routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers
Facilities and data center infrastructure UPS, PDU, DCIM and environmental systems
Strong vulnerability management lifecycle experience from scan to remediation to compliance attestation (exclusionary).
Deep experience with vulnerability scanning tooling Qualys, Tenable Nessus, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent (exclusionary).
Experience leading patching governance forums and cross-tower compliance reviews.
Strong understanding of frontier AI infrastructure risks and the ability to assess, prioritize and respond to AI-driven vulnerability and threat intelligence.
Experience operating in and leading from within an Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC) or equivalent 24x7 operations environment.
Strong SPI and SLA management capability; ability to define, track, report and drive remediation of patching and compliance KPIs across multiple platform towers.
Experience producing executive-level compliance dashboards and vulnerability posture reporting.
Strong knowledge of security and compliance frameworks relevant to infrastructure patching:
CIS Benchmarks
NIST SP 800-40
ISO 27001
SOC 2
CVSSv3/v4 scoring and prioritization
Experience managing patching exceptions, risk acceptances and compensating control documentation.
Ability to engage and influence tower engineering leads, security operations and senior leadership stakeholders.
Experience working with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) for change management, patch scheduling and compliance tracking.
Strong PowerShell or Python scripting capability for compliance reporting automation.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively across global engineering teams and time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Cross-platform patching governance and compliance program leadership 7+ years.
Vulnerability management lifecycle scan, triage, remediation, attestation 7+ years.
Windows Server patching at enterprise scale (WSUS, MECM, MDE) 7+ years.
Linux patching at enterprise scale (Satellite, Ansible, YUM/APT) 57 years.
HCI platform patching (Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix or VMware) 35 years.
Storage and backup platform firmware and software lifecycle management 35 years.
Network device patching governance across multi-vendor environments 35 years.
Vulnerability scanning tool administration (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7 or equivalent) 57 years.
CVSSv3/v4 scoring, vulnerability prioritization and risk-based remediation planning.
SPI and SLA reporting for patching compliance across multiple infrastructure towers.
Executive compliance dashboard and posture reporting monthly and quarterly cycles.
Patching exception management risk acceptance, compensating controls and audit evidence.
Change management and patch scheduling through ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM.
IOC or NOC leadership presence cross-tower incident and compliance escalation management.
Frontier AI risk assessment as applied to infrastructure security posture (preferred).
Security framework alignment CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 (preferred).
PowerShell or Python automation for compliance reporting pipelines 35 years.

Job Title: GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst
Job Span: NVIDIA Alliance
Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation
Skill Level: High
Sub Function: Alliances Program Operations CoE
Job Summary
The GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Alliances Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support for the NVIDIA Alliance within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role will help alliance leadership run an effective, insight-led and scalable operating model by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution of NVIDIA alliance initiatives across sell, build and deliver motions. The incumbent will work closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders to strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
Essential Functions of the Job
Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
Provide NVIDIA alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators.
Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
Program manage NVIDIA partner tools, portals and operational processes, including partner portal access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support NVIDIA Market Development Fund processes, investment tracking, compliance monitoring, quarterly reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
Support NVIDIA alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner distinction or specialization requirements and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
Partner with onshore NVIDIA alliance enablement contacts on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to NVIDIA, accelerated computing, AI platforms, enterprise technology or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.
Job Requirements Academics
MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Bachelors degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, NVIDIA, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.
Experience
8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement.

Job Summary
Role Title: GDS Microsoft Marketplace Transactions, Operations & Finance Lead Analyst
Alliance: Microsoft
Competency: Operations Management
Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation
Skill Level: High
Sub Function: GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE
The Microsoft Alliance is one of EY's most strategic ecosystem relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. As marketplace-led motions become increasingly important to solution commercialization and client activation, disciplined transaction coordination, operational governance and finance visibility are critical to scalable alliance execution.
The Marketplace Transactions, Operations & Finance Lead Analyst will support the Microsoft Alliance team by managing marketplace transaction operations, finance coordination, reporting, documentation, stakeholder follow-through and process governance across Microsoft marketplace-related activities.
This role is designed for a detail-oriented professional who can connect marketplace activity with operational execution and finance transparency. The incumbent will work closely with Microsoft Alliance stakeholders, marketplace and solution teams, finance, commercial, sales, marketing, operations and GDS teams to ensure that transactions, approvals, documentation, reporting and follow-ups are completed accurately, on time and with clear ownership.
The role will also support AI-enabled marketplace growth by helping track AI, Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI and automation-related marketplace activity, while ensuring transaction support considers business value, responsible AI requirements, data privacy considerations and commercialization readiness in a practical and consistent manner.
Your key responsibilities
Support marketplace transaction operations, governance routines and business review cadences for Microsoft Alliance marketplace-related activities.
Maintain transaction trackers, operational status views, finance coordination logs and action registers for marketplace opportunities, submissions, publications and commercial follow-ups.
Coordinate with solution owners, alliance teams, finance, commercial, sales and operations stakeholders to maintain visibility across transaction progress, readiness gaps, approvals, invoices and documentation requirements, where applicable.
Independently progress marketplace operations workstreams aligned to Microsoft Alliance priorities, ensuring activities are tracked, updated and advanced with clear owners and timelines.
Prepare concise leadership and stakeholder summaries covering marketplace transaction status, operational risks, finance dependencies, pending actions and decisions required.
Support marketplace finance coordination by tracking commercial information, funding linkages, transaction evidence, documentation, reporting inputs and reconciliation follow-ups required by the workstream.
Develop and maintain marketplace operations dashboards, Excel trackers, Power BI views, SharePoint repositories, reporting calendars and governance documentation.
Support monthly business reviews, operational check-ins, finance reviews and marketplace readiness discussions by preparing performance narratives and visual summaries.
Analyze trends across marketplace activity, transaction progress, operational bottlenecks, evidence gaps, finance dependencies and stakeholder actions to identify risks, improvement opportunities and recommended next steps.
Coordinate with sales, marketing and solution teams to support marketplace activation requirements, including offer narratives, enablement content, client-facing materials, marketplace content and commercialization readiness inputs.
Support AI-enabled marketplace activities by improving tracker automation, status summaries, exception reporting, dashboard commentary and leadership-ready narratives using responsible AI principles.
Build efficiency, automation and standardization into marketplace transaction workflows, finance coordination processes, reporting routines, data validation and documentation practices.
Partner with onshore Microsoft Alliance, marketplace, finance and operations contacts on special requests, process improvements, reporting enhancements and leadership asks.
Identify transaction risks, data gaps, finance coordination issues, process delays and documentation challenges that may impact marketplace execution, and coordinate timely resolution with stakeholders.
Translate marketplace, commercial and finance-related updates into simple, stakeholder-friendly narratives that support decision-making and execution follow-through.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of marketplace operations, transaction coordination, finance operations, reporting governance and stakeholder follow-through.
Exposure to sales, pipeline, commercial and finance processes, including opportunity life cycles, transaction tracking, reporting definitions, documentation requirements and operational controls.
Technology aptitude and comfort working across Microsoft solution areas such as Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, Cloud, Security, Business Applications, marketplace offerings and automation at a business level.
Good understanding of AI-enabled transformation and the ability to apply approved AI tools responsibly to improve marketplace reporting, transaction summaries, exception tracking and operational storytelling.
Exposure to continuous process improvement, workflow standardization, reporting automation, data validation, process documentation, internal controls and audit-ready evidence management.

Job Summary
Todays world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.


Junior Security Analyst - Cyber Defense CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics)

The Opportunity
Cyber Triage and Forensics (CTF) - The Cyber Defense Response Center is responsible for monitoring and detecting information security events that could adversely impact EY information assets and resources. Its mission is aligned with the incident response and attack lifecycles.
A qualified candidate will have the opportunity to work with highly talent Cyber security professional experts to learn and develop new skills. Candidate will be exposed to many technologies and security tools whilst working with EY as well as career growth opportunity. CTF also deliver training to analysts to upskill.


Your key responsibilities
Perform front line accurate and precise real-time monitoring and analysis correlation of logs/alerts from a multitude of security devices with a focus on the determination of what was said as events constitute security incidents.
Collaborate to detect and respond to information security incidents, develop, maintain, and follow procedures for security event alerting, and participate in security investigations.
The CTF Junior Security Analyst must be competent to work at a technical level, be capable of identifying threats and vectors that cause security events and be able to follow defined procedures for mitigating said threats.


Essential Functions
Respond to network and host based security events
Participate in detecting, investigating, and resolving security events
Identify and propose areas for improvement within the Cyber Defense Response Center
Provide documentation and project support
Serve as an escalation point for difficult problems and complex inquiries
Server as shift lead when necessary
Conduct detailed security event analysis from network traffic attributes and host-based attributes ( binary analysis, etc) to identify information security incidents
Provide feedback on security control capability gaps based off of security intrusion trends
Develop and maintain analytical procedures to improve security incident identification efficiency
Demonstrate ability to drive process improvements and identify gaps


Skills and attributes for success
Information Security Principles, Technologies, and Practices
Experience with multiple security event detection platforms
Fair understanding of Linux, TCP/IP, Network Security, encryption standards etc.
Aware of Types of attacks (DOS, DDOS etc.)
Understand basic IDS / IPS rules to identify and/or prevent malicious activity
Aware of security log analysis.
Idea about various penetration testing and application testing methodology and tools is a definite plus.
Comfortable navigating and troubleshooting Linux and Windows system issues


To qualify for the role you must have
Capability of working independently
Soft Skills - Excellent communication skills; written and verbal.
Good Presentation skills
Good Investigative, analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to work in a team, with little supervision and using own initiative


Experience
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in one or more of the following:
Working in a Security Monitoring/Security Operations Center environment (SOC)
Experience investigating security events, threats and/or vulnerabilities
Understanding of electronic investigation and log correlation Proficiency with the latest intrusion detection platforms; working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows systems administration (Including AD).
Scripting or programming (Shell scripting, Power Shell, C, C#, Java, etc.)


Qualifications, certifications and Education requirements
Under Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or related domain (MCA/MTech/BTech/BCA /BSc CS or BSc IT).


Desired Certifications
Any Cyber Security Certification


Ideally, youll also have
Good demeanour.
Willingness to work a flexible shifts with schedules that includes nights, weekends and holidays; shifts can changed based on business needs.
Demonstrated integrity in a professional environment
Willingness to learn new technologies.


What we look for
Under limited supervision the CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics) Junior Security Analyst will report to the CTF Manager. The CTF Junior Security Analyst will perform tasks including monitoring, research, classification and analysis of security events that occur on the network or endpoint. The CTF Junior Security Analyst should have familiarity with the principles of network and endpoint security, current threat and attack trends, a basic understanding of the OSI model, and have a working knowledge of Defense in depth strategies.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


Consulting - Senior Manager, Insurance Delivery (Guidewire and Insurance Platforms)
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.


The Opportunity
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Delivery Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead complex Insurance technology engagements for global clients. The role requires broad functional and technical understanding of Guidewire InsuranceSuite, surrounding digital and integration platforms, and a strong command of service management and ITIL principles. The successful candidate will own client outcomes, delivery performance, financial health, service quality, people leadership and continuous improvement across a large engagement or a portfolio of engagements.


Your Key Responsibilities
Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex or multiple Insurance engagements across implementation, transformation, application maintenance and support, enhancements, integration, testing, release and production operations.
Provide executive governance across scope, schedule, quality, SLAs, risks, dependencies and benefits, with clear accountability for committed client outcomes.
Lead geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams across onshore, nearshore and offshore locations, including service managers, architects, functional consultants, engineering, testing, DevOps and service management teams.
Build trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, product owners and third-party partners, and act as the senior escalation point for delivery and service matters.
Establish and run governance forums, steering committees, service reviews and executive reporting with fact-based insights, decisions and actions.
Drive predictable delivery through integrated planning, demand and capacity management, dependency management, release readiness, quality gates and disciplined change control.
Own performance against contractual service levels and experience measures; lead recovery plans where performance is at risk and ensure transparent reporting of trends and corrective actions.
Oversee major incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis, change and release management, service transition, knowledge management and operational resilience.
Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, client controls, security requirements, regulatory obligations, audit expectations and delivery standards.
Drive continuous improvement, automation, shift-left, observability, engineering excellence and AI-enabled operations to improve reliability, responsiveness and cost efficiency.
Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, transition planning and mobilization for new opportunities and scope expansion.
Develop leadership capability and succession across the account; coach managers and senior team members, manage performance, improve retention and build a strong delivery culture.


Skills and attributes for success

Guidewire and platform leadership
Broad knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, including configuration, integration, data, digital channels, rating, batch processing, rules, workflows and reporting.
Understanding of Guidewire Cloud delivery and operations, cloud migration considerations, platform upgrades, environment strategy, deployment pipelines and production support models.
Ability to oversee Guidewire integrations with policy, claims, billing, document, payment, finance, customer relationship management, data, analytics, identity and other enterprise platforms.
Knowledge of modern architecture and engineering practices involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, middleware, cloud services, secure DevOps, automated delivery pipelines, test automation and observability.
Working knowledge of adjacent Insurance platforms and technologies such as digital portals, data and analytics platforms, document and content management, rating solutions, enterprise integration and cloud infrastructure.


Service management and operational excellence
Practical application of ITIL principles across incident, major incident, problem, change, release, request, configuration, knowledge, availability, capacity and service-level management.
Experience establishing operating models, service governance, escalation paths, responsibility structures, support coverage, on-call models and service improvement plans.
Ability to use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns, service risks, demand drivers and improvement opportunities, and convert insights into measurable actions.


Leadership and delivery attributes
Strong Insurance domain understanding, preferably Property and Casualty, across policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims and related business processes.
Proven success delivering large-scale or multi-account technology engagements for global clients, with accountability for distributed teams and senior stakeholders.
Ability to operate confidently across executive governance, commercial management, delivery detail and technical risk while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
Strong leadership presence, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial acumen covering estimation, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, productivity, contract interpretation and change control.
Experience with Agile, Scrum, scaled delivery and traditional delivery methods, with the judgment to apply fit-for-purpose governance.
Working familiarity with service and engineering tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring platforms, knowledge repositories and automated delivery toolchains.

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior Oracle Database Administrator is accountable for the reliable, secure and efficient operation of Oracle database platforms supporting business-critical applications. The role combines hands-on database administration with engineering, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, security controls and close collaboration across application, infrastructure, security and DevOps teams.
The successful candidate will own operational database activities from installation and configuration through monitoring, performance optimization, backup and recovery, patching, upgrades and production support. The role also contributes database expertise to ensure that database changes are tested, documented, auditable and safely promoted through environments.


Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Core database administration
Install, create, configure and maintain Oracle databases on all environments
Administer database instances, schemas, storage, tablespaces, parameters, listeners, services and connectivity in line with agreed standards.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and technical maintenance, including prerequisite checks, rollback planning, validation and evidence capture.
Execute database and schema refreshes across environments using approved native tools and controlled procedures.
Maintain accurate operational documentation, configuration records, runbooks and technical procedures.


Performance, availability and resilience
Monitor database health, capacity, availability and performance; identify trends and address risks before they affect service quality.
Perform database performance tuning, investigate bottlenecks and optimize configuration, queries, indexes and resource utilization where appropriate.
Design, operate and test backup, restore and recovery procedures using Oracle RMAN, and ensure recovery evidence is retained.
Operate and troubleshoot high-availability and disaster-recovery capabilities, especially Oracle Data Guard; experience with RAC, ASM and Grid Infrastructure is beneficial.
Support capacity planning, housekeeping, availability reviews and disaster-recovery exercises for critical database services.


Security, access and audit
Implement database security controls, including user and role administration, least-privilege access, authentication integration and segregation of duties.
Administer encryption controls such as Transparent Data Encryption and file-system-level encryption, as well as encrypted database connections.
Review vulnerability assessment findings, assess database impact and apply required remediation or patches through controlled change processes.
Configure and maintain database auditing and reporting mechanisms, and provide traceable evidence for reviews and audits.
Troubleshoot Oracle network configuration, listener issues, certificates, connection encryption and authentication problems.


Delivery, Operations and Collaboration
Operational support and service management
Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for database incidents, performance degradation, failed jobs, connectivity issues and application errors.
Participate in incident, problem, change and release processes; communicate technical status, risk, impact and remediation clearly.
Support planned maintenance and, where required by the operating model, on-call or out-of-hours activities for critical services.
Work with application teams to translate business and technical requirements into supportable database solutions.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, network, security and identity teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administration, monitoring, configuration and deployment activities using scripting and configuration-management tools.
Contribute to standards, reusable procedures, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of database operations.


Expected deliverables
Deliverable
Operational documentation
Change artefacts
Health and performance outputs
Security and compliance evidence
Knowledge transfer


Typical content
Runbooks, configuration standards, recovery procedures and troubleshooting guides
Implementation plan, test evidence, rollback plan, approvals and post-change validation
Monitoring findings, capacity observations, tuning recommendations and incident analysis
Access reviews, patch evidence, vulnerability remediation, encryption and audit records

Job Summary

Assistant Director - Senior Art Director
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Art Director, you will have a unique blend of creative vision and strategic thinking, to lead our team and will act as a strong creative strategist and a design thought leader.
You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on-brand, user-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.


Your key responsibilities
You understand the power of creative ideas and have a track-record of delivering memorable ideas that shape audience perception, engagement, and participation
You help coach and train the wider team, transforming GDS Creative Services capability from providing excellent design and execution services, to leading with brand-building and distinctive creative ideas and strategy
Have experience leading teams in creative agencies or in-house brand teams, championing high-visibility campaigns for top global brands (preferably B2B)
Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post-production
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
Stay up-to-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Lead project discussions with customers with a customer-centric mindset
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives


Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
Proven track record of delivering high-quality output on time and within budget
An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Understanding of current and future visual trends


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc.)
Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
At least 12 years of overall experience in a fast-paced global environment
Prior art direction experience in leading agencies


Ideally, youll also have
Working knowledge of other key software and tools relevant to the industry


What we look for
Strong business acumen along with creative vision
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
Self-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

Job Summary

Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.


Discipline-Design for Technology
Role Type-Visual Design


The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human across multiple media platforms.
As a Supervising Associate Senior Multimedia Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives.
