Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an accomplished Associate Director AI Agentic Platform Architect to lead the architecture, engineering and operational evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms that drive intelligent operations and digital employee experiences.
This role spans the complete Build Deploy Operate Improve lifecycle and requires deep expertise across Agentic AI, Generative AI, Enterprise Application Architecture, Data Knowledge Platforms, Automation, Observability and AI Operations.
As a key technology leader, you will be responsible for defining the enterprise architecture strategy for AI-powered platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and ensuring successful adoption and operation of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. You will work across business, engineering, architecture and operations teams to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, governed and production-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Success in this role requires a proven ability to architect, build and operate secure, resilient and highly available enterprise products at scale while driving innovation, operational excellence and enterprise adoption of AI-powered solutions.


Your key responsibilities
Own the end-to-end architecture vision, standards and technical strategy for enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions.
Design single-agent and multi-agent architectures encompassing orchestration, reasoning, collaboration, memory, context management, tool integration and human-in-the-loop controls.
Architect AI-powered operational capabilities that observe, correlate, diagnose, predict, prevent and resolve technology issues.
Design intelligent conversational experiences capable of understanding user and technology context, diagnosing issues and safely initiating actions.
Architect enterprise knowledge and intelligence platforms leveraging structured and unstructured data, operational telemetry, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic and hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph technologies.
Define Generative AI architecture covering model strategy, model routing, grounding, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails and performance optimization.
Architect scalable enterprise applications utilizing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering patterns.
Establish reusable integration patterns across enterprise applications, operational systems, data platforms and automation services.
Define architecture standards for identity, security, privacy, Responsible AI, explainability, auditability and governance.
Establish engineering standards covering scalability, availability, resilience, performance, maintainability and security.
Lead architecture governance, technology evaluations, design reviews and strategic build-versus-buy decisions.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship and guidance across architecture, engineering and platform teams.
Provide technical leadership across the full product lifecycle, from engineering and release management through production operations and continuous improvement.
Ensure enterprise AI services consistently meet availability, reliability, performance, scalability and service-level objectives.
Establish end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, data platforms, AI models and agent workflows.
Drive incident management, problem management and reliability engineering practices, including root-cause analysis and prevention of recurring production issues.
Establish operational readiness frameworks covering release governance, capacity planning, resilience validation and disaster recovery.
Define and implement AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices covering quality, performance, latency, evaluation, telemetry, failure management and cost optimization.
Utilize operational insights to continuously improve platform architecture, engineering quality, user experience and business outcomes.
Engage, influence and manage senior technology and business stakeholders, including CTO-level leaders, to align AI platform strategy, architecture decisions and delivery priorities with enterprise objectives.
Lead, mentor and develop high-performing teams, providing people leadership, coaching, performance guidance and capability-building across architecture, engineering and platform functions.


Skills and attributes for success
Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, modern application engineering and AI platform design.
Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, multi-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, memory architectures, tool integration and AI evaluation methodologies.
Proven ability to architect and operate large-scale, highly available and resilient enterprise platforms.
Expertise in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering.
Strong understanding of enterprise knowledge platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, hybrid retrieval and knowledge graph architectures.
Experience establishing observability, reliability engineering, AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices for enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity management, privacy, governance and Responsible AI principles.
Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to balance innovation, governance and operational excellence.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and executive engagement skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, lead complex initiatives and mentor high-performing engineering teams.
Ability to drive solutions from concept through architecture, engineering, production deployment, operations and continuous improvement.


Ideally, you'll also
Bring strong hands-on experience with .NET / C# and enterprise application architecture.
Have experience with Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable agent orchestration platforms.
Have experience with Microsoft Foundry or comparable enterprise AI development, governance and operations platforms.
Demonstrate experience designing and implementing multi-agent and tool-enabled AI systems.
Possess experience with cloud-native application development, containerization and orchestration technologies.
Have experience with enterprise data platforms, lakehouse architectures, knowledge graphs and advanced retrieval technologies.
Demonstrate experience implementing AIOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and enterprise observability practices.
Bring experience working within large, complex and globally distributed enterprise technology environments.


What we look for
We are looking for a builder, architect and operator who understands how AI, Data, Knowledge, Applications, Integration, Automation, Security and Operations come together to form a unified enterprise platform.
The ideal candidate brings a balanced combination of strategic architectural thinking, deep technical expertise and operational excellence. They understand that enterprise-scale Agentic AI requires context, identity, memory, permissions, tools, workflows, observability, evaluation, governance, resilience and human oversight to deliver trusted business outcomes.
Most importantly, we are seeking an individual who can architect, build, deploy, operate and continuously evolve secure, resilient and scalable AI platforms, while driving innovation and enabling enterprise-wide adoption of next-generation intelligent solutions.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Additional Responsibilities

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Pathologist-Full Time
Patna
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

SUMMARY
Job Title: Construction Helper
Location: Oman
Industry: Construction
Job Summary
We are hiring Helpers for construction and site-related work in Oman. The candidate will assist skilled workers with material handling, basic site activities, cleaning, and maintaining a safe and organized workplace.
Key Responsibilities
Assist skilled workers with construction and site-related activities.
Load, unload, carry, and arrange construction materials, tools, and equipment.
Support skilled workers with basic preparation, cleaning, and material-handling tasks.
Maintain tools, materials, and work areas in an organized condition.
Follow instructions from supervisors and skilled workers.
Maintain a clean and safe workplace.
Follow all site safety rules and procedures.
Work cooperatively with team members to complete assigned tasks.
Salary: 90 OMR / 22000 INR Per Month including food

Requirements
Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience.
Physically fit and capable of performing manual work.
Hardworking, disciplined, and responsible.
Ability to follow instructions and work effectively as part of a team.
Willingness to work overtime.
Willingness to relocate and work in Oman.

Benefits
Monthly Salary: OMR 90 including food
Overtime Rate: OMR 0.400 per hour
Average Overtime: Approximately 65 hours/month
Working Hours: 8 hours regular duty + 2.5 hours overtime/day
Working Days: 26 days/month
Accommodation: Provided by the company
Transportation: Provided by the company
Food: Included in the monthly salary/package
Joining Flight Ticket: Provided by the company
Employment Visa: Provided by the company
Medical Benefits: As per company policy and applicable regulations
Contract: 2 Years

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Role purpose
Plan, execute and monitor vegetable-seed trials
(includes PLC 6. 1, agronomy trials, satellite demos, demo day fields)
within an assigned state or geography in India. Generate accurate, timely and decision-ready trial data to support hybrid evaluation, product advancement, regional positioning and commercial launch decisions.
Key responsibilities
Execute annual trialing plans for assigned vegetable crops, hybrids and trial types across the designated geography.
Identify, establish and manage suitable trial locations with growers, research partners and external trial service providers.
Implement approved trial protocols, including plot layout, planting, crop management, assessments, harvest and sample handling.
Ensure trials represent relevant local agro-climatic conditions, production systems, seasons, disease pressure and grower practices.
Collect, validate and submit high-quality data on yield, maturity, fruit quality, disease tolerance, plant habit, shelf life and other defined product traits as per the product profile. Effective use of the internal tools like Ez Capture
Monitor trials regularly, identify deviations or risks early, and take corrective action in line with trial protocols.
Maintain complete trial records, photographs, GPS/location details, field books and digital data entries within agreed timelines
Work closely with Product specialist, Breeding & TPP teams to support pipeline decisions and hybrid advancement with trial execution, PAT execution, data collection and data consolidation for proposal to the product meetings
Partner with commercial, Product specialist, customer experience teams to establish satellite demo & demo days field demonstrations and build compelling evidence for launches and demand generation activities around CPIs with CX and Commercial team
Build productive relationships with trial growers, distributors, research institutions and local agricultural stakeholders.
Provide timely local market and crop insights, including competitor observations, emerging diseases, customer preferences and production challenges.
Manage assigned trialing materials, field equipment, seasonal labour and local operating expenses efficiently.
Ensure full compliance with safety, stewardship, phytosanitary, quality and data-integrity requirements.
Support to the commercial team for the mass scale customer complaints validation and RCA process
Lead, coach and develop the supporting team of trail officers
Qualifications
Qualifications and experience
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Agronomy, Plant Breeding or a related discipline.
4-6 years of experience in vegetable-seed trialing, product development, agronomy, field research in vegetable seeds.
Practical knowledge of vegetable crop cultivation and local production systems within the assigned geography.
Experience in multi-location field trials, trial protocol implementation and crop assessment.
Familiarity with experimental design, digital data capture and basic data analysis is preferred.
Ability to work independently in the field and coordinate growers, labour and external partners.
Fluency in English and the relevant regional language(s)
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography, including during planting, assessment and harvest periods.
Key competencies
Field execution and agronomic judgement
Strong attention to detail and data discipline
Planning, prioritisation and problem solving
Stakeholder and grower relationship management
Collaboration across R&D, product development and commercial teams
Clear communication and timely reporting
Safety, stewardship and quality mindset
Success measures
Timely establishment and completion of assigned trials
Compliance with approved protocols and trialing standards
Accuracy, completeness and on-time submission of trial data
Quality and relevance of local product recommendations
Effective management of trial sites, growers and local partners
Efficient use of assigned budget, materials and seasonal resources
Timely escalation and resolution of trial risks or deviations

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
We are looking for a dedicated Executive Assistant to support our management team in Ludhiana.
The ideal candidate will have 2 to 5 years of experience and should be a female professional ready to work full-time at the office.

A polite demeanor and professionalism are crucial to represent the executive team efficiently.
The ability to adapt to changing priorities and work independently while managing tasks is also highly valued.

Description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities

Cross-Sell Execution: Drive personal loan business primarily through Muthoot Finances existing gold loan and branch customer base.
Team Management: Lead, mentor, coach, and manage a team of Sales Executives (typically handling a team of around 5 to 7 executives) to meet monthly login and disbursement targets.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify eligible prospects via branch walk-ins, customer databases, tele-calling, referrals, and local field activities.
Sales Funnel Tracking: Monitor daily metrics including calls, logins, conversion ratios, and final loan disbursements.
Cross-Department Coordination: Work closely with Credit, Operations, Field Investigation (FI), and Branch Managers to ensure smooth and timely file processing.
Customer Service & Escalations: Handle customer queries, resolve service escalations, and maintain strict adherence to company policies and regulatory compliance.
Performance Review: Conduct regular branch visits, review team/cluster metrics, and design action plans for underperforming areas.
AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.
The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. The Muthoot Groups story from humble beginnings to its ever growing stature is built on the firm foundation of 7 fundamental principles of Ethics, Values Reliability, Dependability, Trustworthiness, Integrity and Goodwill. The Group practices an equal opportunity policy wherein people from all sections of the society have equal opportunities to join and be part of the 40,000+ strong Muthoot Family.
Muthoot Finance, the flagship company of The Muthoot Group has been rated India’s No. 1 Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for five consecutive years, from 2016 to 2020 by TRA’s Brand Trust Report. It has been certified as ‘Great Place To Work, 2021-22’ and has been recognised and featured as one of the Top 30 Best Places to Work at in India by Skill Tree Global Knowledge Consortium in the Workplace Excellence Show on CNBC TV-18 in 2016.
The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Job Description -
Job Title- Area Sales Head - CONSUMER LIGHTING
Level-Assistant Manager
Location-Ludhiana
Reporting To-Product head
Supervising-Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Consumer Lighting division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

3-6 Years
Salary

Best in industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified™ Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
For more details, visit www.havells.com
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
The Marketing Assistant Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Manager of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role assists with building deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Assists with the execution of the annual marketing plan to budget .
- Provides support to Operations, Food Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Works with advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Assists with the management of FB media schedules email marketing and display advertising.
;
- Stays informed about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Helps verify that all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Supports facilitation ofsocial media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Assists with promotions campaign in FB, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Participates in the development of comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency;
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Assists with writing and distribution of all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Supports execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Helps manage external vendors and media agencies; Assists with review of PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for FB advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Assists with photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
May serve as a point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Assists with coordination and execution of Hotel and FB printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Supports the production of all property, FB display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Assists with the execution of FB direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists in the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint FB promotions.
- Works with the Manager of Marketing and Communication to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
-
- Provides marketing assistance and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
- Performs other reasonable job duties as assigned by manager.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Approvals
Preparing and getting approved the investments identified by the investment team.
Ensuring proper storage of approval notes for timely future retrieval and reference.
Implementation
Post all requisite approvals ensuring timely execution of investment decision.
This involves documentation, funding and end to end ownership of the transaction.
Processing & Tracking Redemption Transactions
To submit the required transaction documents to counter partys back office, accounts and to inform Short Term Finance about the inflow.
To keep a track of maturities and other inflows from investments. To ensure the money received shall not remain idle and be invested on the same date.
Recording of Investment & Redemption
Recording all the details of the investment/redemption like maturity date, return etc in excel sheet after an investment/redemption has been made.
Miscellaneous Activities
Preparing various reports/data in case of all companies like
Interest Income budget.
Ratification Data for Board Meetings.
RBI returns in case of NBFCs Monthly & Quarterly
Annual Review of Investments
Monthly Reports
Other need based reports as required by management.
Filing all the signed agreements relating to investment in a properly maintained file for any future reference and record.
Disseminating the required information to the concerned stakeholders
Internal/External Audit
Preparing required data and providing the same to the internal as well as external auditors in stipulated time so that audit can be conducted smoothly.
Coordination with Back Office and accounts section
Coordinating with investment back office and accounts section for smooth flow of information.

Description:
Job Summary
An Operations Manager in an education or EdTech company oversees daily campus or digital workflows, faculty scheduling, student onboarding, and compliance.
In Chandigarh and India, local openings range from schools and study consultancies like Silver Fern Education Consultants to growing EdTech platforms.
Core Responsibilities
Academic Coordination: Manage class timetables, faculty assignments, and exam workflows.
Student & Parent Support: Oversee student onboarding, fee tracking, and inquiry handling.
Facility & Resource Management: Monitor campus upkeep, safety, and infrastructure (if on-site) or LMS tools (if online).
Cross-Functional Link: Connect sales, marketing, and academic teams to hit growth and retention goals.
Compliance & Reporting: Maintain student records and ensure adherence to institutional or local rules.
Key Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education Management, or Human Resources (Master's is a plus).
Experience: 5 years of background in Education administration, coaching centers, or EdTech operations.
Tech Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
Soft Skills: Strong time management, team leadership, and parent/student communication.

Description:
We are Hiring for Store Manager (for HealthKart Retail Store)

Designation- Store Manager

Location- Ludhiana & Khanna

Job Specification:-

Energetic and ready to take challenges.
Demonstrable leadership abilities
Age between 18 - 35
Exp - 2 to 6 years
Industry: Health Supplement & sports nutrition preferable, Retail Store
Having sound knowledge of Nutrition and supplements, retail sales
Should have good communication skills
Marketing activities need to be done (LMS)
Gym visits to increase the sale of store and awareness
Excellent Selling Skills

Job Description:-

Overall operational responsibility of HealthKart store.
Taking care of customer service
Creating new customer database to increase the sale and share daily customer
footfall report to your reporting manager.
Stock/Inventory management - inward & outward
Participate and conduct BTL & Local Store Marking activities to increase Sales of
the Store i.e. Gym visit, product sampling in the different kinds of events.
Handling store - Opening & closing of the store
Cash management and daily banking with banking partner without any error.
Raising customers Invoice
Following store aesthetics
Strong in operations & eye for detail.
Strong in maintaining KPIs of the store.
Promoting of products and services of the organization.
Prepare and share Daily Sales MIS of the store.

Interested candidate can share resume at akshat.chauhan@brightlifecare.com or Call/WhatsApp- 9650023605
AboutCompany: HealthKart is India's leading nutrition and supplement platform. Description:
SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Job Description -
Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan)
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard ECD (Water Heater & Fan) division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

5-8 Years
Salary

Best In industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Job Description -

Job Title - Area Sales Head-Standard Building (Wire, Switch & BCP )
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Amritsar Br.
Reporting To Product head
Supervising- Individual Contributor

Job responsibilities
1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Standard Building (Wire, Switch & BCP )division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.

Education
Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience
5-8 Years
Salary
Best In industry
Personal Attributes
Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age
Maximum 32 Years
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Role and Responsibility:
Note: Two wheeler and DL is Mandatory for this role.


To monitor closely the HL data and cross sell insurance (HDFC Life and Non
Life), fixed deposits and other products as introduced by the company to
home loan customers of HDFC Sales
To source open market business too and achieve the targets assigned
To be completely aware of the products being offered by the company and
understand competition offering and handle customer objections
To ensure proper customer profiling on each call / customer visit, to identify
and understand his/her needs and accordingly recommend investment and
Insurance options
Relationship building with the Home Loan Executives to which he is mapped
and to ensure joint calls with the HLE to ensure maximum attachments of the
files being disbursed
To build a relationship with the customer so that he/ she is able to cross sell
other product offering basis the need of the customer, thereby managing the
entire account of customer. FSA to ensure to source customers family details,
other general insurance details, other loan details etc
To be in sync and work together with the partner representatives
Understanding the joint ownership of the customer at the time of servicing
etc
To ensure timely renewal of the business sourced
To ensure appropriate processes defined are being followed and undergo the
training and certification for being compliant towards selling of various
products (insurance, mutual funds etc)
To always be well groomed and his sales kit should be organized and
complete
To maintain company first attitude and be respectful in attitude towards
other fellow colleagues, seniors , partners etc

Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
