Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Ability to work independently without supervision.
Outstanding negotiation and communication skills, with sharp attention to detail.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment

Description:
Role & responsibilities
SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.
Assess automated application controls, configurable controls, interfaces, key reports, data dependencies, exception handling, and manual controls reliant on SAP-generated information.
Challenge design deviations, identify control gaps, evaluate business and financial reporting impact, and recommend remediation or compensating controls with clear ownership and deadlines.
Oversee RICEFW/WRICEF reviews, functional specifications, custom enhancements, defect and change assessments, testing evidence, and control impacts throughout project releases and hypercare.
Technology risk, security and regulatory compliance
Direct SAP ITGC reviews covering user access, privileged access, authentication, change management, operations, logging, and configuration governance, aligned to relevant SOX and audit requirements.
Guide SAP GRC and Pathlock-related reviews, including access request approvals, periodic access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), sensitive access, ruleset governance and mitigating controls.
Provide implementation assurance through design checkpoints, go-live readiness reviews, risk escalation, remediation validation, and coordination with internal and external assurance teams.
Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.

Track SLA performance, KPIs, risks and mitigation plans.
Support transition, knowledge transfer and service stabilization.

Strong enterprise routing and switching expertise
Advanced Layer 2/Layer 3 troubleshooting
WAN, MPLS, VPN and SD-WAN
Enterprise firewall and security policy concepts
Cisco wireless
F5/load-balancing knowledge
QoS, traffic analysis and performance optimization
Major incident management and RCA
ITIL Incident, Problem and Change Management
Network monitoring, reporting and ITSM tools

Preferred: CCNP Enterprise/CCNP Security, SD-WAN expertise, firewall certification, F5 exposure, ITIL Foundation

What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

- Demonstrating proficiency in BillingPlatform scripting and configuration
- Utilizing experience with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs
- Developing integrations with enterprise applications like Salesforce and Oracle ERP
- Excelling in stakeholder management and communication skills
- Possessing hands-on experience with Zuora Billing and SAP BRIM applications

Description:
SRE with ITIL & Incident
Onsite (3 days from client location)
Hyderabad/Bangalore
Exp: 8+years of exp
The Sr. Principal Infrastructure Engineer will play a critical role in the production support of our Internet Banking Application. This position involves overseeing release deployments, middleware operations, and problem management. The ideal candidate will ensure optimal performance and reliability of our banking applications through effective monitoring, observability, and incident management.
Responsibilities:
Provide production support for the Internet Banking Application, ensuring high availability and performance.
Manage release deployments and middleware operations, coordinating with development and operations teams.
Implement and maintain monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, and Grafana to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Lead incident management processes, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and minimizing impact on business operations.
Support OS patching activities to maintain system security and compliance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance application performance and reliability.
Document processes, procedures, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing and training purposes.
Participate in on-call support rotation as required.
Mandatory Skills:
Proven expertise in application production support, particularly in banking or financial services.
Strong knowledge of middleware technologies and operations.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, and Grafana.
Solid understanding of incident management processes and best practices.
Familiarity with OS patching and system maintenance procedures.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud-based infrastructure and operations.
Knowledge of scripting languages for automation (e.g., Python, Bash).
Understanding of ITIL framework and its application in production support.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in infrastructure management or cloud technologies are a plus.
AboutCompany:
Mphasis is a leading IT solutions provider, offering Applications, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Infrastructure services globally through a combination of technology knowhow, domain and process expertise.

Mphasis Limited (then, Mphasis BFL Limited) was formed in June 2000 after the merger of the US-based IT consulting company Mphasis Corporation (founded in 1998) and the Indian IT services company BFL Software Limited (founded in 1993).

Over the years we have left an indelible impression in the IT solutions domain with an impressive clientele and an extensive global presence. The accolades we have been garnering can be attributed to our undeterred focus in delivering quality solutions across verticals that meet the challenging requirements of our esteemed customers. Our integrated solutions offering is aimed at creating value for our customers, helping them in improving their business processes with minimum hassles and capital outlays. The perfect blend of technical excellence, business performance monitoring, business intelligence and customer experience management is what makes us endearing to our clients.

Description:
Position- Territory Manager
Location- Bangalore & Hyderabad

Role Summary
The Territory Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned territory by developing relationships with doctors and clients, generating prescriptions, achieving monthly sales targets, supporting branch growth initiatives, and ensuring timely collections.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales
Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets for the assigned territory.
Generate business through regular engagement with doctors and healthcare professionals.
Develop and maintain relationships with clients and referral partners.
Identify and develop new infrastructure and business opportunities within the territory.
Execute market development and brand-building initiatives.
Doctor & Client Engagement
Conduct approximately 8-10 doctor visits daily.
Conduct approximately 4 client visits daily.
Generate prescriptions and referrals through continuous relationship management.
Maintain strong customer engagement to improve business volumes.
Collection & Territory Management
Monitor collections and outstanding payments.
Ensure timely recovery of dues from clients.
Maintain market intelligence and competitive awareness.
Provide support to existing branches through local marketing activities.
Marketing Activities
Plan and execute BTL (Below-The-Line) marketing activities.
Organize 4-5 BTL camps every month to generate leads and business opportunities.
Support promotional campaigns and local brand visibility initiatives.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly revenue targets.
8-10 doctor visits per day.
4 client visits per day.
New business development within the territory.
Successful execution of 4-5 BTL camps per month.
Collection efficiency and reduction of outstanding payments.
Candidate Profile
Education
Graduate in Science, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or related discipline.
MBA preferred.
Experience
0-2 years of experience in sales, healthcare, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or related industries.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Sales and negotiation capabilities.
Market awareness and territory management skills.
Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders.
Good problem-solving and customer management skills.
Mandatory Requirements
Two-wheeler with valid driving license.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. As an Experienced Associate in OneStream Implementation for Finance Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their financial performance and achieve their strategic goals. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will specialize in financial operations, focusing on enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of financial processes. Your work will involve assessing client needs, developing tailored financial solutions, and providing guidance on financial systems implementation and process automation.
As an Associate, you will contribute to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge. You will be expected to adapt to diverse client challenges, take ownership of your work, and consistently deliver quality results. This role offers the chance to build meaningful client connections and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge and understanding of firm services.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for streamlining financial operations, enhancing controls, and reducing costs for clients. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply professional standards, uphold the firm's code of conduct, and develop commercial awareness. This position is ideal for those driven by curiosity and eager to contribute to a dynamic team environment.

- Analyzing client financial needs to develop tailored solutions that optimize performance
- Implementing financial systems and process automation to streamline operations and enhance controls
- Conducting financial statement analysis and preparation to support strategic decision-making
- Reviewing and managing financial reporting to validate accuracy and compliance
- Applying accounting practices and budgetary management to improve cost efficiency
- Collaborating with teams to provide guidance on financial strategy and internal controls
- Utilizing financial forecasting techniques to anticipate and address potential challenges
- Gathering and interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for clients
- Building commercial awareness and understanding of business operations to drive value
- Adapting to diverse client environments and contributing to team success through reliable support
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating proficiency in Accounting Practices and Financial Management
- Utilizing Financial Forecasting and Financial Strategy skills
- Excelling in Financial Reporting and Financial Statement Analysis
- Adapting to diverse client needs in Finance Operations
- Building commercial awareness in fast-paced environments
- Engaging in continuous learning and development
- Applying analytical skills to discern patterns and insights

Description:
Job DescriptionPosition Requirements:


Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members to design and deliver efficient Financial Close, Consolidation and/or FP&A processes. You will lead key aspects of OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, build, testing, training, change management, go-live and post-go-live support. This position may require you to work directly with clients from an offshore location and at client sites.


Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.
•  Experience implementing planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial close, consolidation and management reporting solutions.
•  Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.
•  For consolidation-focused candidates, good understanding of intercompany eliminations, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting, currency translation and group reporting.
•  For FP&A-focused candidates, good understanding of integrated planning, driver-based forecasting, allocations, scenario modelling and management reporting.
•  Experience developing Cube Views, dashboards, reports and Excel Add-In solutions, and using/configuring relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Good understanding of data integration, data validation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
•  Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.


Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
•  8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.
•  Minimum 6 years of hands-on OneStream experience, with at least two end-to-end implementation projects.
•  Strong functional expertise in FP&A or Financial Close and Consolidation; experience across at least one or both areas is preferred.
•  Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable OneStream solutions.
•  Experience designing and configuring metadata, workflows, security, business rules, integrations, reports and dashboards, including relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Ability to identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend standardized, automated and scalable solutions.
•  Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, cutover, deployment and hypercare activities.
•  Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate activities across business, functional, technical and integration teams.
•  Experience managing project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication.
•  Ability to lead teams involving multiple territories in Onshore-Offshore Model
•  Demonstrated people-management skills, including leading and mentoring team members, allocating work effectively, providing regular coaching and performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
•  Ability to review solution designs and project deliverables for quality, consistency and alignment with OneStream best practices.
•  Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
•  Experience leading and mentoring project team members, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and documentation skills.
•  OneStream certification and prior consulting experience are preferred.
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Manager in OneStream Implementation for Finance Solutions, you will lead the design and delivery of efficient financial processes, focusing on Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to enhance financial operations, streamline processes, and implement solutions that improve decision-making and financial performance for our clients.

As a Manager, you will guide and develop teams, manage client accounts, and drive strategic planning. You will be responsible for mentoring junior staff, confirming project success, and maintaining standards. Your role will involve identifying opportunities, embracing technology, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with both PwC and client teams to implement OneStream solutions, manage project deliverables, and provide guidance on financial systems and process automation.

Responsibilities

- Leading the design and delivery of efficient Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A processes using OneStream
- Managing end-to-end OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, and testing
- Guiding teams in change management, training, and post-go-live support for OneStream solutions
- Coordinating with client stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable OneStream solutions
- Overseeing the development of Cube Views, dashboards, reports, and Excel Add-In solutions
- Implementing process improvements and recommending automated solutions to enhance financial operations
- Managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and data validation activities
- Leading multiple workstreams and coordinating activities across business, functional, and technical teams
- Providing mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment
- Reviewing solution designs and project deliverables for quality and alignment with OneStream standards
- Supporting business users during planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles based on area of expertise
- Utilizing financial data mining and modeling skills to enhance decision-making and financial strategy development

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Possessing OneStream certification
- Demonstrating prior consulting experience
- Excelling in financial data mining and analysis
- Utilizing advanced financial modeling techniques
- Developing comprehensive financial forecasting strategies
- Managing complex financial reporting processes
- Leading cross-functional teams in finance operations

Implement AI-assisted content and asset workflows using AEM generative capabilities, Adobe Firefly/Adobe Express, and AI-powered asset tagging and enrichment.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, release support, production stabilization, and technical documentation.

You will be accountable for delivering projects successfully, maintaining standards, and inspiring your team to achieve quality outcomes. By embracing technology and innovation, you will contribute to the firm's success and uphold its values and purpose. This position offers a unique opportunity to develop your business acumen and build trusted relationships with clients, all while navigating the dynamic landscape of SAP technology.
Responsibilities
- Leading SAP technology consulting projects, focusing on SAP CPI and PIPO solutions
- Managing client engagements to deliver process quality and support business transformation initiatives
- Guiding teams in the strategic planning and execution of SAP-based solutions
- Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data-driven decision-making processes

- Coaching team members to foster professional growth and development

What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
- Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
- Embracing change and fostering innovation in client engagements
- Building trusted relationships through effective communication and teamwork

Description:
Job Summary
Position Senior
EY's GDS Tax Technology teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Tax practice, you'll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding ERP, database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking a Tax Senior to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the solution design and development of Tax tools and technology solutions.
Be subject matter expert to program/project teams in the plan, design, and delivery of technical solutions.
Ability to effectively communicate with other senior leaders of IT on program strategies and plans and negotiate quality solutions.
Qualifications & Experience Required
Bachelors / Masters degree in Software Engineering / Information Technology / MBA / MCA / CA/ CWA.
Relavent 2-8 years of experience in SAP S/4 Hana Project Implementation with SAP FI / DRC. Overall experience not more than 10 years.
SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (previously known as Advance Compliance Reporting)
Minimum 1 End to End Implementation in SAP DRC.
Methodology, Integration & Migration experience in SAP overall.
Sound knowledge in Taxation Direct and Indirect Tax.
Tax integration is an added advantage.
SAP E-invoicing executions and Country specific reporting.
Sound knowledge in Manage Document and Reporting Compliance process.
Knowledge of Scrum and working experience will be an advantage.
Roles & Responsibilities of day-to-day activities of an SAP DRC Consultant:
Expertise in Basic configuration of SAP S/4 HANA in FI
General Ledger Accounting, Taxation.
Invoice creation via electronic documentation.
Knowledge in Electronic invoice Documentation, Data Preparation and Submission.
Reconciliation & Statutory Reporting of E-Invoicing.
Annual & Periodic Reporting of E-Document for various Statutory Reporting.
Correction processing of statutory reporting.
Knowledge on Intrastat Reporting, Withholding Tax & EC Sales list.
Sound Knowledge of Workflow.
Sound knowledge of DRC on Cloud and integration.

Location - Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500081

Description:
Role / Job Title - EPM- FCCS ARCS Manager
Experience: 10 - 16 years
Key Skills : Oracle EPM, FCCS, ARCS, HFM, EPM cloud
Project type : Support and Enhancement Project
Work Location :Bangalore, Hyderabad,Pune, Gurugram

Role & responsibilities
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You'll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference every day.
As an EPM - FCCS ARCS - Manager - Consult, you will play a pivotal role in guiding clients through the complexities of Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to deliver impactful business application consulting services, focusing on Oracle solutions. This role involves direct client support, where you will be instrumental in driving successful outcomes and fostering strong client relationships.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to work with a dynamic team, driving innovation and excellence in Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions.
Responsibilities
- Leading Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) consulting projects, focusing on FCCS and ARCS solutions
- Managing client relationships and expectations to deliver successful outcomes
- Guiding teams in the development and implementation of business process analysis and optimization models
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) to enhance data-driven decision-making
- Overseeing the creation and management of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes
- Conducting performance assessments and developing performance management strategies
- Implementing cost management and profitability management techniques to improve financial outcomes
- Facilitating enterprise integration and resource allocation to support organizational effectiveness
- Providing coaching and feedback to team members to foster professional growth and development
- Analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive strategic data analysis and business insights

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations

Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across ClaimCenter and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across ClaimCenter and claims Integration modules.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Develop and support ClaimCenter solutions including claim workflows, rules, plugins, batch processes, web services, and integrations with internal and external systems.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.


Your Profile
6+years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications.
Strong experience in Guidewire module: ClaimCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across Claims and integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with ClaimCenter,comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence. [Job Descri...C CC Integ | Word]
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in ClaimCenter is preferred.


What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire InsuranceSuite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.


We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

AZURE DevOps Engineer
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled AZURE DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AZURE). The ideal candidate will have experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and containerization technologies to support modern application development and deployment practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AZURE.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools.
Build, automate, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or DEVOPS CodePipeline.
Manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS/ECS.
Monitor system performance, availability, and security using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus.

Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Recruiting.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Recruiting areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. Title: Workday Financials Consultant
Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Chennai / Pune / Gurgaon
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Workday Financials Consultant with strong functional expertise in Workday Finance modules and a proven track record of delivering implementation, support, and enhancement projects. The ideal candidate should possess excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to work closely with global clients to deliver business solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Configure and support Workday Financials modules based on business requirements.
Participate in Workday implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements.
Conduct requirement gathering, solution design, testing, and deployment activities.
Work closely with finance stakeholders to optimize business processes.
Provide functional guidance and best practices across Workday Finance modules.
Support defect resolution, issue analysis, and system enhancements.
Collaborate with technical teams on integrations, reporting, and data migration activities.
Required Skills
5-10 years of overall IT/ERP consulting experience.
2-3+ years of hands-on experience in Workday Financials.
Strong expertise in one or more of the following modules:
Financial Accounting
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Procurement
Expenses
Banking & Cash Management
Fixed Assets
Experience in Workday implementation, support, or enhancement projects.
Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Workday Financials Certification preferred.
Experience working with global customers.
Exposure to Workday Integrations, Reporting, or Prism Analytics.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Position Title: Paramedics/Senior Paramedics
Reports To: Regional Paramedic/Medical Officer I/Medical Officer II Location: Airport Locations

Job Purpose
To provide timely and effective medical support to employees through medical assessments, emergency care, and regulatory health compliance activities, while ensuring adherence to DGCA and company requirements. The role is responsible for maintaining operational readiness of the Medical Centre, conducting Breath Alcohol Testing (BAT), supporting audits and investigations, managing medical inventories, and contributing to a safe, compliant, and healthy workplace environment.

Key Accountabilities

Assist in dealing with the casualties of the accidents/medical incidents in the Airport areas for employees of IndiGo, if needed as a paramedic and administer first aid.
Coordinate with emergency services if necessary.
Assist and submit themselves to DGCA/internal audits and investigations, if required.
Maintaining administrative requirements of medical room like monthly stock taking for PFMC related stationery/eqpt, medicine stock, stationery requirements and initiate process for purchase as and when necessary, etc.

• GNM/B.Sc Nursing
• Valid Nursing Registration

• First aid basics
• Basic computer knowledge

Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, or Hyderabad.
Word Mode: 2 Days weekly WFO

Code: 108260-42
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript.
Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages.
Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable.
Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions.
Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic.
Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups.
Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic.
Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation.
Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture.
Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows.
Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data.
Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support.
Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations.
Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including:
Personalization
Conditional logic
Lookup functions
Data Extension reads and updates
Subscriber and contact attributes
String, date, and formatting functions

Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management.
Hands-on experience with:
Content Builder
Email Studio
Journey Builder
Automation Studio
Contact Builder
Data Extensions
Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of responsive email and web development.

Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect.

Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.

Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions.
Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications.

Location - Bangalore / Mumbai / Nagpur / Kolhapur / Sambhajinagar / Amaravati / Hyderabad / Warangal / Vijayawada / Vizag / Amaravati (AP) / Kalaburagi / Mysore / Tumkur / Gadag / Hassan / Cuddalore / Villupuram

Role Overview-
As a Corporate Linkages Professional, you will serve as the bridge between trained students and potential employers. You will be responsible for developing and managing corporate partnerships,
identifying employment opportunities, facilitating placement activities, and supporting students throughout their career journey.

The role requires strong relationship-building skills, an understanding of evolving industry hiring trends, and the ability to work closely with students, training teams, educational institutions, and employers
to achieve placement outcomes.
Your primary objective will be to maximize student placements and contribute to the overall employability success of the programs.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Corporate Engagement & Partnerships

Identify, map, and connect with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and industry leaders across sectors.
Build and maintain strong relationships with employers to generate placement opportunities for trained students.
Understand industry hiring requirements and workforce trends.
Develop and manage a robust employer network to support ongoing placement activities.
Represent TNSIF at industry events, networking forums, and employer engagement initiatives.

2. Student Placement & Career Support

Understand students' career aspirations, skills, and employment preferences.
Identify suitable job opportunities through corporate partnerships, professional networks, job portals, and recruitment platforms.
Conduct placement readiness sessions, career counselling, and employability guidance.
Support students in resume building, interview preparation, and professional communication.

3. Placement Drives & Recruitment Events

Plan and execute placement drives, recruitment campaigns, job fairs, career fests, and hiring events.
Coordinate with employers and educational institutions to ensure smooth execution of recruitment activities.
Facilitate interviews, assessments, group discussions, and selection processes.
Enable meaningful interactions between students and employers to improve placement outcomes.

4. Data Management & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of employer engagement, job opportunities, interviews, selections, and placements.
Update placement dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports regularly.
Analyse placement performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
Contribute towards achieving placement targets and program KPIs, including student joining and retention rates.

5. Post-Placement Support
Provide support to students during onboarding and joining processes.
Conduct regular follow-ups with placed students and employers.
Track student retention and career progression.
Address challenges related to onboarding, workplace adaptation, and job continuity.

6. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with program teams, trainers, colleges, universities, and corporate partners.
Ensure alignment between student skill development initiatives and market requirements.
Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders to drive placement success.


Preferred Skills & Experience-

27 years of experience in Corporate Relations, Placements, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment,
Business Development, Employer Engagement, or Industry Partnerships.
Experience working with educational institutions, skilling programs, employability initiatives, or workforce development programs is preferred.
Exposure to placements across sectors such as IT/ITeS, Manufacturing, Engineering, BFSI, Retail, Logistics, Healthcare, Emerging Technologies, or allied industries.
Strong corporate networking and relationship management skills.
Proven ability to organise placement drives and recruitment events.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; strong data management, reporting, and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently in a dynamic and target-driven environment.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and placement tracking systems.

By connecting capable individuals to transformative opportunities, we have been able to create an enduring impact for them, their families and communities.
More information can be found at www.tnsindiafoundation.org

Responsibilities
A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment
You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs
You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.
You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives
You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!

Develop and maintain data integration workflows using Informatica IDMC.
Design and implement mappings, mapping tasks, task flows, and data pipelines.
Work with Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI) for ETL/ELT development.
Integrate data from databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
Develop data transformations, data quality checks, and validation processes.
Troubleshoot and optimize data integration jobs for performance and reliability.
Monitor scheduled jobs, resolve failures, and support production issues.
Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, and technical teams.
Maintain technical documentation and follow data governance standards.

Mandatory Skills:
Hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC / Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud.
Strong experience in Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI).
Expertise in mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and ETL/ELT processes.
Strong SQL skills and database knowledge.
Experience with data migration, data transformation, and data validation.
Knowledge of REST APIs and cloud-based data integration.
Experience in debugging, performance tuning, and production support.

Description:
Company Profile:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
Job Title: React JS Developer
Position: Senior software engineer
Experience: 6-8 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification:
bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are seeking an experienced Frontend Technical Lead with 6+ years of experience in ReactJS and TypeScript to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable web portal solutions. The role involves frontend architecture, team mentoring, TDD, DevSecOps practices, AWS cloud-native applications, and CI/CD implementation. Strong technical leadership, Agile delivery, and stakeholder management skills are essential.
Responsibilities:
Lead frontend development using ReactJS and TypeScript.
Define frontend architecture, coding standards, and best practices.
Mentor developers and conduct code reviews.
Implement TDD, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices.
Manage CI/CD pipelines and AWS cloud deployments.
Integrate frontend applications with APIs and microservices.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.
Troubleshoot technical issues and ensure quality delivery.
Support infrastructure automation and containerization using Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.
Must have skillset:
ReactJS, TypeScript
Frontend Architecture & Design Patterns
Web Application Development.
REST API Integration
Microservices-based Application Development
AWS (S3, Lambda, CloudFront, API Gateway, DynamoDB, RDS, IAM, KMS)
Experience in CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Bamboo)
Relational & NoSQL Databases
Good to have skillset:
Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS
Terraform / CloudFormation (IaC)
Git/GitHub
Jira
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, youll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. Thats why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT
Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Data and process analysis skills

Prior experience of designing and implementing new controls and processes
Experience in change and transformation programme.
Cross-Finance knowledge and experience.
Knowledge of MREL regulatory reporting an advantage.

Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Transaction Advisory and Strategy (Tech): Lead and support M&A transactions (Carve Outs / Separation / Mergers/ Integrations) with a focus on the technology sector, including IT infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, cloud computing, SaaS, AI, and emerging tech trends. Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.
