Description:
Key responsibilities are assigned based on an evaluation of the candidates professional qualification, relevant SPA and Disputes experience, analytical skills, and a demonstrated working knowledge of transaction value drivers and post-deal issues. As a Senior Associate in the SPA & Disputes team, you will work on EV to Equity bridge analysis, post-deal mechanisms and disputes matters, while collaborating with PwC UK teams on project deliverables. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.
Preferred Qualifications Strong interest in mergers and acquisitions, with the ability to understand key value drivers in transactions; Good knowledge of accounting fundamentals, price adjustment mechanics (e.g. net debt, working capital), and valuation principles; Familiarity with valuation methods and transaction mechanisms such as completion accounts and locked box structures; Demonstrated ability to analyse complex financial data and legal documents with precision; Proven track record of independently managing deliverables and maintaining high quality under tight deadlines; Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Self-motivated, with a strong commitment to personal growth and continuous learning; and Adaptable and eager to develop new skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Basic Qualifications Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Certifications requirement: CA/MBA; Good accounting and financial concepts; High level of attention to detail; 2-5 years experience in analysing financial accounting information (for example in audit or FDD); and Awareness of business valuations concepts (Enterprise Value vs. Equity Value) and transaction mechanisms (completion accounts vs. locked box).

CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation.
Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year.

Demonstrating strong finance process knowledge and understanding to work with client process owners across accounting, management and reporting, taxation, etc. Assisting clients in developing and building the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practices deep industry, functional and business process acumen to leverage our assets and capabilities for greatest strategic impact. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate and implement programs. Assisting leadership teams in developing offerings and assets

Description:
Role overview: Strategy Consulting - Corporate Deals Technology
The Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team partners with global corporate clients to shape technology strategy that enables business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our thought leadership and extensive expertise in various industries allow us to serve corporate clients with consulting services with a focus on technology components of the value chain to create scalable and profitable businesses.
Corporate Deals Technology (CDT), a key practice of the Strategy platform, works with corporate clients across industries supporting engagements:
Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures by collaborating with C-suite executives
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and evaluate value creation opportunities
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategy with business and operational priorities
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures Core responsibilities as a Manager would entail (but not limited to)
As a Manager, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to
Proactively assist the team across deal spectrum (IT DD, IT integration / separation)
Lead team on project delivery and manage leadership & client conversations
Lead solution design and implementation aspects of the engagement by ensuring high quality within time and budget constraints
Plan and develop integration and separation deliverables, including Day One readiness and execution, business process and systems integration and separation
Develop financial models for IT, including synergy savings, one-time costs, standalone costs and stranded costs
Recommend enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems based on industry leading practices and past experiences

Job Title -

Organizational Analytics-

Custom Analytics - Consultant

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:09 – Consultant

Location:Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore

Must have skills:Data Visualization &

Work Force Analytics

or People Analytics


Good to have skillsStatistical methodologies

Experience:Minimum 4-6 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Master's Full time.

Job

Summary:

Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Organizational Analytics (OA) Consultant in our Talent & Organization (T&O) practice, a typical day might include.

Adopt a data-driven approach to Transformation and Workforce solutions for Global and Local clients.

Engage with clients to understand their challenges, requirements and concerns to determine the best OA solution.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Experience in building data-driven survey-based solutions including frameworks, questionnaires, and action plans.
Linking analytics results with Behavioral Science/ Industrial and Organizational Psychology concepts.
Exposure on Work Force Analytics using basic and advance statistical/ML methodologies in last least 1-2 years.
Good to have practical knowledge in the areas of Natural Language Processing.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets to develop business solutions.
Define data-backed people strategies to support business transformational programs.
Co-create solutions and assist clients in developing action plans.
Support Product Development and own the delivery of new OA products.
Build strong relationships with clients and foster business growth.
Contribute to T&O practice-building efforts such as recruiting, training and attending community events.


 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Skills:

4 to 6 years of experience in business data analysis and people management-related programs (workforce transformation, workforce, and talent strategy, change strategy, stakeholder assessment, change impact analysis, organization design, and business readiness).
Data fluency and working knowledge of statistical methodologies.
Data interpretation with working knowledge of analytic (predictive and prescriptive) models and digital tools.
Fluency in English is required, additional language capabilities are highly advantageous.
Ability to perform in a non-structured and dynamic environment.



Additional Information

:

Natural leader; easily establishes relationships with clients and colleagues.
Team Player; enjoys the intellectual stimulation of collaborating with colleagues around the world.
Determined; appreciates a challenge and overcoming obstacles to achieve results.
Digitally savvy; continuous learner.
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression.
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning.
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do.
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities.

Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Job Description:
TPRM Business Analyst
Key Responsibilities
The role holder is required to perform a range of activities across specific TPRM workstreams, including:
Produce & maintain TPRM process documentation.
Design, implement and capture TPRM controls.
Capture the TPRM Data Dictionary & Data Lineage.
Capture Data Quality controls supporting TPRM processes.
Capture Regulatory Rules, Policies & Interpretations applicable to third-party risk.
Work closely with Process and Control Owners to obtain review and sign-off.
Provide regular updates on work progress to the central TPRM delivery streams and relevant workstreams to ensure delivery to plan.
Support the identification and resolution of process, data and control issues.

Required Qualifications
Experience in Third-Party Risk Management, Operational Risk, Risk & Controls or related functions.
Experience in designing and implementing risk controls and processes, including those supporting SOX and Operational Risk frameworks.
Good relationship management, collaboration and influencing skills.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral.
Confident and experienced in engaging senior stakeholders.
A leader, comfortable taking initiative and driving delivery.
Strong data and process analysis skills.
Experience of resolving issues and problems through a systematic approach.
Experience in change and transformation programmes.
Cross-functional knowledge and experience.
Knowledge of TPRM, outsourcing risk and operational resilience is an advantage.

Job Details
Position Type: Permanent
Experience: 7-10 Years
Notice Period: Immediate
Work Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad / Gurgaon
Work Type: Work From Office (WFO)
Shift: 2:00 PM 11:00 PM
Interview: 2 Rounds Virtual
Laptop: Mandatory for Interview

Role Summary
We are looking for a hands-on SAP ECP / EC Payroll QA Test Analyst to execute testing for US Payroll implementations on the SAP Employee Central Payroll (ECP) platform.
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of US Payroll processing, hands-on experience with EC-to-ECP integration testing, and the ability to accurately execute payroll test scenarios and scripts within a structured testing environment.

Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in the Payroll domain, preferably with SAP HCM Payroll and/or SAP ECP / EC Payroll.
Mandatory US Payroll experience, including:
US tax processing
Wage types
BSI TaxFactory
Garnishments
Retro processing
Year-end processing including W-2
2+ years of hands-on experience in Integration Testing / SIT execution on SAP HCM or ECP programs.
Experience testing payroll interfaces such as ACH/NACHA bank files, GL, time integration, and third-party vendor feeds.

Key Technical Skills
SAP ECP / EC Payroll – payroll schema/PCR familiarity, wage type catalog, payroll control record, and payroll log analysis.
SuccessFactors Employee Central – understanding of EC-to-ECP replication, compensation, organizational and position data flows.
US Payroll – federal, state and local taxes, BSI TaxFactory, garnishments, off-cycle and retro processing, W-2.
Integration testing across:
EC-to-ECP
Payroll-to-GL
Payroll-to-Bank
Time-to-Payroll
Experience with parallel payroll runs and variance comparison between legacy payroll systems and ECP.
Defect management using HP ALM / Quality Center, JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.

Key Responsibilities
Execute test cases and scripts across SIT, parallel testing, UAT and regression cycles.
Execute payroll scenarios covering gross-to-net calculations, federal/state/local tax withholding, garnishments, off-cycle payroll and retro processing.
Perform EC-to-ECP integration testing and validate employee master data, compensation, organization and position data flows.
Test payroll interfaces including ACH/NACHA bank files, GL postings, time & attendance feeds and third-party integrations.
Support payroll parallel runs, perform result comparisons, document variances and assist with root-cause analysis.
Validate US payroll tax scenarios and BSI TaxFactory results.
Execute year-end scenarios including W-2 and W-2c validation, where applicable.
Log and track defects with complete payroll-specific details including wage types, pay periods, employee populations and replication steps.
Review test scripts, identify coverage gaps and provide execution status to the test lead.

Soft Skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in test execution.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify payroll variances.
Clear and structured defect reporting.
Ability to work within defined testing schedules and proactively escalate blockers.

Good to Have
Multi-state US Payroll experience, including state reciprocity and local taxes.
Experience with ADP, Ceridian, or other legacy payroll systems.
Previous consulting / SI delivery project experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile
SAP ECP / EC Payroll + US Payroll + QA Testing + SIT + Integration Testing + Payroll Interfaces + Parallel Run + BSI TaxFactory

Role Summary
Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint
Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations.
Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions.
Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune.
Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues.
2. Infrastructure & Cloud
Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage.
Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure.
Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments.
Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs.
3. Network & Security
Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions.
Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN.
Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies.
Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities.
4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support
Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange.
Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security.
Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support.
Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement.
5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management
Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure.
Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules.
Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery.
Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets.
Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization.
6. IT Billing & Cost Control
Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates.
Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts.
Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services.
Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments.
Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting.
7. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details.
Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements.
Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.
8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations.
Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies.
Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation.
Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation.
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Job Summary
MitKat Advisory is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Analyst who is responsible for managing end-to-end security data collection, governance, integration, and operational analytics across assigned service locations. The position centralizes and validates data streams from physical security systems, dashboards, and logbooks to build real-time automated visualizations, conduct predictive modeling, and track program costs. By identifying trends and operational vulnerabilities, the Data Analyst delivers actionable, data-driven insights to optimize tactical resources, improve response capabilities, and support executive decision-making.


Job Details
Location: Mumbai, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Bangalore, India
Job Type: Full Time


Key Responsibilities
Centralize, clean, and validate data streams at service locations from physical security systems, including Access Control, CCTV, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Incident Management Systems.
Aggregate data from security service provider dashboards, logbooks, registers, and digital feeds.
Conduct operational data collection as required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compile security operational reports.
Establish data hygiene processes to guarantee security data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with corporate privacy standards.
Design, build, and maintain real-time automated operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) deployments, equipment readiness, and incident response times.
Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual security operational reports analyzing security trends, site-level risks, and resource utilization across locations.
Perform variance analysis comparing actual deployments and equipment costs against maximum Statement of Work (Scope of Services) caps and monthly baseline targets.
Analyze physical security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, and asset loss logs to identify emerging security trends and operational vulnerabilities.
Deliver data-driven recommendations for optimal CIRT operator headcount, hardware, and tactical gear allocation across regions.


Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in BI tools (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Desktop Specialist) or data management.


Preferred Attributes
Practical experience in data aggregation, data hygiene, governance, and statistical analysis.
Experience designing and maintaining interactive dashboards using industry-standard visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Hands-on experience performing financial variance analysis, cost tracking, and operational metric modeling.
Experience handling operational data streams, incident log analysis, or physical security metrics
Strong knowledge of data governance principles, data hygiene practices, and corporate privacy compliance standards.
Familiarity with predictive modeling techniques, trend analysis, and pattern identification methodologies.
Understanding of operational performance metrics, resource utilization analysis, and budget variance tracking.
Basic understanding of physical security technology systems (Access Control, CCTV, IDS, and Incident Management Systems).
Data Visualization BI: Advanced proficiency in building real-time dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
Data Cleansing Governance: Capability to integrate, validate, and sanitize disparate physical and digital data logs.
Financial Cost Analytics: Proficiency in performing cost variance analysis against baseline targets and Scope of Services budget caps.
Technical Writing Reporting: Ability to draft clear, error-free operational reports summarizing trends and strategic recommendations.
Analytical Thinking: Translates raw, multi-source data into structured, predictive insights and actionable operational strategies.
Data Integrity Precision: High attention to detail ensuring complete accuracy, hygiene, and confidentiality across all reports and dashboards.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies operational vulnerabilities, process enhancements, and system optimization opportunities.
Stakeholder Alignment: Communicates complex analytics effectively to support operational leaders and vendor management teams.

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Job Description
The Area: The Investment Management group is a global team guided by Morningstars investment principles focused on delivering great long-term investment results to help end-investors reach their financial goals.We use ourexpertisein asset allocation, investmentselectionand portfolio construction to create world-class investment strategiesleveragingthe full resources of Morningstar. The group specializes in multi-asset investing, using building blocks in equities, fixedincomeand alternative investments to construct robust portfolios.Through our investment offerings, we serve financial advisers and institutions, and the investors that they serve. 
Shift: UK Shift
Role Summary: 
TheData Quality Automation Engineer will join theSystematicStrategiesteamin the Research & Investment group. This experienced professional will design and implement automated data quality controls, validation frameworks, reconciliation processes, and monitoring solutions across enterprise-scale data platforms. The ideal candidate combines expertise financial data management and automation engineering, with a passion for building scalable controls that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will 
Design, build, and maintain enterprise-scale automated data quality frameworks like Great Expectations, AWS Glue Data Quality, Amazon Deequ, or similar data validation frameworks 
Experience implementing and maintaining data quality controls by establishing quality metrics for multi-asset class financial datasets. 
Develop automated monitoring controls capable of identifying anomalies, outliers, missing data, stale data, and reconciliation breaks 
Validate investment datasets sourced from multiple external providers including Bloomberg, FactSet, Morningstar, LSEG, and other market data vendors 
Develop automated source-to-target reconciliation frameworks across ingestion, transformation, and reporting layers 
Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to embed data quality controls throughout ETL/ELT pipelines 
Support onboarding and robustness checks for new datasets including validation of data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and fitness for downstream investment and research workflows 
Requirements:
Advanced Python development 
Strong SQL and data analysis skills 
Hands-on experience with PySpark and distributed data processing 
Experience building automated data validation and reconciliation frameworks 
Experience working with large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets in financial domain 
Data profiling, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis experience 
Required Technical Skills
Advanced SQL, Python, and PySpark skills 
Exposure to designing, developing, and maintaining automated data quality frameworks  
Strong expertise in financial data testing, data profiling and root cause analysis  
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and services (AWS preferred) 
Exposure to AI productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot, with responsible validation of AI-generated outputs.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in quantitative, financial, economic, or engineering discipline 
2+ years of experience in Data Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Financial Data Management, or Investment Technology 
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Looking for Immediate Joiners!!!!!!!!

Job Description: Please find the detailed job description attached for your reference.

Working Hours:

• Shift will be in any of United States of America time zones
• Open to work in rotating work week (Mon-Fri, Tue-Sat, Wed-Sun)
Overall, Purpose of Job
• Provide high-quality Tier 2 Customer Support service to Customers with complete focus on 100% issue resolution and 100% customer satisfaction.
• Adhere to Client defined as well as internally defined processes and procedures while handling Inbound calls emails & chats
• Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams

• Work productively whilst maintaining exceptional call/data quality standards in line with targets
• Contribute to the team through open and regular communication with peers / supervisors
• Adhere to all company or departmental policies and procedures (personnel and operational)
• Keep the process repositories like DTPs, Knowledgebase, SharePoint updated with the current process
• Maintain regular and punctual attendance in line with company policies and procedures
• Minimize customer complaints and escalations by providing exceptional service and call control
Knowledge & Skill Requirement
Ability to demonstrate an efficient use of customer service technologies to complete a customer transaction using Ticket Tracking System (Service Now preferred), ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and Internet Explorer
• Good technical aptitude with an ability to learn quickly
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience Profile
Personal Attributes
Able to work on a flexible basis as determined by the business needs
• Ability to work under pressure
• Team worker
• Positive Attitude
• Quick Learner
• Punctual and Disciplined
• Good Communication skills
• Customer Focussed
• Results driven
• High standards of Integrity
• Attention to detail

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Associate Consultant-CHS-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Digital Risk - Gurgaon
CHS :
CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors.
Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. We help clients to capture new sources of profitable growth, rethinking how and where they bring value to consumers, today and into the future. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become.
The Health Sciences Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. To retain relevancy in todays digitally focused, data-infused ecosystem, all participants in the sector must rethink their business practices, including capital strategy, partnering and the creation of patient-centric operating models.
CNS - Risk - Digital Risk :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.


Your key responsibilities
Strong understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC), and IT SOX frameworks for effective risk evaluation. Hands-on experience in conducting IR risk assessments and identifying control gaps across business and technology environments. Working knowledge of ITIL processes and control concepts to assess operational risk and process compliance. Ability to support digital risk engagements through structured testing, documentation, and validation of control effectiveness. Capable of applying general consulting skills to analyze risks, prepare findings, and contribute to control remediation recommendations.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science


Experience
IT audit, IT SOX, ITGC, ITAC


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - DIGITAL RISK - Gurgaon
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future building a better working world for all.
CNS - RISK - Digital RISK
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
The opportunity EYs Software and IT Asset Management (SAM) team is a rapidly growing and high performing team, working with some of the worlds largest companies in a niche sector offering. We have a few work streams, ranging from software license compliance work with major global software vendors, to helping EY clients on matters including improving their processes/governance policies and establishing future focused strategies around software consumption and setting up managed services. Across all the work streams, you will be given a large degree of autonomy and responsibility to lead meetings, identify issues and propose solutions. You will work with, and get to know, senior stakeholders in the software vendors, and at EY clients/vendor customers, up to board level. We provide trusted communications focused on facts and data to management, customers and other stakeholders. Your key responsibilities
Apply advanced technologies to analyse and design end-to-end business processes. Identify inefficiencies using quantitative and qualitative techniques, support large-scale data collection, and implement optimal business processes to mitigate identified risks across various domains (operational, legal, reputational, regulatory, economic, etc.)
Perform risk assessments based on contract terms and conditions
Extract data and perform data analytics to quantify the financial and operational compliance with the contract
Summarization and reporting of complex and disparate datasets via dynamic dashboards using Power BI
Administration and support of Software discovery tools (such as: SCCM, BDNA, Flexera, Service Now)
Assist in Infrastructure upgrades, security compliance and remediation
Effective communication between EY & Clients for a productive collaboration
Working on multiple projects with shifting priorities
Independently capable of seeking information, solving conceptual problems, corralling resources, model project strategies and delivering results in challenging situations
Foster and develop strong networks (local, area, global) with key service line champions in the firm
Work with project managers to ensure that all project deliverables are on time and high quality
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have
A graduate degree or higher
1 - 6 years of SAM or Software License Compliance
A good experience of working with BI Tools (such as Power BI)
A good experience of working with Software Discovery tools (such as Flexera, BDNA, SCCM, Service Now)
Knowledge of Active Directory, virtualization technologies, network topologies, software vendor license agreements and licensing terms
Understanding of IT Processes, IT Infrastructure (applications, databases and operating system) and related technologies i.e. Oracle, Windows, Linux etc.
Outstanding Microsoft Excel skills including the ability to analyse complex and disparate data sets using a combination of pivot tables and functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with good attention to detail
Works well in a diverse team and enjoys a dynamic environment where remote working is required ideally, youll also have
CSAM/ISO 19770/ITAM/BSA SAM qualification preferred
Project Management certification PMP/PRINCE2 (preferred)
IT Vendor Certification e.g. Microsoft Certified Professional
Big 4 experience and training
Qualification
B-Tech
Experience
SAM, HAM, ITAM
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Associate Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Gurgaon
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future building a better working world for all.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
Strong understanding of risk and process controls frameworks with exposure to internal audit and control assessment activities. Ability to support consulting engagements through structured analysis, documentation, and process review. Proficient in drafting audit and risk reports with accuracy, clarity, and attention to detail. Familiarity with client-facing project support, including communication of findings and coordination of audit deliverables. Good knowledge of SQL and data analytics to assist in testing, validation, and risk-related data analysis.
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Business Administration
Experience
Internal Audit (0-2 years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 514,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.

Description:
We are looking for experienced professionals with a background in Client Onboarding, KYC/CDD, Account Maintenance, and Banking Operations. The role involves onboarding clients, maintaining customer profiles, validating documentation, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Perform Client Onboarding, KYC/CDD reviews, and Account Maintenance activities.
Process updates related to authorized signers, authority management, and account servicing.
Review, validate, and verify client documentation and supporting records.
Maintain accurate client information in banking systems.
Ensure adherence to compliance, risk, and operational control requirements.
Investigate exceptions and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
Meet SLA, productivity, quality, and accuracy targets.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders through email and chat support.

Desired Candidate Profile
2+ years of experience in Banking Operations, KYC, Client Onboarding, AML, Account Maintenance, or Financial Services.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and Outlook.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food & Beverage Associate, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.

Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.

Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.

Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
