Description:
Technical Support Engineer Associate
This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Aruba, an HPE Company, is a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernise their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the Intelligent Edge and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us to redefine what is next for you.
What you ll do:
Responsibilities:
Designs portions of engineering solutions utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions based on established engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements
Implements established test plans for existing designs, including validation of mechanical, electrical, software, and other engineering specifications and requirements.
Develops understanding of and relationship with internal and outsourced development partners on engineering design and development.
Participates as a member of project team of other engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for low to moderately- complex products.
What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or other Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
Typically 0-2 years experience.
Knowledge and Skills:
Experience or understanding of appropriate engineering design tools and software packages.
Good analytical and problem solving skills.
Basic understanding of material properties and hardware and electrical component design.
Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
What We Can Offer You:
Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
Lets Stay Connected:
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.
#india #aruba
HPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity/ Veterans/Disabled/LGBT employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, or any other protected category, and all decisions we make are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Our goal is to be one global team that is representative of our customers, in an inclusive environment where we can continue to innovate and grow together. Recruitment Fraud Alert
We have become aware of an increase in fraudulent recruitment activities in which individuals impersonate our company or authorized recruitment agencies to offer fake employment opportunities. These scams may occur through false websites, emails, social media, or chat-based applications and often aim to obtain personal information or money. All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job description Mega walk-in drive only for freshers. Key

Responsibilities:

Content Analysis: Review and categorize high volumes of user reviews to determine sentiment, relevance, and compliance with global policies.
Spam Detection: Identify patterns of "Non-Genuine" content, including bot-generated reviews, promotional spam, and "Blanket Negativity" (e.g., "they are good at nothing") that lacks context.
Nuance Mapping: Distinguish between a "Subjective Opinion" (which stays) and "Harassment or Hate Speech" (which must be removed).
Contextual Auditing: Verify if a review is "Out of Sight/View" due to a technical mapping error or if it is a legitimate complaint about a physical business location.
Data Labeling: Maintain high-precision labeling to help train AI models in recognizing spam patterns across multiple languages and regions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

High Reading Comprehension: Ability to interpret subtext, sarcasm, and cultural nuances in written English (and/or local languages).
Critical Thinking: You must be able to ask, "Does this review actually describe a consumer experience, or is it noise?"
Attention to Detail: Ability to spot repetitive phrasing or "copy-paste" patterns that signal a coordinated spam campaign.
Policy Adherence: Ability to set aside personal bias and follow a strict set of "Source of Truth" guidelines for content removal.
Efficiency: Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with specific daily throughput targets.

Job Description:

Working on the moderation of the listings and making sure > 98% accuracy is maintained
Making sure the listing are completed within the defined SLA/TAT time
Should be able to work independently and understand his/her performance metrics
Track his/her own performance need improvise based on the business requirement
Should be able to manage his / her own performance
Need to be very judgmental in order to make sure that the correct information updated on the map front
Should be focused to achieve 100% user satisfaction and zero client or customer escalations.


Pursuing candidates are not eligible Please carry 1 copy of resume along with original pan card

Description:
Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance

About
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloittes clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.

Work you’ll do
The key job responsibilities will be to:
• Conduct/lead client interviews, communication and follow ups
• Primarily involved in performing SOX, and Internal Audit reviews. Also, apply understanding of controls testing, and perform SSAE18 reviews.
• Perform internal audit assurance activities (internal audits over financial, operational, compliance, and strategic risk areas as well as execution of SOX-related activities and EQARs), consult with engagement leadership and clients on strategic plans and other business matters, and help to anticipate emerging risks for our clients
• Use problem solving and critical thinking skills to quickly identify internal control deficiencies, evaluate their risk implications, and draw the appropriate conclusions to best advise our clients
• Demonstrate ability to research, organize, and analyze data and execute selected tests of internal controls
• Perform business cycle controls and general computer controls review / testing
• Build and nurture positive working relationships with clients, by providing high quality deliverables and communications
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services
• Support client engagements by helping plan the audit approach and scope, preparing the audit program, determining auditing procedures, seeing the audit process through completion, and applying internal audit standards
• Create internal control documentation for the engagement including narratives, process and data flows, and other supporting work papers
• Demonstrate ability to prepare and present concise and easy to understand reporting to the client and other stakeholders
• Demonstrate ability to identify, discuss and agree audit outcomes with stakeholders and work towards finalizing action plan to address the findings/gaps/risks
• Exercise professional skepticism, judgment and adhere to the code of ethics while on engagements
• Identifying and evaluation of complex business risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement along with in depth understanding and knowledge of ERP (Oracle/SAP), COSO and US GAAP to bring greater value to the clients. Further, demonstrating the understanding and applicability of the recent updates from Institute for Internal Auditors (IIA), Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) and American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) guidance
• Continually develop technical and professional skills through continuous learning programs
• Support organization and function initiatives

Location: Hyderabad

Qualification
• Chartered Accountant/MBA in Finance/Relevant certification (e.g. CPA, CIA and CISA)

Required skills
• Experience — Up to 4yrs of relevant work experience
• Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, financial, and IT auditing
• Experience with SOX, Internal Audit, and SSAE18
• Exposure to work across industries - Technology media and telecommunication, Manufacturing/ Consumer, Life Sciences and Health Care, Energy Resources, Financial services (preferred)
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), positive attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile
• Strong analytical, critical thinking/problem-solving skills and executive presence. Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels.
• Willingness to expand skillset and work on other related areas

Preferred skills
• Big 4 experience

Instead of outgrowing the organization, we give you room to grow across service lines, industries and specialties. Variety is just one way we support advancement. The more options you have to choose from the greater flexibility you'll have to extend your career with the Deloitte US Firms. As one of the world's leading professional services firms providing consulting and advisory services through nearly 120,000 people in 150 countries, the Deloitte US Firms deliver deep intellectual capital through highly talented advisory and consulting professionals across all of our service areas. We bring high value solutions that meet our clients' business objectives and increase shareholder value. Description:
Job Summary:
The Applications Engineer is responsible for preparing competitive techno-commercial quotations for intercompany and third-party customers for Projects and MRO business. The role involves reviewing technical requirements, selecting suitable control valves and accessories, coordinating with internal teams and suppliers, and ensuring timely and accurate proposal submission.
Job Responsibilities:
Prepare techno-commercial quotations for standard and special control valves for assigned regions and intercompany requirements.
Review project specifications, valve datasheets, process data, vendor documents, inspection, and testing requirements.
Select suitable valves, actuators, and accessories based on application requirements.
Prepare technical deviations and clarification lists with appropriate justification.
Coordinate with factories, suppliers, legal, operations, and credit analysis teams for quotation support.
Respond to customer technical clarifications and participate in technical discussions when required.
Review purchase orders and contracts to ensure alignment with submitted proposals.
Complete order hand-off documentation and transfer documents to respective manufacturing plants.
Prepare and maintain pre-qualification dossiers and quotation logs.
Meet assigned functional metrics for quotation quality, accuracy, and turnaround time.
Main Objectives:
Deliver accurate, timely, and competitive techno-commercial proposals.
Ensure technical compliance with customer and project requirements.
Support order conversion through effective application engineering and commercial coordination.
Ensure smooth order hand-off from sales to manufacturing plants.
Maintain complete quotation records and support continuous improvement in bid processes.
Job Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering.
1 to 3 years of relevant experience in the valve industry.
Experience in application engineering, control valve selection, actuators, and accessories.
Knowledge of project specifications, process datasheets, inspection, and testing requirements.
Exposure to techno-commercial bidding, proposal preparation, and order hand-off processes.
Commercial knowledge and experience working with international customers will be preferred.
Competencies:
Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
Good technical understanding of control valves and application engineering.
Techno-commercial and business acumen.
Negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple quotations.
Creative, proactive, and energetic approach.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

Description:
Role Summary

The Graduate Engineer Trainee will support the Business Development & Sales team in identifying business opportunities, understanding customer power-generation requirements, preparing techno-commercial proposals, and coordinating the sales process for diesel generator sets and related solutions.

The position is intended for a recent engineering graduate seeking to build a career in technical sales. The trainee will receive practical exposure to diesel engines, alternators, control panels, acoustic enclosures, fuel systems, installation requirements, project coordination, customer relationship management, and commercial negotiations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development

Research potential customers, projects, consultants, contractors, dealers, and channel partners within assigned markets.
Generate and qualify leads through customer visits, telephone calls, email campaigns, referrals, exhibitions, industry directories, and digital platforms.
Identify opportunities in segments such as manufacturing, construction, infrastructure, commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, data centres, telecom, utilities, and institutions.
Assist in developing new markets, customer segments, dealer networks, and strategic accounts.
Monitor market developments, upcoming projects, competitor activity, product positioning, and customer requirements.

2. Technical Sales Support

Understand the customers application, connected electrical load, operating conditions, duty cycle, installation environment, and backup-power requirements.
Support the preliminary selection of suitable diesel generator ratings and configurations under the guidance of senior technical and sales personnel.
Coordinate with engineering, production, sourcing, quality, and service teams to confirm technical feasibility and delivery requirements.
Participate in site visits to collect application details, installation information, and customer requirements.
Assist customers and consultants with technical documentation, product data, drawings, and compliance information.

3. Sales Coordination and Order Processing
Support negotiations relating to price, payment terms, delivery schedule, warranty, and scope of supply.
Prepare order handover documentation after receiving a purchase order.
Coordinate with production, assembly, testing, logistics, finance, installation, and service teams to support order execution.
Assist with invoice coordination, documentation, payment follow-up, and collection of required commercial records.
Support post-delivery coordination, including installation, commissioning, warranty, and service handover.

4. Reporting and Learning
Attend technical and commercial training relating to generator sets, applications, manufacturing processes, quality systems, and selling methods.
Develop a working understanding of the companys products, manufacturing capabilities, assembly processes, testing procedures, and after-sales services.
Follow company policies concerning pricing, discounts, approvals, customer data, quality, safety, and professional conduct.

Educational Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Recent graduates and candidates with up to one year of relevant experience may apply.
Candidates with academic projects, internships, or training related to engines, electrical machines, power systems, manufacturing, energy equipment, or industrial sales will have an advantage.

Description
This role is responsible for evaluating supplier financial claims and providing audit recommendations based on supporting documentation, contractual requirements, purchasing data, and applicable policies.
The analyst will review supplier claim components such as:
Supplier volumes
Invoice prices
Raw-material indices
Part weights and supporting evidence
Tariff-related costs
Costs arising from part or vehicle-program cancellations
The role will also ensure that claim outcomes are appropriately reflected in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
Success in this position requires strong financial and analytical capability along with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Engineering, STA, Product Development, and supplier organizations.


Responsibilities

Supplier Raw-Material Claims Audit
Audit supplier raw-material claims by validating supplier volumes, invoice prices, applicable raw-material indices, part weights, and supporting documentation.
Identify discrepancies between supplier submissions, purchasing information, invoices, indices, and supporting evidence.
Document audit findings and provide financially supported recommendations for claim settlement.
Coordinate with the Supply Chain and Purchasing teams to ensure estimated claims are appropriately captured in relevant forecasting systems before audit.
Partner with the Raw Material Finance team to ensure audit outcomes are incorporated into financial forecasts, budgets, and actual-versus-forecast analysis.


Tariff Claims
Review supplier tariff claims in accordance with applicable trade policies, contractual requirements, and supporting documentation.
Assess the financial validity of claimed tariff costs and provide clear audit recommendations.
Monitor relevant policy changes that could affect supplier tariff claims.


Cancellation Claims
Review supplier claims resulting from part or vehicle-program cancellations, including programs cancelled prior to launch where applicable.
Validate claimed costs against the applicable Supplier Claims Guide, contractual terms, and global terms and conditions.
Review supporting cost documentation and identify unsupported, duplicate, or non-compliant costs.
Provide recommendations based on audit findings and applicable policy.


Forecasting, Budgeting Financial Analysis
Support budgeting and forecasting for supplier claims.
Perform actual-versus-forecast and budget variance analysis.
Support accounting close activities associated with supplier claims where required.
Ensure material audit outcomes and claim developments are appropriately reflected in financial forecasts and reporting.


Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with Product Development Finance, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Engineering, STA, and suppliers to resolve claim-related questions and data discrepancies.
Work with stakeholders to improve process compliance and the quality of claim documentation.
Communicate audit findings clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Build effective working relationships across global and cross-functional teams.


Qualifications

Required
CA (Chartered Accountant) or CMA (Cost and Management Accountant) qualification.
0-8 years of relevant experience, depending on the position grade and level of responsibility.
Knowledge or experience in areas such as:
Financial planning and analysis
Budgeting and forecasting
Actual-versus-budget/forecast variance analysis
Accounting close
Financial or commercial audit
Cost analysis
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas and financial-data analysis.
Ability to prepare clear and effective Microsoft PowerPoint presentations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to challenge discrepancies professionally and drive compliance with established processes and policies.


Preferred
Experience or working knowledge of one or more of the following would be advantageous:
Microsoft Power BI
Alteryx
ERP/financial systems
Supplier cost or commercial analysis
Manufacturing or automotive finance
Raw-material or commodity-cost analysis
Supplier claims auditing

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura
Join Us & Be the Digital Face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers!

Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Job Title: Associate - Channel Sales
Job Responsibilities:
Generate new leads through cold calling, market visits, networking, and referrals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners to understand their requirements and provide suitable solutions.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop sales strategies and achieve business targets.
Identify, approach, and onboard new channel partners to expand the company's market presence within the assigned territory.
Prepare and share accurate sales reports, forecasts, and updates with senior management.

Achieve monthly sales targets and drive business growth in the assigned area.

Requirements:
Minimum 2 years of experience in field sales, channel sales, or business development.
Must own a two-wheeler for market visits.
Valid driving licence is mandatory.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of handling challenges effectively.
Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and travel within the assigned territory.

Description:
We are looking for an Associate Business Head to lead our ed-tech firm's growth and profitability. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business, including sales, marketing, product development, and operations, and driving the P&L of the designated branch.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability for the business.
Build and lead a high-performing team to execute the company's goals and objectives.
Identify new market opportunities and develop plans to expand the company's customer base.
Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the company's products and services.
Manage product development initiatives, including ideation, design, and launch.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of products and services to customers.
Develop and manage the P&L for the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Identify and manage key business risks, including competitive threats, regulatory changes, and market fluctuations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including investors, partners, and customers.
Represent the company at industry events and conferences.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA preferred.
At least 3+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, with a track record of driving business growth and profitability.
Experience in the ed-tech industry is highly preferred.
Strong business acumen and financial management skills, with experience managing P&L for a business unit.
Excellent leadership and management skills, with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to develop and execute complex business plans.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias towards action and a willingness to take risks.

Interested candidates can email a CV at ankita.bhowmick@pw.live or WhatsApp at 8383811921

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.


Required Skills
Academic Counselling
Admission Guidance
Admission Counselling
Student Counselling
Higher Education
College Admissions
University Admissions
Student Support
Educational Consultancy
Client Handling
Communication Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Documentation
Application Processing
Online Research
MS Office
Email Communication
CRM
Follow-Up Management
Record Keeping


Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

About

Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Limited (BCIBL) is an IRDAI-licensed insurance broker and part of the Bajaj Capital Group. Established in insurance broking since 2004, the company offers a wide range of life and general insurance solutions, including health, term life, motor, travel, pet, and commercial insurance. Position title: Sales Executive
Salary: 15k to 22K+ Huge Performance Incentive
Type of Job: Inhouse Sales

Job purpose
To achieve assigned sales targets by identifying potential customers, building strong relationships, and providing multiple financial products. The role involves ensuring customer satisfaction, driving persistency,
client meetings,need analysis,plan preparation,solution providing, collaborating with other teams and adhering to sales process guidelines to contribute to the overall profitability of the venue.

Key responsibilities

Sales & Business Development
Identify and approach prospective clients through direct sales, referrals and leads generated through market survey.
Analyze customer needs and recommend suitable financial products to achieve their financial goals.
Pitch & promote various financial products such as Life Insurance, Health Insurance, Mutual Funds.
Meets or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers to encourage repeat and referral business.
Provide ongoing support and after sales services to ensure customer satisfaction.
Handle customer queries, concerns and complaints promptly and professionally.

Driving Persistency
Ensure timely premium payments and policy renewals by engaging with customers and providing reminders or support.
Proactively address customer queries or concerns to reduce policy lapses.
Coordinate with customers to collect the relevant documents for policy renewals.

Market Intelligence & Product Knowledge
Stay updated on market trends in the insurance and mutual funds industry.
Maintain in depth knowledge of product features, benefits and compliance requirements.
Attend regular training sessions to enhance product knowledge, selling skills and compliance understanding.

Compliance & Documentation
Ensure adherence to regulatory and organizational guidelines during the sales process.
Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, sales transactions and financial advice provided.
Get Certified for required profile

Job Requirements

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in any discipline

Experience: 0-3 years of experience

Functional and Behavioral requirements
Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand financial products and explain them effectively to clients.
Self-motivated with a result-oriented approach.

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager (Field Sales Executive)


Company: Policy Bazaar
Industry: Insurance
Eligibility Criteria:
Must own a Bike and have a valid Driving License.
Proficient in the regional language
Minimum 1 year of experience in field sales.
Immediate joiner will a plus.
Strong communication and networking skills.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet business goals based on
Annualized Premium (ANP) and case count
Customer Acquisition: Generate new leads via natural market, referrals, and the orphan base
Client Meetings: Conduct regular meetings to understand client needs and offer suitable insurance solutions
Need-Based Selling: Ensure appropriate solutions through a structured selling model
Upselling & Cross-Selling: Maximize revenue through existing customer base
Post-Sales Service: Resolve queries and ensure timely policy issuance
Customer Engagement: Maintain regular touchpoints and strong relationships with clients
Collaboration: Coordinate with supervisors to plan and execute business strategies
Sales Forecasting: Design and evaluate innovative sales strategies
Database Management: Maintain and grow your customer database in your designated territory
ISMS Compliance: Follow security protocols to safeguard customer and company data.
Perks and Benefits:
Unlimited Incentives
Travel Allowance
Medical Insurance
Attractive Salary Package
Join Policy Bazaar to grow your career in insurance sales with strong incentives and nationwide opportunities.
Send your CV at priyankaprasad@policybazaar.com or Connect at 9220507161.
AboutCompany:
Mission: Make India's billion-plus households financially safe and secure

Values: Fairness to all our stakeholders

Vision: A healthy and well-protected India

PolicyBazaar.com is India's largest insurance marketplace and a leading fintech player globally. It has backing from a host of investors including the likes of SoftBank, InfoEdge (Naukri.com), Temasek, Tiger global Management, True North, Premji Invest. The portal started in 2008 with a purpose to educate people on insurance products and has had a significant influence on how insurance is bought in India. It has helped in driving penetration of pure life insurance, health insurance, and such products which were barely bought earlier. From receiving traffic of 180,000 visitors in 2008, PolicyBazaar.com has come a long way and today hosts over 100 million visitors yearly, and records 10 transactions on its platform every minute. The company collected Rs 3,500 cr of insurance premium in FY19, and is on track to double this figure in FY20.
PolicyBazaar.com accounts for nearly 25% of India's life cover, and over 7% of Indias retail health business. It accounts for roughly half of all internet based insurance purchase in the country.

Group Companies : Paisabazaar.com, Docprime, QuickFixCars, Policybazaar.ae, Zphin

Job Summary
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.
Eight hours per day

Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features

Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Renewable Energy Expert / Team Leader to support the Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in strengthening renewable energy program monitoring, project management, and capacity-building initiatives. The selected expert will work closely with the State Energy Department, Renewable Energy Development Agency (REDA), and DISCOMs to drive effective implementation and oversight of renewable energy projects.

Location
Raipur, Chhattisgarh/ Agartala, Tripura (Full-time deployment with State Energy Department)

Assignment Duration- 1 year

Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Project Management
Lead and manage the overall delivery of the assignment.
Coordinate project activities, stakeholders, and reporting requirements.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the State Energy Department and associated agencies.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely delivery of outputs and milestones.
Conduct impact assessments and provide strategic recommendations.
Prepare and submit project completion reports.

Renewable Energy Advisory
Lead program monitoring and management activities for renewable energy projects in Chhattisgarh/Tripura
Support State Energy Department, REDA, and DISCOMs in project implementation and performance monitoring.
Identify project risks and recommend mitigation measures.
Facilitate training programs and capacity-building workshops for government officials and utility staff.
Provide technical advisory support related to renewable energy sector initiatives.

Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Master's Degree in Engineering, Management, MBA, or related field preferred.

Experience
Proven experience managing projects of similar scale and complexity.
Familiarity with ADB or other Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) funded projects.
Experience supporting state-owned power utilities, renewable energy agencies, or government energy departments.
Demonstrated involvement in monitoring or managing at least two renewable energy projects.
Minimum 4 years of experience working with renewable energy companies in India.

Skills
Strong stakeholder engagement and project management capabilities.
Understanding of renewable energy policies, utility operations, and sector programs.
Excellent communication and reporting skills.
Proficiency in MS Office Suite.

Language
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Please note that this is fixed term role, contingent upon winning the bid.
