Description:
Contact 639865 2832
URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT & ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3.5 Lakhs - 4 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT & ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

Description:
Job Purpose
1. Drive sales growth of solar products through distributor training and customer engagement.
2. Expand the dealer and distributor network by onboarding high-potential partners from the solar industry and competitors.
3. Build long-term trust with channel partners to ensure Loom Solar remains their first choice for solar solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
Meet retail shops, solar dealers, and distributors daily (minimum 10 visits) to promote Loom Solar products.
Conduct cold calling to prospective solar dealers/customers to generate new business opportunities.
Develop a strong dealer network by generating leads and converting them into active partners.
Negotiate with dealers to position Loom Solar as their preferred brand, ensuring competitive edge over other solar companies.
Prepare and share customized quotations for solar product orders.
Update all visits, leads, and sales data in the company sales application.
Respond to dealer queries promptly to build strong relationships.
Ensure 30 days stock availability with channel partners to support smooth order fulfillment.
Track distributor/dealer stock movement and secondary/tertiary sales of solar products.
Conduct dealer/distributor training sessions and meetings to enhance product knowledge and trust.



Requirements

Qualifications Skills
Any Graduate.
25 years of experience in solar product sales / channel sales / electrical product sales.
Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to meet dealers and distributors.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.



Benefits
Any Graduate.
15 years of experience in solar product sales / channel sales / electrical product sales.
Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to meet dealers and distributors.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Description:
Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.
Assist in maintaining compliance with all pharmaceutical storage and distribution guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
Experience:
Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.
AboutCompany:
LRS services is an integrated and innovative technology firm providing managed IT services, maintenance services, staffing services and hardware support globally. Offering customized service solutions and hardware that help customers to reduce overall costs and minimize risk in all phases of their IT life cycle.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.

Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.
Engage with potential clients to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering guidance and support throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.
Provide accurate and timely information to clients regarding products, services, and pricing.
Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for business growth.
Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Manager / Asst. Manager – Learning & Development
You will design, develop, and deliver technical, process, quality, safety, compliance, and behavioral training programs tailored to plant operations. You will ensure the shop-floor workforce, technicians, engineers, and supervisors possess the necessary competencies to meet safety compliance, production targets, and quality benchmarks.
Key Responsibilities
Training Needs Identification (TNI / TNA):
F Conduct regular skill-gap analyses across shop floors, assembly lines, and technical departments in partnership with Plant Heads and Production Managers.
F Develop and update training modules, SOPs, manuals, presentations, and learning aids.
Technical & Safety Training:
F Design and deliver programs covering Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), machine operations, EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), TPM, 5S, Lean/Six Sigma, and quality management systems.
F Collaborate with Plant Heads, Functional Heads, HR, and Subject Matter Experts to address capability gaps.
Onboarding & Shop-Floor Induction:
F Manage the end-to-end induction and safety orientation for all new plant hires, contract workers, and apprentices.
F Deliver induction and onboarding programs for new manufacturing employees.
Training Calendar & Execution:
F Plan, schedule, and execute the annual plant training calendar, balancing shift rotations and production demands.
F Coordinate and execute the annual manufacturing training calendar across all plant locations.
Competency Mapping:
F Maintain and update skill matrices for machine operators and technical staff to ensure multi-skilling and operational flexibility.
F Support competency mapping, multi-skilling, cross-functional learning, and succession development initiatives.
Vendor & Certification Management:
F Liaise with external technical trainers, equipment manufacturers, and statutory bodies for specialized certifications and regulatory compliance training.
Evaluation & ROI:
F Measure training effectiveness through pre- and post-training assessments, scrap/defect rates, safety incident tracking, and on-the-job performance observations.
F Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, feedback, observations, and on-the-job evaluations.
MIS & Compliance Records:
F Maintain accurate training documentation, audit-ready MIS reports, and statutory training records required for ISO or safety audits.
Others:
F Travel extensively across manufacturing plants to deliver training and monitor implementation.
F Drive a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence across manufacturing operations.

Preferred candidate profile
1. MBA in HR or related discipline with 5-7 years of experience in Learning & Development, Technical Training, or Manufacturing Training within a manufacturing plant, heavy industry, or engineering setup.
2. Certification in Training & Development will be an added advantage.
3. Familiarity with manufacturing methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen), safety standards (OSHA/local statutory safety laws), and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
4. Strong facilitation and presentation skills.
5. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality systems, and safety practices.
6. Training design and content development.
7. Training evaluation and learning analytics.
8. MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
9. Willingness to travel extensively across manufacturing locations & offices (PAN India).
10. Strong communication, cross-functional stakeholder management, presentation abilities, and shop-floor credibility to engage both blue-collar operators and plant leadership.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.




What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire Insurance Suite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.


We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.

Candidates will act as the first point of contact for customers and service users, assisting them through voice calls, chat, email, and other support channels.

- Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.

- Maintain good time management and ensure a positive customer experience.
- Be proactive and demonstrate respect for customers' time.

- Qualification: Any full-time graduate with 15 years of formal education.
- Experience: 15 years, depending on the job level and profile.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Willingness to work in a voice support process and 247 rotational shifts.
- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.
- Candidates must have completed double vaccination, as specified in the JD.

Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - EWM / WM Senior Associate, you will be at the forefront of delivering impactful solutions within our SAP Supply Chain and Operations practice. You will engage with clients directly, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges from strategy to execution. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will utilize a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from industry trends, enhancing client engagements and driving process quality.
As a Senior Associate, you will develop meaningful client connections and anticipate their needs, using critical thinking to navigate complex situations. You will guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages growth and learning. Your role will involve maintaining professional standards and adapting to diverse perspectives, all while building your personal brand and technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team that supports global delivery capabilities, providing cost-effective services that enhance client engagement processes. Your contributions will be pivotal in upholding the firm's code of ethics and business conduct, confirming quality and relevance in all deliverables.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing complex supply chain processes to identify areas for improvement and optimization
- Leading the implementation of SAP Supply Chain Management solutions to enhance operational efficiency
- Coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver client-focused supply chain transformation projects
- Utilizing data modeling and analysis to support demand forecasting and inventory management strategies
- Developing procurement strategies and managing project budgets to achieve cost efficiency
- Overseeing warehouse management system implementations to streamline operations and reduce lead times
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to foster professional growth and development
- Building and maintaining relationships with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions
- Applying critical thinking to solve unstructured problems and drive process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging industry trends and insights to inform strategic planning and decision-making.

Relevant years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in Web Automation Testing.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a differenceevery day.
As an SAP - Syniti - Associate 2, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will help clients optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives. You will be expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to design and implement SAP data management and analytics solutions
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating visualizations and reports using SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence tools
- Collaborating with clients to optimize data management processes and enhance data quality
- Providing training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools
- Integrating data from various sources using SAP Data Integration and SAP Data Intelligence Cloud
- Implementing data quality improvement plans to derive valuable insights from client data
- Supporting data migration efforts with SAP BW/4HANA and SAP BW on HANA Data Modeling and Development
- Collecting and preprocessing complex data sets to discern patterns and inform insights
- Validating data security measures within analytics frameworks to protect client information
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Job Description Summary

About this opportunity :
Join our Team as a Data Lead. You'll work within multi-functional product engineering teams to deliver top-quality data capabilities, demonstrating your engineering expertise and cloud opportunities
What youll be doing:
Implement scalable, resilient, low-latency data systems.
Ensure systems meet performance and reliability standards.
Collaborate with engineering leadership and stakeholders.
Set technical strategy and best practices for data engineering.
Deliver solutions for multiple entities within the group.
Ensure alignment with business needs and cloud opportunities.
Promote secure, high-quality data pipelines.
Implement standards for data integrity and compliance.
Identify and eliminate recurring issues through automation.
Improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Provide guidance and technical leadership.
What youll need:
Extensive industry experience in designing, building and supporting distributed systems and large-scale data processing systems in production with a proven track record.

Best practice coding/scripting experience developed in a commercial/industry setting (Python, SQL, Java, Scala or Go).
Strong working experience with operational data stores, data warehouse, big data technologies and data lakes
Experience in using distributed frameworks (Spark, Flink, Beam, Hadoop)
Good knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes etc) and experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
Strong experience working with (Real Time streaming), such as Kafka technologies.
Clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design, design patterns and core programming concepts.
Good understating of cloud storage, networking, and resource provisioning
And any experience of these would be really useful:
Certification in GCP “Cloud Architect”, “Cloud Developer”, “Professional Data Engineer”
Certification in Apache Kafka (CCDAK)

Description:
As an Oracle Technical - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our business application consulting team, specializing in Oracle technology. You will be responsible for analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to optimize operational efficiency and help clients achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will utilize and manage the Oracle suite of software and technologies, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of Oracle products and solutions.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and management of Oracle software solutions to optimize client operations
- Analyzing client needs and developing tailored Oracle technology strategies to achieve business objectives
- Overseeing the installation, configuration, and administration of Oracle products and solutions
- Guiding teams in the development and support of Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher and Oracle Data Integration to enhance data-driven decision-making
- Driving process improvement and optimization initiatives within client environments
- Coaching and mentoring team members to develop their skills and deliver quality outcomes
- Collaborating with clients to address challenges and provide strategic technology planning
- Embracing change and fostering a culture of innovation and digital tooling within teams
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships to support business transformation efforts
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in technical, integration, database, or related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) domains
- Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher
- Utilizing strategic technology planning to drive business transformation initiatives
- Embracing AI fluency and AI-human collaboration for innovative solutions
- Excelling in process improvement and optimization within Oracle environments
- Leading teams with a focus on coaching and feedback to enhance performance

Description:
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai (as per project requirement)
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days preferred

Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Azure GenAI Developer with strong expertise in Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The candidate should have hands-on experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications using Microsoft Azure AI services.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Build RAG pipelines using Azure AI Search, vector databases, and enterprise data sources.
Develop REST APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Work with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Functions.
Implement prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and model optimization techniques.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications using REST APIs and Azure API Management.
Implement MLOps/LLMOps practices, including deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
Follow best practices for security, responsible AI, version control, and production readiness.

Mandatory Skills:
Python programming
Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering
RAG pipeline development
Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Search and vector databases
FastAPI / Flask / Django and REST API development
Azure Functions and Azure API Management
Git, Docker, and SQL/NoSQL databases

Good to Have:
LLM fine-tuning and model evaluation
MLOps / LLMOps
NLP and machine learning fundamentals
Production monitoring using Azure monitoring tools
Experience with enterprise-scale AI deployments

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with total experience, relevant GenAI experience, current location, notice period, and current CTC/expected CTC.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Position Details
EY's GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Assurance practice, you'll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking Software Engineer to join the GDS Assurance Digital practice in Bangalore, India, to work on various Microsoft technology based projects for customers across the globe.
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree (BE/BTech/MCA & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
Technical skills requirements
BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4.5 to 7 Yrs.
Strong experience in MVC, .Net Core and Entity Framework.
Strong React JS or Angular JS experience.
Solid working knowledge of relational database development: MS SQL/SQL Azure, EF 6, EF Core

Unit testing: NUnit, Moq, jest

Excellent business communication

Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving

Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem-resolution skills

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, its more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the clients toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world''s leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today''s connected landscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:
Project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.
The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape
Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities.
Lead Hybrid Cloud Projects: Guide clients through application modernization and migration initiatives, designing strategies and roadmaps for hybrid environments.
Architect Hybrid Solutions: Develop cloud architectures integrating public cloud services with on-premises and private cloud platforms, using technologies such as OpenShift, Anthos, and VMware.
Application Modernization: Design composable architectures using microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA), and cloud-native technologies across hybrid environments.
Hybrid Cloud Integration: Implement solutions that enable seamless workload portability and management across on-premises, private, and public clouds.
DevOps & Automation: Establish CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Deployment Manager, OpenShift templates), and automated operations across hybrid environments.
Data Integration & Analytics: Architect data platforms that span cloud and on-premises, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and secure data exchange.
Security & Compliance: Design secure hybrid architectures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for identity, access, and data protection.
Client Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor, communicating hybrid cloud architecture, best practices, and transformation strategies to technical and business stakeholders.
Thought Leadership: Develop reusable assets, publish whitepapers, and contribute to the hybrid cloud community.
Business Case & ROI Analysis: Build financial models for cloud adoption, including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI. Advise on cost optimization strategies and AWS pricing models.
Operating Model Design: Design cloud operating models for governance, security, and compliance. Recommend organizational changes for cloud adoption (e.g., Cloud Center of Excellence).
Resilience & DR Strategy: Define RTO/RPO tiers, multi-region patterns, backup/restore policies
Design Architecture Review Board charters, NFR baseline templates



Qualification

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree
MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)
9-13 years of large-scale consulting experience and/or working with hi tech companies leading Projects on Cloud Strategy, Assessment, Cloud architecture, App Modernization, Containers, information security and information management.
Professional Cloud Architect Certification (GCP or AWS)

Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale engagements in application modernization, cloud architecture, and cloud strategy. The ideal candidates will have technical expertise in cloud strategy, assessments, cloud architecture, application modernization, and containers, across all stages of the innovation lifecycle, with a focus on shaping the future in real-time."
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

Key Competencies and Skills:
The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes
Expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, integration, and cloud-native development.
Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift), and event-driven design.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation across hybrid environments
Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POVs

SAP FICO - Senior Consultant

Experience: 3-8 Years
Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore, Trivandrum, Kochi, Coimbatore

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled SAP FICO Senior Consultant with strong experience in SAP Finance and Controlling modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP implementations, client interactions, solution design, testing, and support activities across ECC and/or S/4HANA environments.

Mandatory Skills
3-8 years of hands-on experience in SAP FICO.
Minimum 1 end-to-end SAP implementation experience is mandatory.
Experience in Greenfield and/or Brownfield implementation projects.
Strong expertise in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience in core FICO areas:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Bank Accounting
Cost Centre Accounting
Profit Centre Accounting
Experience in business requirement gathering, configuration, and solution design.
Hands-on experience in preparing Functional Specification Documents (FSDs).
Experience in UAT planning, execution, defect management, and user support.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
Experience supporting Go-Live, Hypercare, and post-production activities.

Responsibilities
Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
Configure and support SAP FICO processes as per business needs.
Conduct Fit-Gap analysis and recommend best practices.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams.
Support integration with other SAP modules.
Lead and assist UAT activities and business user training.
Support deployment, cutover, and Go-Live activities.
Engage directly with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Good to Have
SAP FICO Certification.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation or migration projects.
Exposure to data migration and cutover activities.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Note: Candidates must have experience across at least one full-cycle SAP implementation from requirement gathering/design through Go-Live and Hypercare support.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.
