Description:
The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)

For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).

Result-oriented and highly motivated.

Associate / Sr. Associate (TA Operations)

Position: Associate / Sr. Associate
Department: TA Operations Business
Location: KFintech GIFT City, Gandhinagar
CTC: 2.5 3.5 LPA
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO) Only
Working Days: 5 Days a Week + Alternate Saturdays (2 Saturdays Working per Month)
Joining Preference: Immediate Joiners

About the Role
KFintech is seeking enthusiastic and detail-oriented professionals to join the TA Operations team at GIFT City. The role involves handling investor servicing, transaction processing, operational activities, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and process requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Process investor transactions and Transfer Agency (TA) operational activities.
Verify and maintain investor records, account information, and KYC documentation.
Ensure accurate and timely execution of transactions within defined SLAs.
Handle investor queries and coordinate with internal stakeholders for resolution.
Prepare and maintain MIS reports, operational trackers, and related documentation.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, regulatory guidelines, and operational procedures.
Support process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and service quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and record maintenance activities.

Eligibility Criteria
Education: B.Com, M.Com, BBA, BBM, or any Commerce-related degree. (with minimum of 60% and above)
Experience: 03 years.
Freshers with strong academic credentials are welcome to apply.
Experience in financial services, back-office operations, mutual fund operations, TA operations, or customer servicing will be an added advantage.

Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Basic knowledge of financial services and investor servicing.
Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office applications.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Profile
Commerce background candidates.
Immediate joiners or candidates serving short notice periods.
Candidates with exposure to Mutual Fund Operations, Transfer Agency Operations, Registry Operations, or Financial Services Operations preferred.

Compensation & Benefits
CTC ranging from 2.5 LPA to 3.5 LPA based on qualifications and experience.
Opportunity to build a career in the financial services and investor servicing domain.
Exposure to industry-leading operational processes and regulatory frameworks.

Preference will be given to immediate joiners willing to work from the KFintech GIFT City office on a WFO basis.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.

Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.

C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

7+ years of overall IT/functional experience.
Strong hands-on experience with Workday Adaptive Planning / Adaptive Insights.
Experience in EPM, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
Strong understanding of financial models, planning processes, and reporting.
Experience in designing and configuring Adaptive Planning models.
Experience with reports, dashboards, dimensions, sheets, and versions.
Knowledge of data integration and data management within Adaptive Planning.
Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into Adaptive Planning solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with global teams.

Preferred Skills-

Workday Financials knowledge.
Experience integrating Adaptive Planning with ERP/financial systems.
Knowledge of SQL and ETL/data integration concepts.
Experience working with global Finance/FP&A teams.
Prior experience in Adaptive Planning implementation and support projects.

Candidate Profile-

The ideal candidate is a Workday Adaptive Planning specialist with strong EPM/FP&A domain knowledge and hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, and supporting Adaptive Planning solutions.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job Description (JD)
Job title: Area SM/ASM/Manager Bedding & Rugs Designation: Domestic Sales
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai & Ahmedabad
Experience: 6+ yrs
CTC: 10 LPA

COMPANY BROAD OUTLINE
The Company is one of the worlds largest manufacturers of home fabrics, in the form of curtains and upholstery.

Job Description/Desired Profile:
Drive Sales for the given Business Unit Bedding/ Rugs/ comforters etc.
Visits customers, Dealers, distributors and participates in exhibitions to develop domestic market
Monitors conversion of customer orders to production orders.
Monitors timely execution of production orders & sampling for customers
Increase customer satisfaction through more informed and sophisticated selling.
Ownership of buyer inquiries and issues handled in a timely manner.
Facilitate on and off line marketing vehicles for the given business unit: website, tradeshows, and promotional materials.
Select and offer products leveraging on competitive advantage of each region.
Harmonize production, packing and accounting.
Increase country wide presence of the brand by tapping new opportunities for growth, new customers, new regions, new product ideas, new business development.
Must be responsible and process oriented to ensure timely order execution and the requisite follow-ups thereon.
Innovative and flexible approach of problem solving
Monitors timely payment from customer
Market Survey for develop new quality
Education: Diploma /bachelor’s degree in textiles. MBA would be an add on advantage.
Required Skills :
Marketing expertise in pricing and promotional vehicles (including trade shows).
Proven track record as a team leader running an effective office from operations to motivated support staff.
Excellent communication and partnership building skills; ability to instill confidence in team and partners.
Finance and accounting management expertise.
Logistics, distribution, and consolidation expertise
A candidate having experience from Textile industry would be preferred
Candidate should have minimum 10 years of experience
Should have aggressive marketing skills.
Should have good command over English both verbal and written.
Should be analytic and critical thinker. Should be a go getter

Description:
Job Description – Channel Sales Executive (IT Hardware)

Company: Aadinath Peripherals & Consumables  
Head Office: Mumbai, Maharashtra  
Job Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Nagpur, Ahmedabad, Rajasthan, Bhopal & Mumbai  
Experience:2–8 Years (Preferred)  
Department: Sales & Business Development  
Job Type: Full-Time | Field Sales

Job Summary
We are looking for motivated Channel Sales Executives to expand our dealer and reseller network across multiple locations in India. Candidates will be responsible for developing channel partners, generating sales of IT hardware products, building dealer relationships, and achieving sales targets in their assigned territories.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and onboard new IT dealers, resellers, and channel partners.
- Generate sales orders for laptops, desktops, printers, servers, networking products, and computer peripherals.
- Develop and maintain relationships with existing dealers and channel partners.
- Conduct regular field visits within the assigned territory to generate business.
- Promote products from leading IT hardware brands.
- Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and follow up on orders and deliveries.
- Coordinate with the Mumbai head office for pricing, product availability, procurement, and order fulfilment.
- Follow up on payments and outstanding dues.
- Achieve monthly sales targets and submit regular sales reports.

Required Skills & Qualifications
- 2–5 years of experience in channel sales, preferably in IT hardware, computer peripherals, or electronics.
- Experience dealing with IT dealers, resellers, distributors, or system integrators.
- Good knowledge of the local market and dealer network in the assigned location.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
- Willingness to travel for field sales.
- Target-oriented with good business development skills.

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Job Opening: Deputy Manager Accounting & Commercial (Cable Division)

Experience: 4 - 5 years
Compensation: 20 LPA 25 LPA
Age Limit: 25–35 years


Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting & Closure: Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting, plant/project accounting, and ensure timely month-end financial closure for the Cable Division.
Commercial Governance: Oversee vendor contract evaluations, customer credit management, receivables tracking, and commercial terms verification.
Working Capital Optimization: Monitor and optimize key working capital drivers including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and inventory valuation/provisions.
SAP S/4HANA Operations: Leverage SAP S/4HANA (FI & CO modules) for general ledger management, cost center reporting, and seamless financial postings.
Profitability Insights (COPA): Utilize COPA to generate granular segment-wise, product-wise, and customer-wise revenue and margin insights.
MIS & Business Reporting: Prepare monthly Management Information Systems (MIS) reports, plant performance dashboards, and comprehensive budget vs. actual variance analysis.
Taxation & Compliance: Support compliance for GST returns, TDS submissions, and tax audits in close coordination with corporate tax teams.

Candidate Requirements
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (Mandatory).
Experience: 4 to 5 years of post-qualification experience in Accounting, Commercial Finance, Plant Finance, or Business Finance within a manufacturing environment (Cable, Electrical, Capital Goods, or Process Manufacturing preferred).


How to Apply
If you match the criteria and are ready for an exciting career growth opportunity, please share your updated CV to bhargavi_s@trigent.com.

Description:
Manager, Global Process Excellence

Transformation | Global Process Excellence | Global Procurement Solutions

Job Title Manager, Global Process Excellence ,
Location Ahmedabad, India

Role Purpose
The Manager, Global Process Excellence is a hands-on transformation leadership role within the Transformation team, responsible for driving and executing the modernization of Source-to-Pay processes, technology, and ways of working across SAP ECC 6.0, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP Ariba (SAP Business Network). Reporting to the Associate Director, Global Process Excellence, this role owns the day-to-day execution of transformation workstreams translating the global roadmap into deliverable outcomes ; while ensuring seamless service delivery to the business during the transition.
The role requires direct, working-
level involvement in SAP transformation delivery (not solely oversight): partnering with IT, functional, and BPO teams on configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and hypercare activities, while building strong relationships across Procurement, Accounts Payable, IT, Shared Services, and external suppliers/partners.
Key Responsibilities
Transformation Execution: Drive and personally execute assigned workstreams of the Global Transformation Agenda, partnering with Global/Zone teams, Global Service Excellence, and Global GBS Capabilities to deliver measurable business impact.
SAP ECC to S/4HANA Migration: Provide hands-on execution support across migration phases ; requirements, process design, configuration validation, data migration support, integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization support.
SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network: Lead hands-on execution of Ariba modules (e.g., sourcing, contracts, procurement, supplier network) implementation and optimization, including supplier enablement, catalog/PO configuration validation, and network transaction troubleshooting.
Roadmap Delivery: Support development and execution of the 3-year Transformation Roadmap (Expansion, Digital, and Process Transformation initiatives) in collaboration with stakeholders, technology partners, and BPO partners.
Continuous Improvement: Lead the Continuous Improvement (CI) framework across the Source-to-Pay process, identifying opportunity areas and partnering with Global GBS Capabilities to execute and deliver value.
Technology Optimization: Drive platform optimization and utilization (SAP ECC/S4HANA/Ariba and adjacent digital/AI tools) in partnership with Global Functions and the Zones.
Risk, Controls & Compliance: Manage transformation-related risk, compliance, and access controls in collaboration with internal audit/controls teams, including access/role adherence and issue remediation.
Governance & Reporting: Define and track transformation KPIs, run operating reviews, manage escalations, and report progress to the Associate Director and senior stakeholders.
Change Management: Drive adoption, communications, training, and supplier/user experience improvements associated with SAP transformation releases.
Stakeholder Management: Build and manage global relationships across Procurement, AP, IT, Services, and external suppliers/partners to ensure scalable processes that meet service standards and business outcomes.
Qualifications & Experience
15+ years of combined Operational and Transformation experience, including exposure to global or regional roles.
Proven, hands-on experience personally driving and executing SAP ECC 6.0 to S/4HANA transformation and SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network trouble shooting / Implementation this is a working, execution-level requirement, not solely a governance/oversight requirement.
Practical exposure to NextGen AI-enabled solutions within Source-to-Pay / Procurement technology landscapes is an advantage.
Strong process management skills: standardization, optimization, documentation, controls, and scalable service delivery.
Governance & KPI expertise: ability to define metrics, run operating reviews, manage escalations, and ensure compliance.
Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire global/virtual teams, including driving operational excellence with offshore BPO providers.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to use data-driven insights to inform decisions and drive improvements (root cause analysis, defect reduction, cycle-time improvement).
Ability to influence without authority at team and stakeholder levels; strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills across functions and levels.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or an advanced degree is a plus.
Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.
AboutCompany:
Kraft Heinz, The Company
The Kraft Heinz Company is the fifth largest food and beverage company in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We are a globally trusted producer of delicious foods for 150 years, and we provide high quality, great taste and nutrition for all eating occasions whether at home, in restaurants or on-the-go. The Kraft Heinz Company manufactures and markets food and beverage products in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Australia and throughout Asia-Pacific. Our products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, and other grocery products, as well as infant and nutrition products.
As one of the worlds largest food and beverage companies, we are proud to spark joy around mealtimes with a global portfolio of more than 200 brands. Our iconic brands include Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Planters, Maxwell House, Capri Sun, Ore-Ida, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, Cracker Barrel, Classico, and McCafe, among others. We sell products through our own sales organizations and through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to convenience stores, drug stores, value stores, bakeries, pharmacies, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors, and institutions (e.g., hotels, restaurants, hospitals, health care facilities, and certain government agencies) as well as to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts.
No matter the brand, we are united under one vision: To Be the Best Food Company, Growing a Better World. Bringing this vision to life are our 39,000+ teammates around the world, making food people love. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership and commitment with Rise Against Hunger. And we also stand committed to sustainability, and the health of our planet and its people. Every day, we are transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion -- and are ready to create the future, build on storied legacy, and participate as a conscientious global citizen -- there’s one thing to do: join us.
Our culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration
We’re not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry intern to senior leader -- to own their work. We believe that we share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – and we apply this to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you’re supported to grow and achieve. You’re recognized and rewarded for outstanding performance at every level. You’re given opportunity to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’ll be supported by a thriving group of teammates in over 40 countries around the world, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress every day.

Description:
Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 6 to 12 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams
- Excellent communication
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Job Summary
We re seeking a hands-on Lead Software Engineer to drive application modernization, legacy-codebase stabilization, service/API extraction, and secure integration initiatives. The role combines deep expertise in C#/.NET, Angular, and SQL Server with modern integration engineering using TypeScript/Node.js, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft Azure. You will lead integration development and guide architecture decisions, code reviews, and the reliability, security, and maintainability of existing systems. Experience: 8+ Years


Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, modernization, and maintenance of enterprise applications using C#/.NET and Angular.
Stabilize legacy codebases by addressing technical debt, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Design and implement service/API extraction strategies to decouple legacy applications into well-defined, maintainable services.
Design secure integrations between existing platforms and external systems, covering authentication, authorization, data protection, and error handling.
Develop and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and application data-access layers.
Lead integration development using TypeScript/Node.js and modern API architectures.
Design and implement service-to-service communication using gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
Build and maintain PostgreSQL-backed integrations.
Build, deploy, and support integration components on Microsoft Azure.
Define API contracts, integration patterns, error-handling approaches, observability, and security standards.
Troubleshoot complex application, cross-service, and data consistency issues and drive root-cause analysis to resolution.
Lead architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews; establish coding standards, testing practices, and reusable development patterns.
Collaborate with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Mentor engineers and support delivery planning and estimation.


Requirements
(all mandatory)
Minimum 8 years of experience in software development.
Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET.
Experience building and maintaining enterprise web applications using Angular.
Strong SQL Server skills, including stored procedures, query optimization, and database troubleshooting.
Proven experience stabilizing, refactoring, and improving existing enterprise applications.
Experience extracting services from monolithic or legacy systems and designing maintainable APIs.
Solid understanding of secure service communication, authentication, authorization, and data protection.
Strong hands-on development experience with TypeScript/Node.js.
Expertise in API design: RESTful APIs, service contracts, integration patterns, and versioning.
Practical experience designing or implementing gRPC services and Protobuf contracts.
Experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, SQL, query optimization, and application integration.
Experience deploying, integrating, and supporting application services on Microsoft Azure.
Strong grasp of design patterns, clean code, testing, debugging, and version control (Git).
Ability to lead design discussions, run architecture and code reviews, and mentor engineers.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer (6+ years experience) with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of AWS and/or GCP to lead end-to-end cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices.
This role focuses on designing and operating secure, scalable, and production-grade cloud platforms, with emphasis on Azure-native services, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, observability, and cloud governance. You will work closely with engineering teams and clients to deliver highly available, cost-optimized, and compliant systems.
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-time (on - site)


Requirements
6+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps roles.
Strong production experience with Azure , exposure to AWS or GCP is a plus and willingness to learn and work across other cloud or hybrid environments as needed.
Deep hands-on experience in designing and managing Terraform based infrastructure provisioning.
Strong expertise in designing and securing Azure network architectures, including Hub-and-Spoke topologies, Azure Virtual Networks (VNet), Private Link, Application Gateway, and Azure Firewall.
Experience with cloud native Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tools such as Bicep/ARM and Ansible (good to have).
Strong knowledge and experience with container orchestration platforms such as AKS (must-have), Azure Container Apps. Exposure to EKS, GKE, ECS is a plus..
Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
Proven expertise in scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, Go, or Bash to build tailored automation solutions, integrate APIs, and develop custom tooling.
Experience working with serverless and event-driven architectures.
Strong understanding and hands on production experience of implementing observability solutions including logging, metrics and alerting using cloud native or open source tools.
Hands-on experience with identity, access management, and enterprise governance in Azure using Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Management Groups, and Azure Policy.
Experience in administering Windows and Linux based Cloud virtual machines, including AD integration, storage, networking, backup, performance optimization, access control, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Experience designing and managing databases, knowledge of MySQL, PostgreSQL and MS SQL.
Strong troubleshooting and Hands on experience in incident management, conducting root cause analysis.
Good communication skills with experience interacting with clients.
Ability to collaborate effectively with different teams and stakeholders.


Nice to Have
Certifications in Azure, AWS, GCP, Terraform, or Kubernetes.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Familiarity utilizing GitHub Copilot or Azure DevOps AI features to accelerate Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development and script automation.

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.

Business Development & Key Accounts

Commodity Market Analysis

B2B Brand Management

Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.

Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity:
The Engineer - Customer Order Fulfillment independently owns the complete customer order lifecycle, from purchase order receipt and validation through bill of quantities/material preparation, order entry, supply chain coordination, shipment tracking, delivery confirmation and handover for installation or deployment. The position ensures orders are processed accurately, compliantly and within agreed service levels, while maintaining reliable status visibility, proactive risk escalation and effective coordination across customer, project and supply-chain stakeholders.
What you will do:
Customer purchase order validation and order creation.
Open-order management and fulfillment assurance.
Shipment, transit and delivery follow-up.
NEXT card aging and data quality.
Operational governance, meetings and escalation
The skills you bring:
Minimum 3 years of directly relevant experience in customer order management, order fulfillment or delivery operations, preferably supporting telecom, IT infrastructure, hardware deployment or complex B2B projects.
Proven ability to independently manage orders end to end, balance multiple priorities, lead stakeholder calls and resolve execution issues with limited supervision.
Working understanding of procurement, supply-chain operations, logistics, shipping milestones, vendor coordination and installation/deployment handover.
Practical experience with ERP/order-management platforms, including SAP and/or NEXT or comparable systems; familiarity with intercompany ordering and PO-to-delivery controls.
Strong Excel capability, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, filters, data reconciliation and operational tracker management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, customer orientation, accuracy, problem solving, accountability and cross-functional stakeholder management.
Preferred / Additional competencies :
Exposure to Power BI, dashboarding, workflow automation or process-improvement initiatives.
Understanding of order-quality controls, commercial PO validation, BOQ/BOM preparation and revision-log management.
Experience coordinating geographically distributed teams, third-party vendors and project delivery stakeholders.
Relevant bachelor s degree in engineering, business, supply chain or a related discipline is an advantage; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead Sourcing Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-

We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India
Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Lead implementation and execution of procurement processes with existing and new vendors/ partners
Develop detailed sourcing strategy and category plans to maximize effectiveness and efficiency
Embrace change, utilize and champion new & existing digital tools and portals applicable to the role.
Build and maintain strong relationships with local suppliers to ensure reliable and consistent steel supply.
Lead negotiations to achieve the best possible pricing, payment terms, and cost efficiencies through volume aggregation and strategic partnerships.
Ensure that all procured steel products meet the company's quality standards and comply with industry regulations.
Continuously monitor steel market trends, price fluctuations, and emerging risks to inform procurement strategies and make informed purchasing decisions.
Conducting supplier reliability assessment, developing KPIs, joint action plan and providing feedback to identify areas of improvement
Identify potential supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure continuous steel supply and business continuity.
Continuously assess and improve procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce lead times, and drive cost savings.
Provide updates about procurement related progress and potential delays on a daily basis to the Sourcing/ Category Lead
Exposure of MSME universe preferably in the Raw Material procurement sector.
Maintain an awareness of pricing and industry market conditions. Provide pricing and product availability to all customers basis the guideline and processes outlined.
Strong team player and comfortable with new categories and customer profile.

Work experience:

Atleast 10 years of proven experience in purchase/ procurement in one or more industries/ market/ commodity segments such as EPC, Manufacturers, OEMs, Automotive, Building materials
Entrepreneurial and business owner mindset (startup experience a big plus) owning some big accounts themselves
Passion and energy to drive hyper growth in a new yet rapidly growing business segment
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant

Position: Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant
Experience: 7+ Years
Employment Type: Remote
Shift: UK Shift 9 Hours
Working Days: 5 Days a Week
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon – Remote
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds

Job Description -

We are looking for an experienced Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant with 7+ years of experience to support and deliver Workday HCM and Payroll solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of Workday HCM and Payroll, experience in configuration and implementation/support activities, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Implement, configure, and support Workday HCM and Payroll modules.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Workday solutions.
Configure Workday business processes, workflows, security, and functional areas.
Support payroll-related processes, integrations, and issue resolution.
Perform impact analysis, testing, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
Work with HR, Payroll, and business teams to understand requirements and provide solutions.
Participate in Workday enhancement, implementation, and production support activities.
Prepare functional documentation, test scenarios, and process documentation.
Support data validation, reconciliation, and payroll-related reporting activities.
Coordinate with technical and functional teams for integrations and issue resolution.
Ensure solutions comply with business and payroll requirements.

Required Skills & Experience-

7+ years of overall experience in Workday HCM and Payroll.
Strong hands-on experience as a Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant.
Good understanding of Workday HCM business processes.
Strong knowledge of Workday Payroll processes and configurations.
Experience in Workday configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
Good understanding of Workday integrations and data flow.
Experience working with HR/Payroll stakeholders and business users.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a UK shift environment.

Must Have
Workday HCM
Workday Payroll
Workday Configuration
Workday Business Processes
Workday Support / Implementation
7+ Years of Experience
Immediate Joiner

Additional Information
Remote opportunity.
Candidates must be available for the UK shift (9 hours).
Immediate joiners only.
Laptop is mandatory for the interview.
Both Virtual and Face-to-Face interview rounds are mandatory.


Thanks,
HR

Description:
Workday Technical Consultant


Position: Workday Technical Consultant
Experience: 7+ Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only
Work Location: Remote
Preferred Base Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon
Work Type: UK Shift 9 Hours | 5 Days a Week
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds
Job Description -

We are looking for an experienced Workday Technical Consultant with 7+ years of experience to join our team . The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting Workday technical solutions based on business requirements.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Workday technical development, integrations, reporting, and troubleshooting, along with the ability to work closely with functional and business teams.

Key Responsibilities -

Design, develop, configure, and support Workday technical solutions.
Develop and maintain Workday integrations with internal and external applications.
Work on Workday Integration Cloud, EIBs, Core Connectors, and other integration technologies.
Develop and maintain custom reports, calculated fields, and dashboards.
Analyze technical requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
Troubleshoot and resolve integration, reporting, and technical issues.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, defect fixing, and production support.
Work closely with Workday functional consultants and business stakeholders.
Participate in enhancement, migration, and implementation projects.
Prepare technical specifications and documentation.
Monitor integrations and ensure successful data flow between Workday and third-party systems.
Support deployment and post-production activities.

Required Skills & Experience -

7+ years of experience in Workday technical development/consulting.
Strong hands-on experience as a Workday Technical Consultant.
Strong knowledge of Workday integrations and reporting.
Experience with EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Hands-on experience with Core Connectors and Workday integration technologies.
Experience in Workday Report Writer, Advanced Reports, Calculated Fields, and dashboards.
Good understanding of Workday HCM data and business processes.
Experience with XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST APIs and web services.
Experience in integration troubleshooting and performance optimization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a UK shift environment.

Must-Have Skills
Workday Technical Consultant
Workday Integrations
EIB
Core Connectors
Workday Reporting
Calculated Fields
XML / XSLT
SOAP / REST APIs
7+ Years Experience
Immediate Joiners Only

Candidate Profile
Strong technical expertise in the Workday ecosystem.
Good understanding of end-to-end Workday integration processes.
Ability to independently handle technical requirements and production issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Candidates must be available for immediate joining.

Important Note -

Laptop is mandatory for the interview. Both Virtual and Face-to-Face interview rounds are mandatory.


Thanks,
HR

Description:
Oracle Fusion HCM UK Payroll & Fast Formula Consultant

Employment Type: Permanent
Experience: 5-8 Years
Positions: 1
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon
Work Mode: Hybrid
Laptop: Mandatory for Interview
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds

Job Summary-

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion HCM UK Payroll & Fast Formula Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM UK Payroll and Fast Formula.
The consultant will be responsible for implementing, configuring, testing, supporting, and enhancing UK Payroll solutions, including payroll elements, balances, statutory calculations, legislative updates, and Fast Formula-based business rules.

Key Responsibilities-

Implement and configure Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM UK Payroll solutions.
Configure UK Payroll elements, balances, payroll definitions, statutory deductions, and legislative rules.
Develop and optimize Fast Formulas for payroll calculations, validations, absence, Time & Labor, and other HCM requirements.
Gather requirements, perform solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
Handle UK payroll legislative updates, HMRC requirements, and statutory changes.
Troubleshoot payroll calculation issues and debug Fast Formulas.
Conduct system testing, integration testing, and UAT.
Support payroll runs, reconciliation, issue resolution, and post-payroll activities.
Work with technical teams on integrations between Oracle HCM and third-party systems such as Finance, HR, Time & Attendance, and Benefits.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and user guides.
Interact with UK-based stakeholders and payroll teams in an onshore-offshore delivery model.
Support end users and provide guidance on Oracle Fusion UK Payroll best practices.

Must-Have Skills

58 years of experience in Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud.
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion UK Payroll Functional.
Strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Fast Formula.
Experience with UK Payroll elements, balances, payroll definitions, statutory calculations, and legislative updates.
Strong understanding of UK Payroll legislation and HMRC requirements.
Experience in at least one end-to-end UK Payroll implementation or major enhancement project.
Good understanding of Oracle HCM Cloud data model, security, and payroll-related reporting.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with global teams.

Good to Have
Oracle HCM Cloud certification in UK Payroll and/or Fast Formula.
Experience with Oracle HCM integrations.
Experience working with UK-based clients/stakeholders.
Strong documentation and presentation skills.
Experience in payroll controls, reconciliation, audit readiness, and data accuracy.

Education
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, HR, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Important
Only Immediate Joiners are preferred.

Required Technical Skill Set:

1. Extensive experience in designing, planning and implementing IMS-based voice solutions including VoLTE, VoWiFi and VoNR services across multi-vendor telecom environments.
2. Proven capability in translating business and service requirements into High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and deployment-ready architecture artefacts.
3. Strong understanding of IMS Core architecture including P-CSCF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF, SBC, TAS, HSS/UDM and their integration with EPC and 5GC networks.

5. Experience in designing and validating Emergency Services (999/112), Lawful Intercept (LI), number portability and regulatory service requirements.

7. Experience managing HLD-to-LLD traceability and ensuring alignment between design, implementation and validation activities.
8. Ability to provide technical leadership during integration, testing, migration and production deployment phases.
9. Experience working with telecom operators, OEMs and cross-functional teams to resolve architecture and service design challenges.
10. Knowledge of cloud-native IMS evolution, automation frameworks and autonomous network principles.

We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.
