Description:
Position Overview : Sales & Marketing Head

Department: Sales & Business Development
Location: Head Office, Raipur, Chhattisgarh
Experience: 5-10 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a results-driven Sales & Marketing Head to lead our pan-India sales operations from the Head Office in Raipur. The role will be responsible for developing sales strategies, driving revenue growth, managing the head office and regional sales teams, and expanding the company's market presence across India.

Key Responsibilities
Sales Strategy & Business Growth: Develop and execute pan-India sales strategies, annual business plans, and market expansion initiatives.
Revenue & Target Ownership: Drive national sales targets, revenue growth, profitability, and sales budget performance.
Team Leadership: Lead, monitor, and develop the head office and regional sales teams to maximise productivity and performance.
Performance Management: Establish sales KPIs, review individual and team performance, identify gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
Business Development: Identify new markets, customer segments, industrial clients, distributors, and strategic business opportunities.
Sales Planning & Reporting: Manage sales forecasting, pipeline reviews, MIS dashboards, CRM utilisation, and periodic performance reports.
Key Account Management: Build and strengthen relationships with major industrial customers, business partners, and key accounts.
Pricing & Negotiation: Develop pricing strategies, negotiate commercial terms, and support profitable business acquisition.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with plant operations, finance, and supply chain teams to align sales commitments with pricing, production capacity, inventory, and delivery.
Sales Team Development: Drive team training, territory planning, incentive structures, and performance improvement initiatives.

Candidate Requirements
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management preferred.
5-10 years of experience in B2B or industrial sales, including sales leadership responsibilities.
Proven experience managing regional or pan-India sales teams and achieving business targets.
Strong expertise in sales strategy, revenue growth, business development, forecasting, and commercial negotiations.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder
management skills.

- Maintain and review Job Safety Analysis (JSA) documents.

Description:
Dear Candidates,

We are seeking a visionary experienced Centre Head for our VLCC Clinic. To provide a wide range of exceptional beauty services to clients, enhancing their appearance and well-being while adhering to VLCCs standards and creating superior customer satisfaction.

Position: Centre Head Clinics (Females Only)
Locations: Delhi NCR (10 Openings)
Department: Operations – Clinics
Reporting To: Regional Business Head
Experience: 6–10 years (at least 3 years in a leadership role)
Compensation: Best in Industry

Role Overview:

The Clinic Centre Head is accountable for the overall performance of the clinic – owning revenue, customer experience, and operational excellence. This role involves leading cross-functional teams (slimming, beauty, dermatology, and support staff), driving sales, ensuring compliance, and delivering a superior client experience aligned with brand standards.

Key Responsibilities:

1) Business & Sales Growth
Deliver clinic revenue and profitability targets.
Drive sales through consultations, upselling, cross-selling, and service bundling.
Track daily/weekly MIS and ensure KPIs are met.

2) Operations & Service Excellence
Ensure smooth functioning of all clinic services (slimming, beauty, dermatology, and wellness).
Maintain hygiene, safety, and quality standards.
Oversee inventory, billing, and cash management processes.

3) Team Leadership
Manage, coach, and motivate the clinic team (Centre staff, Slimming Heads, Beauty Heads, and Counsellors).
Conduct regular reviews and performance appraisals.
Build a culture of accountability, service, and sales focus.

4) Customer Experience
Ensure every client receives a consistent, high-quality experience.
Resolve escalations and ensure high NPS & client retention.
Implement loyalty and referral programs.

5) Compliance & Reporting
Adhere to company SOPs and statutory requirements.
Ensure proper documentation for audits and reviews.

Description:
MIS Executive
Job Title-MIS Executive
Location-Patna -Raipur-Lucknow-Bhubaneshwar-Bhopal

Experience -3--4 Years of Work Experience Preferably in Real Estate Projects
Reporting To-Management / Finance Head / State Head
Coordination With-Finance, Accounts, Sales, Project Teams, and Vendors

MIS REPORTING • PROJECT MONITORING • FINANCIAL TRACKING • DATA ANALYSIS
1. Role Overview
The MIS Executive is responsible for collecting, consolidating, verifying and analysing operational and financial information from relevant departments and project teams and converting it into accurate MIS reports, financial trackers, project dashboards and performance summaries for management review. The role supports management decision making by monitoring project wise budgets, actual expenses, cash flows, cost variations, vendor payments, outstanding dues and receivables. It requires strong Excel and data management skills, timely coordination with Finance, Accounts, Sales and Project Teams, and disciplined follow-up to ensure reliable reporting and clear visibility of project and business performance.
2. Professional Skills
Minimum 3-4 years of MIS experience, preferably in real estate or a project based business.
Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
Knowledge of budgeting, project costing, and cash flow tracking.
Strong analytical, reporting, and data-management skills.
Proficiency in MS Word and PowerPoint.
Good communication, coordination, and problem solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines.
Knowledge of Power BI or ERP systems will be an advantage.
3. Roles and Responsibilities
A. MIS Reporting & Analysis
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports, dashboards and performance summaries for management.
Collect, consolidate and analyse data from Finance, Accounts, Sales, Project Teams and other relevant departments to ensure accurate reporting.
Identify trends, discrepancies, delays and variances in reported data and highlight key findings to management.
Maintain reporting schedules and ensure reports are submitted within agreed timelines.
Prepare clear summaries and comparisons so management can quickly identify pending items and areas requiring attention.
B. Financial & Project Monitoring
Monitor project wise budgets, actual expenses, cash flows and cost variations using information supplied by the responsible teams.
Maintain trackers for vendor payments, outstanding dues, receivables and project expenditure.
Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams to obtain timely updates on financial information and clarify discrepancies.
Compare budgeted figures with actual expenditure where data is available, flag variances and follow up with the concerned team for explanations.
Coordinate with project teams to collect updates on project progress, expenditure and pending activities for management reporting.
C. Data Management & Documentation
Maintain and update project databases, Excel sheets, MIS trackers, dashboards and standard reporting formats.
Verify data accuracy, consistency and completeness, and follow up with concerned departments to resolve discrepancies.
Maintain organised source records and supporting documents so reported figures can be traced to the relevant input.
Keep records of reporting dates, revised data, pending inputs and report submissions.
Ensure proper documentation and timely submission of MIS reports.
D. Management Support & Coordination
Prepare presentations, analytical reports and summaries for management meetings and decision making.
Coordinate with project, finance, sales and other teams to collect updates on project progress and financial performance.
Follow up on pending inputs and action points, updating the relevant trackers once information is confirmed.
Improve reporting formats and processes to enhance data accuracy, consistency and operational efficiency.
Present verified information clearly and distinguish confirmed figures from pending or unverified inputs.
4. Authority & Accountability
Take responsibility for the accuracy, completeness and timely submission of assigned MIS reports, trackers and dashboards.
Request missing information, clarifications and corrections from the relevant departments before finalising reports.
Escalate unresolved discrepancies, delayed inputs, material cost variances or reporting risks to the Management, Finance Head or State Head, as applicable.
Maintain confidentiality of company, project, financial, vendor and other business information.
The role supports reporting and analysis and does not independently approve payments, budgets or changes to source financial figures.
5. Qualifications
Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
Minimum 4 years of relevant MIS experience, preferably in real estate.
Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
Knowledge of budgeting, project costing, cash-flow tracking and financial or operational reporting.
Proficiency in MS Word and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of Power BI or ERP systems is an advantage.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines.
6. Key Success Measures
Accurate and timely submission of daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports, dashboards and performance summaries. Reliable and up to date project wise budgets, expenditure, cash-flow, vendor payment, outstanding dues and receivables trackers. Prompt identification and escalation of data discrepancies, reporting gaps, delays and cost variances.
Consistent coordination with Finance, Accounts, Sales, Project Teams and Vendors to obtain complete and verified information.
Well maintained databases, Excel sheets and supporting records that allow reported figures to be traced and checked.
Clear management reports and presentations that improve visibility of project progress, financial performance and pending actions.

Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. *Accounting Operations*

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions.
* Maintain books of accounts, journals, vouchers, and supporting records.

2. *Accounts Payable & Receivable*

* Monitor vendor and customer accounts.
* Track outstanding payments and receivables and ensure timely follow-up.

3. *Bank & Ledger Reconciliation*

* Conduct regular bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies.

4. *Statutory Compliance*

* Maintain records related to *GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements*.
* Coordinate with the CA for timely compliance and documentation.

5. *MIS & Financial Reporting*

* Prepare accurate and timely MIS and financial reports.
* Provide required financial information to management for decision-making.

6. *Financial Documentation*

* Verify and maintain invoices, bills, receipts, payment vouchers, and other financial documents.
* Ensure systematic and confidential record maintenance.

7. *CA & Audit Coordination*

* Coordinate with the Chartered Accountant and auditors.
* Provide required financial data and supporting documents within timelines.

8. *Expense & Payment Management*

* Verify expense claims and supporting documents.
* Process payments in accordance with company policies and approvals.

9. *Accuracy & Internal Controls*

* Maintain high standards of accuracy in accounting and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with established financial procedures and internal controls.

10. *Process Improvement*

* Identify gaps in existing accounting processes.
* Recommend practical improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reporting.


Preferred candidate profile

Candidates with practical experience in end-to-end accounting operations.
Experience coordinating with CAs and handling compliance-related documentation.
Ability to work inbajadependently while coordinating with management.
Preference may be given to candidates who can join at the earliest.

With a focus on helping businesses find the right locations and investors identify suitable opportunities, the company provides real estate advisory services across multiple sectors in India.

- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data
- Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Conducts sales strategy analysis and refines as appropriate to increase market share for all properties.
- Maintains accurate reservation system information.
- Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.
- Generates updates on transient segment each period.
- Assists with account diagnostics process and validates conclusions.
Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy
- Updates market knowledge and aligns strategies and approaches accordingly.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Attends meetings to plan, organize, prioritize, coordinate and manage activities and solutions.
- Establishes long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.
- Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc).
- Explores opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenges existing processes/systems/products to make improvements.
- Provides revenue management functional expertise to cluster general managers, leadership teams and market sales leaders.
- Ensures hotel strategies conform to brand philosophies and initiatives.
- Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.
- Prepares sales strategy meeting agenda, supporting documentation.
- Communicates proactively with properties regarding rate restrictions and strategy.
- Manages rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue.
- Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

- Checks distribution channels for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning.

- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue management processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Understands and communicates the value of the brand name as it relates to franchise partnerships and revenue management opportunities.

Building Successful Relationships
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships in a proactive manner.
- Acts as a liaison, when necessary, between property and regional/corporate systems support.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Attends staff/forecast/long range meetings as requested by properties.

SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up

Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Kitchen Support Experts play an important role in support of several hotel functions. These associates may work across departments (e.g., kitchen, food and beverage, employee dining room) to support cleaning and basic kitchen preparation needs. Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (e.g., dishwashing machines, hand wash stations), or transporting dishware across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Role
Quality Incharge TMT

Location
Raipur

Key Responsibilities:
Ensure product quality as per BIS 1786 standards (FE 550 / 550D).
Monitor chemical and mechanical properties of TMT bars.
Supervise lab testing (UTM, bend/re-bend, chemical analysis).
Ensure proper calibration of equipment as per defined scope and standards.
Facilitate audits by customers and government authorities.
Handle customer complaints and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA.
Ensure process control at LRF, CCM, and rolling mill stages.
Maintain quality documentation and ensure audit compliance.
Coordinate with production for continuous quality improvement.
Possess working knowledge of Six Sigma, 7 QC tools, and Why-Why analysis.

Requirements:
B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical or Metallurgical Engineering.
4 to 6 years of experience in TMT/steel industry.
Strong knowledge of BIS/ASTM standards and testing procedures.
Experience in handling audits and customer inspections.
Proficiency in SAP/ZOHO ERP systems.

Founded in 1982, the Mumbai-based group is known for sustainable growth and large-scale, complex project execution, employing nearly 40,000 people across India, USA, Europe, and Africa.

Description:
Roles and Responsibility/ Duties to be performed:-

A. Civil Project Planning & Execution -
Plan, coordinate and execute civil construction projects related to thermal power plants, buildings, infrastructure and plant facilities.
Prepare project execution plans, WBS, schedules, activity plans and construction methodologies.
Monitor project progress against approved schedules, milestones, budgets and quality requirements.
Ensure timely execution of foundations, RCC structures, structural steel, buildings, roads, drainage, paving and other civil works.
Monitor manpower, materials, machinery and other resources and take corrective action for delays and constraints.

B. Engineering, Construction & Technical Management -
Review and interpret civil, structural and architectural drawings, GFC/shop drawings, specifications and technical documents.
Coordinate with consultants/design teams for resolution of design discrepancies and technical issues.
Supervise construction activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements and relevant IS/BIS standards.
Provide technical guidance on construction methodology, materials and sequencing of critical activities.
Monitor waterproofing, finishing, MEP coordination and other building works and ensure necessary inspections and testing.

C. Quantity Estimation, BOQ & Cost Control -
Prepare and review BOQs, quantity estimates, rate analysis and cost estimates for civil works.
Assess material, manpower and machinery requirements and assist in project budgeting.
Monitor project expenditure and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Verify contractor measurements, bills, quantities, variations and extra items and provide technical/commercial recommendations.

D. Contractor & Consultant Management -
Coordinate with civil contractors, consultants, vendors and subcontractors for project execution.
Review contractor work programs, resource deployment and overall performance.
Conduct site meetings and progress reviews and ensure timely mobilization of resources.
Monitor contractor performance with respect to progress, quality, safety and contractual requirements.
Review contractor claims, measurements, variations and completion documentation.

E. Quality Assurance & Quality Control -
Ensure implementation of approved QA/QC procedures, inspection plans and testing requirements.
Monitor quality of concrete, reinforcement, structural steel, earthwork, roads, waterproofing and finishing works.
Ensure compliance with IS/BIS codes, project specifications and approved quality standards.
Maintain inspection records, test reports, NCRs and corrective-action documentation.

F. Project Documentation & Reporting -
Maintain project records including drawings, BOQs, schedules, inspection reports, measurements, test reports and contractor documents.
Highlight project risks, delays and technical issues and recommend corrective measures.
Prepare management presentations and project review reports.

G. Civil Maintenance & Infrastructure Management -
Coordinate civil maintenance of plant buildings, roads, drainage, structures and other infrastructure.
Plan and monitor preventive, corrective, repair, rehabilitation and renovation works.
Conduct site inspections to identify structural defects, leakage, settlement, pavement distress and other civil issues.
Ensure timely execution of emergency and breakdown-related civil works.

H. MEP & Multidisciplinary Coordination -
Coordinate civil works with Mechanical, Electrical, C&I, MEP, Administration and other departments.
Coordinate civil interfaces for equipment foundations, trenches, cable routes, pipe supports, openings and embedded items.
Resolve interdisciplinary issues to minimize rework and project delays.

I. Safety, Environment & Statutory Compliance -
Ensure civil construction and maintenance activities comply with HSE requirements, statutory regulations and environmental guidelines.
Monitor safety compliance cf contractors and ensure safe construction practices, work permits and site arrangements.
Participate in safety inspections, audits and implementation of corrective actions.

J. Team Leadership & Coordination -
Supervise and guide civil engineers, supervisors, contractors and site teams.
Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance and mentor junior.

Functional Competencies:-
Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance and mentor junior engineers.
Coordinate with internal departments, consultants and external agencies.
Lead site meetings and ensure timely closure of action points.
Civil Maintenance & Infrastructure: Knowledge of building repair,
structural rehabilitation, renovation, and road maintenance, with
understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
Maitenance Planning & Execution: Ability to plan and schedule
maintenance activities, conduct site inspections, assess defects, prioritize works and ensure timely completion.
Safety & Statutory Compliance: Sound understanding of HSE
requirements, building codes, environmental norms and safe work
practices applicable to civil maintenance activities.
Cost Management & Optimization: Experience in budgeting,estimation and expenditure control, with the ability to identify practical and cost- effective maintenance solutions.
Team & Stakeholder Management: Ability to lead maintenance teams and coordinate with contractors and Mechanical, Electrical, Administration and other departments for effective execution of maintenance activities.

Behavioral & Management Competencies:-
Leadership - Ability to guide and motivate teams effectively.
Problem Solving - Analytical thinking for resolving on-site challenges.
Time Management - Efficient task prioritization and deadline adherence.
Communication - Clear and professional interaction with stakeholders.
Adaptability - Flexibility to operate under changing conditions.
Decision-Making - Sound judgment in complex project scenarios.
Ethics & Integrity - High standard of professionalism and accountability.
Accountability & Ownership -Taking responsibility for assigned tasks and ensuring timely completion. Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and budget constraints.

Description:
Job Purpose
The Sales & Marketing Manager will be responsible for business development, regional market penetration, client acquisition, and revenue generation in their assigned region. This role involves engaging with end-customers, electrical consultants, and EPC contractors (Electrical & Solar) to deliver technical solutions, secure orders, and build long-term corporate relationships.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities
Regional Market Management & Business Development:
Manage sales operations and market expansion across assigned territories (Ahmedabad, Pune, Raipur).
Identify and prospect new business opportunities with industrial end-customers, utilities, renewable energy players, and infrastructure developers.
Technical Consultation & Solution Selling:
Meet directly with end customers and consultants to present product capabilities, understand technical specifications, and resolve technical queries.
Conduct technical discussions to align products with client design requirements.
Consultant & EPC Engagement:
Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with Electrical Consultants, Solar EPC contractors, and Turnkey Contractors to get approved/approved vendor listed.
Generate qualified inquiries and leads through regular networking and business promotion activities.
Inquiry Tracking, Negotiation & Closing:
Track, follow up on, and convert technical inquiries/tenders into firm, profitable sales orders.
Lead commercial negotiations, finalize contractual terms, and ensure high conversion rates to drive revenue targets.
Customer Relationship Management:
Maintain active post-sales engagement to ensure high client satisfaction, repeat business, and strong market presence.
Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) or Electrical Engineering.
Experience: Proven experience in technical sales, market development, or techno-commercial engineering within the Transformer, Switchgear, Heavy Electrical, or Power Equipment sectors.
Key Skills & Competencies:
Strong technical understanding of transformers, electrical equipment, and power distribution systems.
Familiarity with Solar EPCs, Electrical Contractors, and Consulting Engineering networks.
Excellent communication, presentation, and technical query resolution skills.
Proven negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
Strong regional network and ability to work independently in field-based roles.
AboutCompany:
Sri Indrakshi Informatics is a solutions firm specialized in IT, Non-IT and professional staffing services. Our Knowledge force empowers industry leading companies to achieve their digital transformation goals. We curate teams of technical experts who build solutions custom-tailored to each clients needs. These scalable, flexible outcomes are shaped by deep market knowledge, thought leadership and our multi-industry expertise.

Purpose/Objective


The Team Member - Trucking Logistics is responsible for managing all road transportation logistics, ensuring efficient and timely delivery of goods.
This role involves coordinating with transporters, managing Delivery Orders, optimizing performance, and ensuring compliance with safety and logistics standards.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Road Transportation Management: - Oversee all road transportation activities, ensuring efficient and timely movement of goods.
- Manage relationships with transporters and their supervisors to facilitate smooth operations.
Delivery Order Management and Execution: - Arrange and manage Delivery Orders (D/O) to ensure trucks arrive at the plant for loading as scheduled.
- Ensure timely loading and dispatch of trucks from the plant.
Performance Monitoring: - Monitor transporter performance to ensure timely and efficient deliveries.
- Implement improvement strategies to enhance road logistics operations.
Cost Management: - Monitor transportation costs and implement cost-saving measures.
- Optimize truck routing and scheduling for cost efficiency.
Safety and Compliance: - Ensure adherence to safety regulations and compliance with logistics standards.
- Implement safety measures to minimize risks during transportation.
Ethical Standards - Use ethical reasoning to guide decisions, considering the broader impact on the organization and stakeholders.
- Ensure all communications, both verbal and written, reflect the organization’s commitment to integrity and ethics.
Policy Adherence and Development - Implement and enforce organizational policies to maintain consistency and alignment with corporate objectives.
- Contribute to policy development by providing feedback and insights from departmental operations.
Organizational Skills - Prioritize tasks effectively to ensure timely completion of departmental objectives and projects.
- Implement best practices in workflow management to reduce bottlenecks and improve output quality.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, adapting to changing priorities and demands with agility.
Transparency in Operations - Foster a culture of openness by sharing information transparently with team members and stakeholders.
- Establish clear accountability mechanisms to track performance and decision-making within the department.
- Document and communicate decision-making processes and rationales to ensure clarity and understanding.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: - Head Plant Logistics - Lead Primary Logistics Key Stakeholders - External: - Transporters and their Supervisors - Regulatory Authorities
Technical Competencies


Fleet Management-Cements,Fleet Safety and Risk Management-Cements,Inventory Management-Cements,Logistics and Supply Chain Management-Cements,Operational Excellence & Innovation-Cements,Operational Planning-Cements,Transportation Route Optimization-Cements
Qualifications and Experience


Education Qualification - Master's degree in Business Administration or Operations.
Work Experience (Range of years) - 7+ years of experience in truck logistics, fleet management, and route optimization Industry Knowledge - Demonstrate proficiency in vehicle maintenance, fleet utilization, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


To manage the end-to-end procurement process for assigned categories/materials by ensuring timely sourcing, vendor management, purchase order execution, cost optimization, and adherence to procurement policies.
The role is responsible for maintaining uninterrupted supply while achieving quality, cost, and delivery objectives.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Procurement & Sourcing - Execute procurement activities for materials, equipment, consumables, and services as per organizational requirements.
- Float RFQs/RFPs, obtain quotations, and conduct comparative analysis.
- Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and commercial conditions with vendors.
- Prepare and release Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with approved procurement procedures.
- Ensure timely procurement to avoid operational disruptions.
Vendor Management - Identify, evaluate, and onboard new suppliers.
- Maintain strong relationships with existing vendors to ensure quality and timely deliveries.
- Monitor vendor performance based on cost, quality, and delivery metrics.
- Coordinate with suppliers for order acknowledgments, dispatch schedules, and issue resolution.
Commercial Evaluation - Conduct techno-commercial evaluation of bids along with user departments.
- Analyze market trends, pricing movements, and supply risks.
- Support cost-saving and value-engineering initiatives.
Coordination & Follow-up - Liaise with internal stakeholders including operations, maintenance, stores, finance, and projects teams.
- Track purchase orders and expedite deliveries as required.
- Resolve procurement-related issues, shortages, and delivery delays.
- Liaise with GCC for timely floating RFQ, Conducting RA, vendor onboarding Compliance & Documentation - Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and audit requirements.
- Maintain procurement records, contracts, vendor documentation, and reports.
- Support internal and external audits related to procurement activities.
Inventory Support - Coordinate with stores and planning teams to optimize inventory levels.
- Monitor consumption trends and support replenishment planning.
- Minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
Technical Competencies


Procurement & Sourcing,Coordination & Follow-up,Negotiation,SAP, ARIBA
Qualifications and Experience


Qualification and Experience: 5 to 8 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management.
Experience in Procurement of Materials and Services related to Power Plant Equipment / Spares (Mech, Elec, C&I) / AMCs / Civil / Commodities / IT / HR/FMS and should be ready to take up assignments of any category.
Experience in Power, Manufacturing, EPC, Infrastructure, Steel, Cement, or Industrial sectors will be preferred.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a reliable, experienced and well-organised General Administration & Accounts Executive to join our team in Goa. The role involves managing day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, banking and general business administration, while providing support in HR, office administration and operational management.

Candidates with prior accounting or finance experience in the hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food industry will be preferred. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, trustworthy, capable of working independently and interested in building a long-term career with the organisation.

On-site (Office-based) Margao, Goa, India

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping records.
Handle purchase and sales invoices, expenses, receipts and payments.
Perform bank, supplier and customer reconciliations.
Maintain cash, petty cash and expense records.
Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with relevant parties.
Prepare financial information and reports for management, accountants and auditors.
Support budgeting, cost control and financial administration.
Maintain organised accounting records and supporting documentation.
Assist with accounting and cost management activities related to hotel, restaurant and food business operations.

2. Banking & Financial Administration

Assist with routine banking activities and payment processing.
Maintain payment records and supporting documents.
Coordinate with banks, accountants, suppliers and external service providers.
Ensure financial and administrative tasks are completed accurately and within deadlines.

3. HR & Office Administration

Maintain employee documentation, attendance, leave records and personnel files.
Assist with recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
Maintain employment contracts, company records and other confidential documents.
Coordinate office administration and routine operational requirements.
Support management with general HR and administrative activities.

4. General Business & Management Support

Provide administrative support across the company's food, hospitality and IT businesses.
Maintain organised records, schedules, reports and administrative systems.
Coordinate and follow up with employees, suppliers and external parties to ensure timely completion of tasks.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work independently with minimal supervision.
Help develop and maintain efficient administrative processes and internal controls.
Handle confidential company, employee and financial information responsibly.
Take on additional responsibilities across administration, accounts and business operations as the role develops.

Candidate Requirements

Previous professional experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance administration or business administration is required.
Practical knowledge of accounting procedures, financial records and reconciliations.
Experience in hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food-sector accounting will be strongly preferred.
Relevant qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance or Business Administration is desirable.
Good working knowledge of accounting software, MS Excel, Google Sheets and standard office applications.
Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi.
Strong organisational, coordination and follow-up skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling financial information.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
Trustworthy, disciplined, practical and resourceful, with a strong sense of responsibility.
Willingness to support multiple business functions and build a long-term career with the organisation.
Candidates residing in or around Margao, Goa, will be given preference.

What We Offer

Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Stable, full-time, long-term employment.
Exposure to UK and Indian business operations.
Opportunity to work across food, hospitality and technology businesses.
Direct interaction with senior management.
Opportunities to take on greater responsibility and progress into senior accounts, administration or business management roles.

Joining: Immediate.

Description:
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential.
Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC).
Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity.
Achieves personal and team related revenue goals.
Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience.
Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (eg, , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Description:
About the job
Role - Program Manager (Sales Strategy)
This is an IC role
This is a 6day working role (5days - WFO ; Saturdays - WFH)

Job Overview:
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Program Manager with a strong focus on business development to drive growth within a Segment of our SME Express parcel division. This role involves strategizing, planning, and managing programs aimed at expanding our market share, strengthening customer relationships, and enhancing our service offerings. The Program Manager will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, fostering partnerships, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to achieve revenue and growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Market Expansion
Develop and implement strategic programs to drive business growth in key logistics & SME markets.
Identify and assess new business opportunities, including partnerships, contracts, and expansion into new regions or service lines.
Conduct market research to stay current with industry trends, competitor activity, and customer needs.
Program Strategy & Execution:
Lead cross-functional initiatives to create, launch, and optimize programs that enhance customer acquisition and retention.
Define clear program goals, KPIs, and timelines to ensure successful execution of business development initiatives.
Manage programs from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with the company's revenue and growth goals.
Client Relationship Management:
Collaborate closely with the sales and customer service teams to develop tailored solutions that meet client needs.
Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews to gather feedback and identify potential areas for additional services.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination:
Partner with internal teams (operations, marketing, and finance) to design, promote, and deliver value-added solutions.
Data Analysis & Performance Tracking:
Use data and analytics to track program effectiveness, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations.
Prepare reports on program outcomes, revenue impact, and market expansion, presenting insights to senior leadership.
Leverage CRM tools to maintain a detailed pipeline of business opportunities and track progress against revenue targets.
Budget Management & ROI Analysis:
Oversee program budgets, managing costs to ensure maximum return on investment.
Regularly assess the ROI of business development initiatives and recommend adjustments as needed to maximize profitability.
Identify cost-saving opportunities that do not compromise service quality or hinder growth objectives.
Skills:
Strong strategic planning and decision-making abilities.
Min 1-2yrs exp in program management, driving projects, cross-functional collaboration
Data-driven with strong analytical and reporting skills.
Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA).
Highly organized, with strong multitasking skills and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.

- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.

- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.

- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.

- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.

- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Description:
Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (eg, transportation, reservations, dry cleaning) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers.
Respond to special requests from guests with unique needs and follow up to ensure satisfaction.
Gather, summarize, and provide information to guests about the property and the surrounding area amenities, including special events and activities.
Answer, record, and process all guest calls, messages, requests, questions, or concerns.
Contact appropriate individual or department (eg, Bell person, Housekeeping) as necessary to resolve guest call, request, or problem.
Review shift logs/daily memo books and document pertinent information in logbooks.
Ensure that any outstanding requests from the previous day receive priority and are resolved.
Monitor inventory and order general office supplies.
Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be responsible for managing the daily operations of the front office, housekeeping, and guest services teams, and ensuring overall room division efficiency. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a senior hotel management role, ideally as a Room Division Manager or similar position.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-focused approach.
Strong knowledge of front office, housekeeping, and guest services operations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and financial reporting.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee front office operations: Manage front desk functions, including check-in/out, guest relations, and conflict resolution
Manage housekeeping operations: Oversee daily room assignments, monitor cleaning performance through inspections, and ensure readiness of guest rooms
Deliver guest service excellence: Ensure high-quality, consistent guest experiences by upholding brand standards and resolving issues with creativity, discretion, and sound judgment
Oversee service operations: Ensure Front Office and Housekeeping systems and procedures support exceptional service, smooth check-in/check-out, and room readiness
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Maintenance and operation of plant utilities like Air compressor, Chillers, Heat pumps, Hot water system, Water system, HVAC systems, Nitrogen plant, HSD yard,Gensets, cooling towers, boilers, NG stations,Transformers, HT switchyards,Electrical systems,Mechanical systems and other utilities related systems.
2. Provide the maintenance support to the QC/Micro area, Fire pump house, ETP, Solvent storage yard and other non manufacuturing areas as applicable.
3. Carrying out the Preventiva maintenance, Building maintenance, AMC,CAMC,Breakdown maintenance, predctive maintenance,Safety complinace inspections.
4. Support Engineers & Technician in carrying out Functional Engineering, maintenance, repair and Planning, Detailed Scheduling and Execution to- ensure continuity of availability of plant & equipment at optimal cost, achieve standard capacity, ensure overall plant & equipment integrity & reliability in compliance with Teva Standards & Procedures.
5. Reporting of daily MIS, Incidents & Deviations and other observations.
6. Execute maintenance activities in a shift by managing available resources to achieve shift maintenance plan.
7. Upkeep the Equipment availability by analysing and reducing the breakdowns.
8. Keep the facility in good condition with proper building maintenance.
9. Determine needed resources (manpower, equipment and materials) from start to finish with attention to budgetary limitations
10. Execute the Engineering & Maintenance activities in the plant & ensure timely delivery of AOP within the given budget, also having an In-depth understanding of Operation and maintenance procedures and project management principles.
11. Support Engineers/technicians, Managers & contractors in carrying out, operation and maintenance planning, detailed scheduling and material ordering-delivery, project workflow and documentation.
12. Ensure all legal, health and safety regulations are being followed.
13. Working as per cGMP guideline and upkeep the facility and all time readiness for audit.
14. Implementing improvement programs and its changes.
15. Identifying the critical spares, consumables for the service floor area and keep them in stock.
16. Lead contractors/vendor/OEMs and non-payroll manpower. Also, define their tasks and required resources.
17. Assist Utility lead to achieve the Department goals and AOP.
18. Contractor onboarding as per site compliance and site timelines.
19. Lead procurements and invoicing of the assigned area and adhere the compliances. (Monitor invoices for accuracy and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.)
20. Track activities & deliverables, and prepare weekly and monthly reports.
21. Lead GEP documentation like qualification, validation, change management, Project management and other quality-related engineering documentation.
22. Develop effective ways to measure and analyze the operation and maintenance progress. Common strategies for documenting a maintenance & operation include data collection and verbal and written status reports.
23. Evaluate and identify the Energy savings projects, simplifications of procedures, revising the procedures or processes to eliminate the non-value added works.
24. Implementation of contractor safety and induction, also routine evaluation of safe practices.
25. Use the problem solving tools to find out the root cause of any failure and implement the CAPA accordingly
26. Responsbile to take care all other activities assigned by Reporting manager and HOD.
27. Keep self-updated on regulatory guidelines and product regulatory requirements of all markets to which product manufactured by the Site is exported.
28. Connect with various OEMs, Facility maintenance, Industry Bodies, Statutory Bodies to complete the deliverables.
29. Ensures the Periodical boiler, Electrical and other statury inspection readiness and it‘s compliances.
30. Represent the utility area for all audits.

- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to ensure adequate supplies.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and ensures compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.

- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.

Description:
Manages all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection.
Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation.
Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements.
Assists in leading the emergency response team for all facility issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 1 year experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets
- Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems.
- Ensures regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
- Manages and controls heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations.
- Develops specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs.
- Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion.
- Oversees and directs the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities.
- Develops a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan.
- Develops project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs.
- Contacts contractors for bids and supervising construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.
- Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors.
- Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
- Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition.
- Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction.
- Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.
- Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
- Selects and orders or purchasing new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.
Maintaining Property Standards
- Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.
- Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.
- Strives to improve service performance.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job description

About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What Youll Do

Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What Were Looking For

0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?

Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.

If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets

Job Title: Guest Relations Executive / Senior Guest Relations Executive

Location: Auroville, Pondicherry, Bangalore, Kasol, Coorg, Chikmangluru, Civil Lines Jaipur, Vagataur Goa, Baga Goa, Alibagh Maharastra, Panjim Goa, Delhi, Gurgaon

Employment Type
Full-time

Job Functions
Customer Service

Skills
We are looking for a Guest Relations Executive / Senior Guest Relations Executive to join our team at goSTOPS, India's fastest-growing backpacker hostel brand. As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for ensuring an exceptional guest experience at our properties in North India, fostering a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere for all visitors.

Roles and Responsibilities
Guest Services: Greet and welcome guests with a pleasant demeanor, providing excellent
customer service throughout their stay.
Front Desk Operations: Manage check-ins and check-outs efficiently, ensuring accurate
completion of all necessary documentation.
Communication: Handle phone calls, messages, and inquiries, redirecting them to relevant
departments when necessary.
Administrative Support: Maintain and organize files, records, and documents, updating them as
needed. Create and manage spreadsheets for reporting and operational needs.
Property Management Support:
Conduct inventory checks and maintain records.
Assist in the procurement of monthly supplies.
Step in as the property in-charge during the absence of the property manager.
Food and Beverage Assistance: Support the service of food and beverages to ensure guest
satisfaction.
Bookkeeping Assistance: Issue invoices, checks, and assist in basic bookkeeping tasks.
Cross-Location Travel: Be willing to travel to other properties in South and West India when
required.
Qualifications/Knowledge/Experience
A minimum of 6 months of industrial training or relevant experience in hospitality.
A pleasant personality and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Final-year student or graduate from a Hotel Management program is preferred.
Flexibility and enthusiasm for traveling across our properties.
What We Offer
Compensation: A competitive salary, plus PLI, Provident Fund, and ESIC.
Performance Incentives: Performance-linked incentives of up to 35% of the gross salary.
Additional Perks: Complimentary accommodation and meals provided by the company.
The opportunity to work at multiple PAN India locations with a focus on North regions.
If you are passionate about hospitality, have a positive attitude, and love meeting new people, we
encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Be part of our team and help us continue to provide unique and unforgettable experiences for our guests!

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the ficial performance in areas of responsibility.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the spa, guest services, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Spa Operations and Budgets

- Ensures all employees have the proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the ficial management of department.
