POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) will hold a senior academic and clinical faculty role at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will lead undergraduate and postgraduate medical teaching in forensic pathology, forensic toxicology, medical jurisprudence, and forensic evidence, while overseeing mortuary operations, toxicology laboratory supervision, and medico-legal case management. This is a faculty leadership role requiring a highly experienced academic with strong publication credentials, deep NMC compliance, and demonstrated expertise in forensic medicine in a teaching hospital setting.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, practical sessions, clinical classes, and demonstrations in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as per university curriculum.
Conduct postgraduate (MD/DNB) classes, seminars, and case-based learning sessions in forensic pathology, toxicology, and medico-legal aspects.
Lead and supervise autopsy teaching sessions for MBBS students and PG trainees ensuring pedagogical clarity and adherence to safety and ethical standards.
Mentor postgraduate students in thesis formulation, research methodology, and case study documentation.
Participate in curriculum planning, academic assessment, and examination processes for UG and PG programmes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required, ensuring academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Supervise and oversee toxicology laboratory investigations, ensuring accuracy, chain of custody, and medico-legal compliance of specimens and reports.
Ensure proper mortuary management, including adherence to safety protocols, infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling of remains.
Conduct and supervise medico-legal autopsies, post-mortem examinations, and forensic evidence collection in accordance with legal and institutional standards.
Prepare medico-legal reports and expert opinions for courts, law enforcement agencies, and institutional authorities as required.
Liaise with judicial, police, and government agencies on medico-legal matters affecting the institution and the community.
Ensure compliance with NABH standards in all forensic and mortuary operations.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC criteria, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit medical articles and forensic science commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead and contribute to departmental research initiatives in forensic toxicology, forensic pathology, and medico-legal sciences.
Guide postgraduate students in original research and thesis work.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and quality improvement initiatives.
Participate actively in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality reviews, and institutional committees.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national conferences, and forensic medicine professional bodies.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a recognized institution.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in FMT, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for becoming Associate Professor.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education (where FMT is covered under UG training).
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Associate Professor

Department Ophthalmology

Reporting To Head of the Department / Professor

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super
Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology will serve as a senior academic and clinical faculty leader at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering advanced undergraduate and postgraduate medical education in ophthalmology, providing specialist eye care across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings, and contributing meaningfully to research and publication activities. This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.
Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.
Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.
Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.
Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.
Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.
Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.
Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.
Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.
Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.
Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.
Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education, as Ophthalmology is covered under undergraduate training.
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical & Surgical Expertise
Cataract surgery (phacoemulsification)
Glaucoma diagnosis & management
Retinal disease management
Ophthalmic emergency care
Slit-lamp & fundus examination
Surgical training & OT supervision
Academic & Research
• UG & PG medical teaching
Bedside clinical teaching
NMC regulatory compliance

PG thesis guidance & mentoring
Curriculum development
Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Team leadership & collaboration
Organised & detail-oriented
Patient-centric approach
Adaptability in teaching hospital

Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
Data Inquisitiveness

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams
Please visit our company website for further information:
https://www.db.com/company/company.html

Description:
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.

Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.

Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhinagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Locations: Bangalore | Mumbai | Pune | Gandhinagar
Experience: 6-15 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 90 Days Preferred

Description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar
Mandatory Skill set - SAP CAR , UDF,Implementation


Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.
Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
Required Skills
Functional Skills
Strong experience in SAP CAR.
Hands-on experience with:
SAP UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning
Demand Forecasting
Replenishment Planning
Inventory Optimization
Retail Processes
Understanding of merchandise planning and supply chain processes.
Technical Knowledge
Knowledge of SAP HANA.
Experience with data modeling and data extraction.
Understanding of IDocs, APIs, SLT, and integration frameworks.
Basic ABAP debugging knowledge preferred.
Domain Expertise
Retail industry experience is highly preferred.
Understanding of:
Merchandise Management
Supply Chain Planning
Inventory Management
Omnichannel Retail Operations
Mandatory Qualifications
6-15 years of SAP experience.
Minimum 4+ years of SAP CAR experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP CAR implementation project.
Experience in UDF configuration and forecasting processes.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

SUMMARY
Summary:

We are seeking dynamic and customer-focused professionals to join our Greenlight Hub team in Bangalore as Customer Support Specialists. This role is central to empowering new driver partners by delivering exceptional in-person support, guiding them through onboarding, and equipping them with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. As a key member of our operations team, you will play a vital role in shaping the driver experience, ensuring smooth onboarding, resolving issues efficiently, and fostering a positive brand presence. The ideal candidate is a self-driven communicator with a passion for helping others, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proactive mindset. This is a temporary, contract position with potential for extension, offering a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization.

Experience: 0-1 year

Responsibilities:
Deliver high-quality, in-person support to driver partners during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Guide new drivers through the onboarding process and introduce them to essential tools and resources.
Troubleshoot and resolve driver-related issues promptly and effectively.
Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting the company’s values and building enthusiasm among drivers.
Stay updated on company processes, tools, and policies to ensure accurate and consistent support.
Collaborate with the Driver Operations team to identify and implement process improvements.


Requirements

Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Tamil.
Graduate degree.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.



Benefits
CTC: 22k

Description:
Company Description Simplilearn is a leading digital skills training platform that helps individuals and organizations build capabilities needed to succeed in the digital economy. The company offers rigorous online programs in rapidly evolving fields such as Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Digital Marketing, and Data Science. Courses and certifications are designed and continuously updated by more than 2,000 industry and academic experts, and delivered in partnership with world-renowned universities. Simplilearn focuses on practical, applied learning through thousands of live classes each month and real-world projects, enabling millions of professionals to gain work-ready skills and supporting organizations with corporate training and employee upskilling. This learner-centric approach has helped a majority of participants achieve promotions or new roles in their careers.

Role Description:
The Student Advisor (Sales) will support prospective learners through the entire admission and enrollment journey, with a focus on consultative selling and student guidance. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with leads via calls, emails, and messages, understanding learners goals, recommending suitable programs, and clearly explaining course features, pricing, and outcomes. The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, following up on inquiries, meeting enrollment and revenue targets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve learner experience. Student Advisors will also provide basic counseling on career paths, program selection, and learning formats while ensuring high-quality customer service. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bangalore Urban.

Qualifications
Candidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and customer service skills to build trust, handle queries, and manage learner relationships effectively.
Candidates should possess student counseling skills and education-related understanding to guide learners on program selection and career pathways.
Candidates should possess clear and confident communication skills, including spoken and written English, to conduct professional sales and advisory conversations.
Candidates should possess basic sales, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, with a track record of meeting targets in inside sales or similar roles.
Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with CRM tools, comfort with night/US shifts, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Regards

Job Description: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant (4 to 10 Years)
Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.
Provide end-user training and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.
Required Skills
4 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows

Description:
Job Description Inside Sales Executive
Company: NoBroker.com
Department: Sales – Supply RM
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)
Languages Required: English, Hindi, and a Regional Language
Role Overview
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Inside Sales Executive to manage customers who have already enrolled in a plan through the Supply RM team. The role involves understanding customer property requirements, recommending suitable properties, managing follow-ups, conducting negotiations, and driving property visits and deal closures while ensuring an excellent customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Connect with customers who have enrolled in a plan through the Supply RM team.
Understand customer requirements, including location, budget, property type, preferences, and timelines.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the property search journey.
Recommend suitable properties based on customer needs and preferences.
Explain property details, features, pricing, and other relevant information.
Address customer queries, concerns, and objections effectively.
Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain customer engagement and drive conversions.
Coordinate with internal teams to identify and provide suitable property options.
Encourage customers to schedule property visits and progress toward transactions.
Negotiate effectively to convert sales opportunities into successful property deals.
Take ownership of the customer journey from lead allocation to deal closure.
Maintain accurate customer, lead, follow-up, and sales records in the CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales and conversion targets.
Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
Requirements & Qualifications
Any Graduate or Postgraduate preferred.
Experience in Inside Sales, Real Estate Sales, Property Sales, B2C Sales, or Telesales is preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer relationship management and customer-handling abilities.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate property options.
Good negotiation, persuasion, objection-handling, and sales-closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and organizational skills.
Familiarity with CRM systems and sales processes.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Conversion rate from enrolled leads to property visits.
Number of successful property deal closures.
Achievement of daily and monthly sales targets.
Customer follow-up effectiveness and lead conversion rate.
Customer satisfaction and overall sales performance.
Preferred Skills
Customer relationship management
Consultative selling
Real estate market and property knowledge
Lead nurturing and follow-up
Negotiation and objection handling
CRM management
Target achievement and sales conversion
Work Location: Bangalore, Karnataka
Work Arrangement: Work From Office (WFO)

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Job Title: Senior Sales Manager Steel Industry
Location: Bhubaneswar, Jamshedpur, Mumbai, Bangalore
Industry: Steel
Experience: 7+ Years
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Experience: 3 to 5 Years | 5 to 9 Years | 9 to 18 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid

Roles & Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Sales & Distribution and Customer Service processes.
Configure and implement SAP S/4HANA SD solutions based on business needs.
Design and support Vistex solutions for rebates, chargebacks, incentives, claims, and pricing programs.
Work on Customer Service (CS) processes including service orders, warranty management, and service contracts.
Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, and enhancement projects.
Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including MM, FI, PP, and technical teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support developments, integrations, and interfaces.
Conduct client workshops, provide solution recommendations, and support go-live activities.
Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and project standards.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD).
Mandatory experience in Vistex.
Mandatory experience in SAP Customer Service (CS).
Strong knowledge of:
Order-to-Cash (O2C)
Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs
Minimum one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation project.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Integration knowledge with MM, FI, and other SAP modules.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal apprenticeship or regional training program, assists with facilities changes and improvements; assists with maintaining relationships with various suppliers and vendors of services provided to the facility; communicates changes and improvements to affected facility occupants. Performs activities under direct supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Supports coordination with facilities management to schedule work and special projects for the assigned facility. Assists with planning for changes and improvements; assist with schedules and implements plan. Helps with developing, documenting, and reporting budgets for approval process; creates and writes purchase orders; approves payment of invoices. Assists to update, edit and print CAD layouts and master plans; assist with managing floor space and office space all locations within master plan. Assists with organizing installation of communications equipment with internal and external suppliers and customers. Participates in improvement processes; actively participates in self-and team audits and resulting process improvements. Works under close supervision according to defined facility procedures/processes. Attends classes and on/off site training programs (travel if required) and makes appropriate progress necessary to build basic skills and knowledge required to pass local certification.
Manage the Plant Manager s calendar, meetings, appointments, and priorities.
Coordinate daily morning meetings, including collection, consolidation, and presentation of key plant data and updates.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting information for Plant Leadership meetings.
Coordinate meetings with Plant Leadership Team members and stakeholders across different plant locations.
Record meeting minutes, decisions, and action items, and follow up with respective owners for timely closure.
Prepare and maintain MIS, dashboards, trackers, and management reports as required.
Coordinate communication and information flow between the Plant Manager and key functional stakeholders.
Support the Plant Manager during plant visits, leadership reviews, audits, and other important meetings/events.
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and employee information.
Identify opportunities to improve meeting effectiveness, reporting, and administrative processes.
Coordinate EEEC activities at the plant level.
Coordinate purchase of required materials and services for plant visits, meetings, and other important forums/events.

The responsibilities outlined above are indicative and not limited to the listed activities. Additional responsibilities may be assigned based on business and organizational requirements.
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Emergency Preparedness - Plans, manages and supports the site s emergency preparedness program; identifies risks and develops a risk management plan to address incidents such as power outage, flood, and fire; manages the maintenance of emergency systems for fire and flood protection; reports any system impairments.

Facilities Maintenance - Assesses the condition of the facility including its systems, structure, interiors, exteriors and grounds; manages facility operations and maintenance activities; develops and operates asset management systems for Preventative Maintenances that uses criticality analysis, predictive tools and prioritization.

Facilities Operation - Manages occupant services (parking, janitorial services, food services, concierge, facility helpdesk, security and safety); manages the maintenance contracting process; develops and manages the facility s operational planning requirements (temperature control, lighting, equipment replacement, water treatment and so forth).

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

As part of Cummins Inc., a global leader in engine technology, the plant contributes to the design and production of diesel and alternative fuel engines, supporting diverse applications in automotive, industrial, and power generation sectors. Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Below is a summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department:
Sales and Distribution Management
Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.

Description:
About Organisation
Tata Power runs four electricity distribution companies (Discoms) in Odisha through a public-private partnership with the state government. Formed as 51:49 joint ventures between Tata Power and the Government of Odisha, these utilities supply reliable power to nearly 10 million consumers across the state.

The Four Odisha Discoms
TPCODL (TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPNODL (TP Northern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPSODL (TP Southern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPWODL (TP Western Odisha Distribution Limited)

This Position will be based at TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited, Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Job Purpose
TPCODL is seeking an experienced and strategic finance leader to head key finance functions including Budgeting, Capital Expenditure (Capex), Treasury Management, Insurance, and Enterprise Risk Management.
The role requires a seasoned Chartered Accountant with strong financial planning, regulatory, and stakeholder management capabilities, preferably from power, infrastructure, utilities, manufacturing, or large corporate environments.

Key Responsibilities
Budgeting & Financial Planning
Lead the annual budgeting process and long-term financial planning across functions.
Monitor budget utilization and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Drive budgeting reviews, variance analysis, forecasting, and financial performance reporting.
Present budget insights and recommendations to senior management.
Capital Expenditure (Capex) Management.
Evaluate and monitor Capex proposals, business cases, and investment decisions.
Establish controls to ensure optimum utilization of capital investments.
Track project-wise Capex spending against approved budgets.
Support management in capital allocation and investment prioritization.

Treasury Management
Manage organizational liquidity, cash flow planning, and working capital requirements.
Optimize fund deployment and borrowing arrangements.
Maintain relationships with banks, financial institutions, and lenders.
Ensure compliance with treasury policies and financial covenants.
Insurance Management
Design and manage the organization's insurance portfolio.
Assess insurance requirements for operational and strategic risks.
Coordinate renewals, claims management, and policy negotiations.
Liaise with insurers, brokers, and internal stakeholders to ensure adequate coverage.

Enterprise Risk Management
Develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies.
Identify, evaluate, and mitigate financial, operational, and strategic risks.
Drive risk assessments and monitor risk mitigation plans across functions.
Report key risk indicators and risk exposures to leadership.

Financial Governance & Compliance
Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory, taxation, and corporate governance requirements.
Support internal and external audits related to treasury, risk, and financial controls.
Strengthen internal controls and financial governance practices.
Monitor changes in regulations impacting finance operations.

Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders to support strategic decision-making.
Engage with auditors, banks, regulators, insurers, and external consultants.
Build and mentor a high-performing finance team.

Educational Qualification
Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI (Mandatory).

Experience
12+ years of progressive experience in Finance.
Strong expertise in Budgeting, Capex Management, Treasury Operations, Insurance, and Risk Management.
Experience in Utilities, Power Distribution
Proven experience in managing large budgets and strategic finance initiatives.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.


Duties and Responsibilities


General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

Description:
Application Engineer - Drill Bits
Would you like to help customers improve drilling performance and economics through innovative drill-bit solutions
Are you an engineering graduate ready to start or grow your career in application engineering
Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company. We provide innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the energy value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, we combine deep industry expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With more than a century of experience, we partner with customers across oil and gas, industrial, and emerging energy markets to help advance a more sustainable energy future.
Fuel your passion
As an Application Engineer for Drill Bits, you will provide technical and application support to customers and internal teams. You will use engineering analysis, field data, and collaborative problem-solving to recommend drill-bit solutions, improve drilling performance, and support business growth. This role is suitable for a fresh engineering graduate or an early-career professional who is eager to learn and develop within the drill-bit industry.
As an Application Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Providing technical support for drill-bit products and applications
Supporting the implementation of product strategies, engineering standards, and best practices across the assigned market and the wider Asia-Pacific region
Working with the sales team to develop account strategies, identify opportunities, and support profitable growth
Preparing drill-bit proposals, application engineering studies, design recommendations, drilling-parameter guidance, and vibration-mitigation recommendations
Analyzing drilling data and product performance to identify opportunities for performance improvement
Collaborating with customers and Baker Hughes design engineers to adapt existing products or develop new designs for specific applications
Investigating unusual or unsatisfactory product performance, identifying root causes, and recommending preventive and corrective actions
Supporting field activities and visiting rig sites when required
To be successful in this role, you will:
Hold a bachelor s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university
Be a fresh engineering graduate or have one to two years of relevant work experience
Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills
Be able to prepare clear technical information and confidently support customer and internal discussions
Have an interest in the drill-bit industry and a willingness to develop knowledge of its products, technologies, markets, competitors, and customers
Be fluent in spoken and written and English Hindi
Be able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams
Be willing to travel to customer locations and rig sites when required
Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that people perform at their best in different ways. In this role, we can offer the following working arrangements:
A standard five-day working schedule, with occasional field trips to rig sites
Hybrid working, subject to business needs and manager approval
Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We are at our best when our people are developed, engaged, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, develop and reward talent, and build leaders at every level so that we can bring out the best in one another.

Working for you

Our innovations have transformed the energy industry for more than a century. To continue progressing, we must keep pushing boundaries. We reward people who embrace change and contribute to our success with a package that reflects how much we value their contribution. When you join us, you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and well-being activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Services Professional - Applications Engineering

Role & responsibilities
Instruments Maintenance as per schedules decided by the Instrument In charge.
Periodic and need based maintenance (PM, BM, Plant S/D maint.), of Pneumatic, Electronic, Mechanically operated, Hydraulically operated, instruments.
All types of Control Valves, Solenoid valves, Hydraulic Valves, Electric Motor or Coil operated Valves, Controlled speed Motors for (Bagging /Robots), Pneumatic, Hydraulic(e.g.Power cylinders), Electrically operated Cylinders. Damper movement operating devices.
Undertake regular & periodic plant rounds for checking/ensuring healthy operating conditions and taking corrective actions wherever required in all plant areas, Control rooms, DCS Panels, Analysers/GC, weighbridges, Ambient Air Monitoring Stations and weather monitoring station. Bagging Machines, Robotic Palletisers, Process and Air Compressors, Tank Farm Areas etc.
Pneumatic Tubing (SS, Copper, Aluminum, MS, Nylon, PVC, Teflon, Metallic or Non-metallic) laying, Termination, Connecting, Disconnecting, Removal, Modifying, Protecting, cleaning, Draining, etc
Trip Logic checking, Interlock Checking, Plant Health Checks as and when required by Operation / Instrument Depts. from time to time is the responsibility of Instrument Technician.
Maintenance of Analytical Instruments used to analyze plant processes quality analysis. This includes repairs, Commissioning, De-commissioning and transportation of analytical Instruments.

Preferred candidate profile
Skills in fault diagnosis and rectification of individual Instruments, all Control Loops (pneumatic or Electrical/Electronic), Bagging machines and weighbridges, routine interlock checking.
Technical skills for cost effective and quality repairs of all instruments. To monitor general health of field instruments, DCS systems, SCADA Systems, other types of Control Systems and weighbridges.
Awareness of Job hazards and job safety in his area of work. and use of Personal Safety. Equipments.
Basic knowledge of pneumatic, electronic and analytical instruments.
Basic knowledge of relevant control systems DCS, PLC, SCADA, Vibration monitoring systems.
Diploma in Electronics or Instrumentation

Job Title: Evaluation Engineer
Company: CARS24
Locations: Bhubaneswar (Odisha), Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh), Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Maharashtra)
Function: Procurement / Vehicle Inspection
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary
The Evaluation Engineer inspects and evaluates used cars for purchase at customer locations and hubs. The role ensures accurate, SOP-compliant inspections and a fair price recommendation for every car.

Key Responsibilities
Inspect used cars as per assigned leads and appointments, following the company SOP.
Check engine, transmission, suspension, interiors, exteriors, structural condition and documents.
Record all findings accurately in the CARS24 inspection app.
Estimate repair needs and recommend a fair market price based on the inspection.
Explain inspection results and pricing clearly and professionally to customers.
Test-drive vehicles (manual and automatic) as part of the evaluation.
Meet daily inspection targets and keep turnaround time (TAT) on track.
Travel within the city and nearby areas for field inspections.
Coordinate with the procurement and operations teams for smooth deal closure.

Requirements
Diploma, ITI or degree in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering (preferred), or relevant experience.
Basic knowledge of vehicle mechanics, engines and car components.
Valid two-wheeler and four-wheeler driving license, and the ability to drive both.
Smartphone and willingness to use inspection apps.
Good communication skills in the local language plus basic Hindi/English.
Prior experience as a service advisor, mechanic, technician or car evaluator is an advantage.
Willingness to do field work and travel locally.


What CARS24 Offers
Fixed salary with performance incentives (exact band as per current approved CTC for each location).
Structured training and onboarding.
Growth opportunities within procurement and operations.
AboutCompany: CARS24 is Indias leading e-commerce platform for pre-owned vehicles, revolutionizing the way people buy and sell cars. We are driven by technology, operational excellence, and a strong commitment to delivering quality and value to our customers. As we continue to grow, we seek dedicated professionals who share our vision of transforming mobility across the country.
CompanyAddress: Tower B, 10th Floor, Unitech Cyber Park, Sector 39, Sector 39, Gurgaon, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Job Title: Blue Collar Recruiter
Job Industry: Recruitment / Staffing
Job Locations: Gorakhpur, Patna, Murshidabad, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Delhi & Kolkata
Job Summary
We are looking for target-oriented Blue Collar Recruiters to source and recruit skilled and semi-skilled workers for domestic and international projects, especially in the construction sector.
Key Responsibilities
Source candidates such as Masons, Electricians, Welders, Plumbers, Carpenters, Fabricators, Drivers, and other blue-collar workers.
Source candidates through ITIs, contractors, vendors, referrals, field visits, and local networks.
Screen candidates and verify their skills, experience, licences, and documents, as applicable.
Coordinate interviews, trade tests, recruitment drives, and candidate mobilization.
Build a strong candidate pipeline and maintain regular follow-ups.
Achieve recruitment targets and maintain candidate records.

Requirements
Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in Gulf recruitment, primarily in blue-collar, construction, driver, or field recruitment verticals.
Good understanding of skilled and semi-skilled manpower sourcing.
Strong networking, communication, and coordination skills.
Only Male candidates may apply.
Existing contacts with contractors, ITIs, vendors, or manpower suppliers will be an advantage.
Target-oriented approach and willingness to travel locally for recruitment activities.

Description:
Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.
