Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Group Company: Marks and Spencer Reliance India Private Limited

Designation: Store Manager

Office Location:

Position description: As a Store Manager, you will lead the operations of your business unit while ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers. Your key responsibilities will include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Operational Leadership:

? Day-to-Day Management: Oversee the smooth running of the store, maintaining high standards across all operations, and ensuring legal compliance, particularly regarding pricing and product display.

? Procedure Adherence: Execute operational procedures efficiently, ensuring consistency and excellence in areas such as housekeeping, fitting rooms, and checkout processes.

? Quality Control: Monitor product quality, address any issues swiftly, and communicate feedback to the merchandising team to uphold superior product standards.

2. Sales Performance Management:

? Target Achievement: Drive and monitor the achievement of sales goals for your department. You?ll also play a key role in setting realistic yet ambitious targets, with the flexibility to adapt based on performance trends.

? Sales Analysis: Track sales performance continuously, taking timely corrective actions when necessary to meet or exceed sales objectives.

? Team Communication: Regularly share updates on department, store, and regional performance with your team, ensuring transparency and motivating everyone towards common goals.

3. Customer Experience:

? Customer Service Excellence: Lead by example in delivering exceptional customer service, creating a welcoming atmosphere for every visitor.

? Building Relationships: Understand customer needs, cultivate rapport, and establish loyal relationships with key clientele.

? Handling Feedback: Take ownership of customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions that turn challenges into positive outcomes.

4. Visual Merchandising Store Presentation:

? Merchandising Standards: Ensure that all visual merchandising guidelines are followed to create an attractive and engaging shopping environment.

? Continuous Improvement: Provide constructive feedback to visual merchandisers to enhance the store's visual appeal and product presentation.

5. Shrinkage Inventory Control:

? Loss Prevention: Implement best practices to minimize shrinkage by training staff on merchandise handling and stock protection, safeguarding store assets.

6. Team Development Leadership:

? Training Development: Facilitate on-the-job training, product knowledge sessions, and visual merchandising workshops to equip your team with the skills needed for success.

? Role Clarity Task Delegation: Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each team member, ensuring accountability and efficient task management.

? Constructive Feedback: Regularly provide feedback that helps your team identify strengths and areas for improvement, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.

? Motivation Engagement: Inspire your team to not only meet sales targets but also to follow operational procedures with enthusiasm and dedication.

7. Cashier Support Training:

? Support Supervision: Assist in the training of cashiers and provide ongoing support to ensure smooth operations at checkout, contributing to a positive customer experience.

Job Description for Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals:

As a Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals, you will play a key role in promoting and selling our healthcare services to potential patients and clients. Your primary responsibilities will include identifying sales opportunities, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and providing exceptional customer service. You will work closely with the healthcare team to understand our offerings and effectively communicate the benefits of our services to customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Engage with potential patients and provide them with detailed information about healthcare services offered by Manipal Hospitals.
- Conduct market research to identify prospective clients and generate leads.
- Develop and maintain relationships with referral sources, such as physicians and community organizations.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional materials and campaigns that highlight our services.
- Meet and exceed sales targets and objectives.
- Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system.
- Attend industry events and health fairs to represent Manipal Hospitals and connect with potential clients.
- Provide feedback to the management team on market trends and customer needs.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent negotiation and persuasive abilities.
- Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to providing exceptional service.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in healthcare or a related field, is a plus.
- Knowledge of healthcare services and an understanding of the sales process.

Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and stakeholders. This role is critical in promoting our healthcare services and driving patient engagement. The Sales Associate will collaborate closely with various teams to enhance service delivery and ensure customer satisfaction.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dynamic sales team dedicated to expanding Manipal Hospitals' reach in the healthcare market. The team comprises skilled professionals who are passionate about providing exceptional service and support to patients. Collaboration and a customer-centric approach are key values within the team.

You are Responsible for:
Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within the healthcare sector.
Achieving sales targets and contributing to the overall growth of Manipal Hospitals.
Building and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals, patients, and other stakeholders.
Conducting market research to understand customer needs and competitive landscape.
Participating in promotional events and activities to raise awareness about the services offered.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
A strong background in sales, preferably in the healthcare industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients.
Strong analytical skills to assess market trends and customer needs.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive and positive attitude, along with a passion for healthcare service.
AboutCompany: Manipal Health Enterprises, commonly known as Manipal Hospitals, is an Indian for-profit private hospital network headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka. The hospitals trace their origins to the Kasturba Medical College, founded by T. M. A. Pai in 1953.

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers

Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

right time to pitch the recommended solutions

Storeupkeep& maintenance

Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies

Job Description:
Role 1:
Job Title: Apprentice Role for Non-Technology hiring 2024 - 2025
Location: Bangalore
Role Description
The position is for an Apprenticeship - PB Operations based out of Mumbai and reporting to the Head, Controls - Operations (NPC).
Your key responsibilities
Tracking deadlines for Key Operating document (KOD) for PB Operations and follow-ups with stakeholders for timely upload of KODs on policy portal.
Go through existing KODs and liaise with Ops to understand the process followed on ground. Highlight deviations if any and re-draft / modify KODs.
Design Publication of trackers on TAT Quality parameters.
Revisit Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for each Ops related process and modify / re-define time and motion.
Follow-up and publication of End of Day checklist for Operations.
Assist in drafting BRDs for Ops and follow-up on deliverables with stakeholders to ensure timelines are met.
Reconciling of vendor bills.
Other Operations related activities which may be assigned from time to time.
Your skills and experience
Good knowledge of Excel, Word, and Power point presentation.
Excellent communication skills.
Education | Certification (Recommended):
Bachelor Degree from an accredited college or university
Education/ Qualifications
Minimum Graduation in any stream.
How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

Job Title: Field Sales Executive

We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles. As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 18-20 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions
Variable compensation based on sales performance


Training:
45-day comprehensive training in Whitefield, Bangalore on eye checkups and sales techniques


Requirements:
Graduate
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skill
Ability to lift and carry equipment (18 -20 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license


What We Offer:
Opportunity to work with India's leading eyewear brand
Competitive compensation and incentives
Comprehensive training and support
Chance to make a difference in customers' lives through vision care

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
Master Nokia's IP Portfolio: Develop comprehensive expertise in Nokia's Internet Protocol (IP) networking solutions-including the 7750 Service Router (SR) family, 7250 Interconnect Router (IXR), 7705 Service Aggregation Router (SAR), 7210 Service Access Switch (SAS), and Network Services Platform (NSP)-and confidently present their capabilities to customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Bachelor degree with 10-15 years of relevant experience.
Delivers short-term impact through individual and team contributions within the assigned function or subject area.

Makes decisions, prioritises work, and executes plans to meet business and customer needs.
Leads people and oversees processes where applicable, ensuring effective execution of plans and policies.

Communicates effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and senior leaders

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Title
Customer Service Assistant
Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations.
Key Deliverables
Essential functions & Responsibilities of the Job:
Greet & Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.

Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.

On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia
Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option
Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity
We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities
Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments
Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments
Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Job Summary
Endo Mechanical and Intelligent Devices (EMID) offers a comprehensive portfolio of surgical technologies, including open and laparoscopic stapling systems, ligation devices, access and hand instruments, powered stapling platforms, and intelligent surgical solutions. The team partners with surgeons, operating theatre staff, and healthcare institutions to support the adoption of advanced surgical technologies and improve procedural outcomes.
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding product adoption, and managing customer relationships for the Endo Mechanical and Intelligent Devices portfolio within assigned government hospital accounts across Jaipur, Bikaner Ajmer territory. The role combines territory business management, clinical support, account development, and engagement with key healthcare stakeholders to achieve commercial and strategic objectives. This role is based in Jaipur, India, supporting government and public healthcare accounts across Jaipur, Bikaner Ajmer. The position is field-based and requires regular travel within the city to support customer engagement, operating theatre coverage, product evaluations, training, and account development activities.


Responsibilities
Achieve territory sales objectives by driving product utilisation, secondary sales growth, and focus product performance across assigned government hospital accounts.
Develop and execute account plans for priority customers to increase market penetration and expand portfolio adoption.
Build and maintain relationships with surgeons, operating theatre personnel, procurement teams, and hospital decision-makers.
Provide clinical support in operating theatres, including product demonstrations, evaluations, and procedural assistance as required.
Collect, analyse, and utilise market, procedure, customer, and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities and support territory planning.
Establish and maintain professional relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), medical associations, and Centres of Excellence (COEs) within the territory.
Partner with regional and marketing teams to organise Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and approved customer engagement initiatives.
Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activities, forecasts, account updates, and required business trackers.


Required Knowledge and Experience
High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience
OR Associate s Degree AND 4+ years experience
OR Bachelor s Degree AND 2+ years experience


Preferred
Experience selling surgical stapling technologies or other advanced surgical / MedTech devices.
Experience managing government private hospital accounts of Rajasthan Medical corporation and public healthcare procurement processes.
Knowledge of surgical procedures, operating theatre workflows, and clinical decision-making environments.
Experience establishing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), medical associations, and Centres of Excellence (COEs).
Strong analytical skills with experience using market and customer insights to develop territory growth strategies.


Physical Job Requirements

Business Development Executive

Responsibilities:
Merchant Acquisition: Onboard new OMC merchants' basis understanding of transaction volume and pattern in the assigned geography.

Relationship Management & Servicing: Engage with identified merchants to strengthen relationship with these merchants and onboard them on more value added products and services .

Account Management: The PAE's task is to develop a deep understanding and relationship with each account that any competitor finds it an uphill task to onboard the merchant account.

Competition Mapping: Study, map and report competition activity in assigned geography basis geographical or category based initiatives to enable faster response.

12th+ education qualification.
Good Communication and influencing skills.
Should have a driving license and two wheeler.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
  Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered.
Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately.
Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal. Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure.
Managing cash (system & physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures.
Create new CUID in system &modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments & LoanClosure.
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents.
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.
  Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service.
CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4.20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Job Summary
Responsible for developing and growing business opportunities within an assigned sales territory, market segment, or channel. Builds and maintains strong customer relationships, understands customer needs and buying processes, and positions Cummins products, solutions, and services to deliver customer value and achieve business objectives.
The role involves prospecting for new opportunities, developing and executing account plans, managing the sales pipeline, achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate forecasts, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and sustainable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
Identify, research, and develop new business opportunities by engaging prospective customers and understanding their business needs.
Develop and execute account plans for key prospects and customers to drive business growth and achieve sales objectives.
Conduct customer meetings and face-to-face sales calls to understand customer requirements, priorities, business models, and buying processes.
Build and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships to generate repeat business and identify future sales opportunities.
Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate Cummins products, solutions, and services aligned with their business requirements.
Articulate the value proposition and competitive advantages of Cummins solutions to support customer decision-making.
Conduct commercial negotiations in accordance with company guidelines, including pricing and payment terms.
Drive sales performance by achieving assigned sales targets and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.
Prepare and maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance against business targets.
Monitor pipeline health and proactively identify actions required to improve conversion and achieve sales objectives.
Maintain customer and sales activity information in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system as required.
Respond to customer concerns and queries in a timely manner and work with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
Support collection of accounts receivable and maintain an acceptable level of past-due accounts by collaborating with customers and relevant internal teams.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations, as applicable.
Consistently follow the Cummins Sales Process, tools, systems, and initiatives that support sales effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and customer value.
Monitor market and channel dynamics and identify opportunities to strengthen Cummins presence and grow the business.
Support special projects and other sales initiatives aligned with business requirements.
Employee to handle Rajasthan State sales business.
Customer Engagement and Generating New Business opportunity through New Customers.
Account Receivable management for Dealers.
Delivery Signed AOP for assigned dealership.
Analyse, Monitor Improve Dealer Parts Secondary Sales.
Working on PowerGen other Sales Initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and develops customer-centric solutions.
Business Development: Identifies and converts new business opportunities to drive growth.
Account Planning: Develops and executes account strategies aligned with business objectives and customer needs.
Sales Pipeline Management: Proactively manages the sales pipeline and prioritizes activities to achieve sales targets.
Sales Forecasting: Uses customer, market, and historical data to develop accurate sales forecasts and consumption projections.
Articulating Value Proposition: Clearly communicates the benefits and differentiated value of Cummins products, solutions, and services.
Negotiation Excellence: Uses effective negotiation techniques to achieve mutually beneficial commercial outcomes within company guidelines.
Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, customer segments, and routes to market.
Persuasion: Uses compelling and fact-based communication to influence customer decisions and gain stakeholder commitment.
Communicates Effectively: Adapts communication style and content to effectively engage customers and internal stakeholders.
Sense Making: Uses probing, diagnostic questions and available information to understand customer needs and buying behavior and translate insights into appropriate solutions.
Adapts to Target Audience: Simplifies and communicates complex information effectively for different audiences.
Integrates Customer Perspective: Incorporates customer insights into sales strategies and solutions to improve customer experience and revenue.
Action Oriented: Demonstrates urgency, ownership, energy, and enthusiasm in pursuing opportunities and addressing challenges.
Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences to achieve better business outcomes.
Qualifications
College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline .
Relevant sales experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
May require applicable licensing or compliance requirements related to export controls or sanctions regulations, depending on the role and market.
Skills Experience
Basic relevant experience in sales, business development, account management, channel sales, customer relationship management, or a related field preferred.
Strong customer relationship management and communication skills.
Ability to identify customer needs and translate them into appropriate products, solutions, or services.
Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of pricing, negotiations, and business profitability.
Ability to develop and execute account plans and manage a sales pipeline.
Ability to analyze customer and market information and use insights to support sales decisions.
Experience using CRM systems and sales tools for opportunity tracking, activity reporting, and forecasting is preferred.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external customers.
Strong problem-solving, influencing, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Willingness to travel to customer locations, channel partners, or assigned territories as required by the role.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Develop and implement quality systems across cable manufacturing processes.
Ensure compliance with IS, IEC, UL, VDE, SABS, ASNZ and other applicable standards.
Monitor incoming material quality, in-process inspections, and final product testing.
Lead NABL, BIS, customer, and certification audits.
Handle customer complaints, field failures, and CAPA implementation.
Drive Six Sigma, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and quality improvement projects.
Manage laboratory operations, routine/sample/type testing activities.
Conduct supplier quality audits and monitor corrective actions.
Prepare quality MIS, audit reports, and management review presentations.
Support New Product Development (NPD) quality validation activities.


Preferred candidate profile
Strong experience in Power Cable manufacturing quality.
Sound knowledge of cable manufacturing processes and testing.
Expertise in QMS, Quality Tools, and Process Improvement.
Hands-on experience with 8D, CAPA, FMEA, SPC, MSA, RCA, and SAP.
Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 systems.
Exposure to BIS, CPRI, ERDA, NABL and certification requirements.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
Our Spa Specialists play an important role in support of a number of vital Spa functions.
At our hotels these associates work to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with Spa services on the side.
Our Spa Specialists take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their experience.
Whether promoting Spa services or retail, scheduling reservations and confirming appointments, providing answers about services, checking in guests, or processing payments, the Spa Specialist makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Spa Specialists will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing reservation software (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance and 25 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Spa Specialists - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Planning & Performance Manager (PPM) to act as the strategic finance and performance partner for
our brewery operations. This role is pivotal in driving profitability, cost optimization, and operational
efficiency through robust budgeting, forecasting, KPI management, and performance analytics.
You will work closely with both operational and financial teams to ensure accurate planning, effective cost control, and
continuous improvement across the supply chain. This position offers end-to-end exposure to manufacturing operations
and finance, preparing you for future leadership roles.
Key Responsibilities

1. Budgeting & Cost Management
Collaborate with BU, Zone PPM, and subject matter experts to develop and manage budgets for variable and fixed
logistics costs.
Prepare annual budgets (Capex, BOM, variable & fixed costs) and monthly forecasts in collaboration with HQ and
brewery leadership.
2. Variance Analysis & forecasting:
Monitor and analyze cost variances, providing actionable insights to leadership.
Lead monthly forecasting, ensuring adherence to financial targets. Analyse risks and opportunities (R&O) to
proactively address cost deviations.
3. Cost Optimization & Capex Management:
Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or efficiency.
Build business cases, calculate ROI, and track post-implementation performance.
4. KPI Management & Data Integrity
Ensure accuracy and integrity of operational KPIs reported by brewery teams.
Benchmark performance against other breweries.
5. Reporting & Analysis
Deliver timely reports and performance reviews for leadership meetings.
Conduct data-driven analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend improvements.
6. Stakeholder Engagement & Presentations
Prepare and deliver presentations for weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews with leadership.
Partner with cross-functional teams and translate financial insights into clear operational recommendations to
ensure seamless operations.
7. Project Leadership
Lead or support transformation projects such as Power BI dashboarding, automation, and SKU rationalization.
Drive business case development and support strategic planning processes (e.g., 1YP, 3YP & 10YP Plan, S&OP).

Required Knowledge & Skills
Education & Experience
Masters degree in Business, Finance, or Cost Management.
Experience in manufacturing, beer/alco-beverage, or soft drink industry preferred.
Prior experience with SAP-based ERP systems is an advantage.

Technical Skills
Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office tools.
Experience with SAP, Power BI or similar analytics tools preferred.
Strong analytical and logical thinking; comfortable working with large, unstructured datasets.
Professional Attributes
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
High degree of ownership, self-motivation, and ethical standards.
Ability to thrive in fast-paced or ambiguous environments.
Proven ability to foresee and plan for future risks.

Description:

About this opportunity

We are looking for Circle SME role, you will drive circle-wide RAN parameter governance, network optimization, and feature management to deliver best-in-class customer experience across 4G and 5G networks. You will own and advance network performance excellence and operations through effective governance, optimization, analytics, and innovation.

What you will do

- Own the RAN parameter strategy, compliance, configuration governance, and adherence across the circle.
- Drive sustainable improvements in Accessibility, Retainability, Mobility, Handover Success Rate, Data Throughput, Capacity Utilization, VoLTE/VoNR performance, and overall customer experience.
- Lead the optimization of LTE, VoLTE, 5G NSA, and 5G SA networks.
- Evaluate, test, and roll out new vendor features and optimization initiatives.
- Perform root cause analysis for performance degradation and major customer-impacting issues, acting as the L3 subject-matter expert for critical incidents and escalations.
- Ensure alignment across Circle, Central Engineering, and vendor teams.
- Drive automation, analytics, and dashboarding for performance management.
- Improve customer experience by reducing voice-of-customer concerns and complaints.
- Enable faster resolution of performance-related incidents and successful implementation of optimization features and initiatives.

You will bring

- 8+ years of experience in RAN performance and optimization.
- Strong expertise in LTE, VoLTE, 5G NSA, and 5G SA optimization.
- Hands-on experience in RAN parameter management, parameter governance, and multi-vendor environments.
- Expertise in Ericsson and/or Nokia OSS platforms.
- Strong knowledge of mobility and congestion management, KPI analytics, and root cause analysis.
- Experience using performance measures such as Accessibility, Retainability, Handover Success Rate, VoLTE/VoNR performance, Data Throughput, Capacity Utilization, customer complaint reduction, and parameter compliance scores.
- Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, and Python is preferred.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced and fluent Japanese Team Lead to oversee daily operations, manage project deliverables, and guide a team of bilingual/multilingual professionals. In thisrole, you will act as the key liaison between Japanese clients/stakeholders and internal teams,
ensuring seamless communication, high-quality deliverables, and high operational performance.
Key Responsibilities
Team Management & Leadership
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of Japanese-speaking customer service representatives, content moderators, or specialists.

Manage team schedules, attendance, workload distribution, and overall productivity.
Client & Stakeholder Communication

Ensure accurate interpretation and translation of business requirements, guidelines, and project specs.
Quality & Operational Excellence
Monitor team outputs, SLAs, and KPIs (e.g., CSAT, response time, quality accuracy) to meet or exceed targets.
Conduct quality audits, root-cause analyses, and implement corrective action plans when needed.
Continuously optimize team processes, training materials, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Qualifications & Requirements
Language Proficiency: Native or near-native fluency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or equivalent required) and high proficiency in English (both written and spoken).
Experience: 2+ years of experience Team Lead role within BPO, customer support, IT, or localized operations.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, CRM systems Zendesk), and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana).
Soft Skills: Excellent conflict resolution, decision-making, and organizational abilities.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Deutsche Bank operates in the banking and financial services industry, offering a wide range of solutions including corporate banking, investment banking, asset management, and retail financial services. As a global institution headquartered in Germany, it provides capital markets expertise, risk management, and advisory services to corporations, governments, and individuals. With a strong presence in India and worldwide, Deutsche Bank positions itself as a trusted partner for financial innovation, global trade, and wealth management.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for enthusiastic and result-oriented MBA freshers from the 2025 and 2026 batches to join our team as Collection Manager Management Trainees. The selected candidates will be responsible for supporting collection operations for unsecured personal loans, monitoring overdue accounts, coordinating with customers for timely repayments, and ensuring collection targets are achieved while maintaining professional customer relationships.
This role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in retail lending, credit operations, and collections management.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor overdue accounts and follow up with customers for repayment of unsecured personal loans.
Contact customers through calls and other approved communication channels to remind them of pending payments.
Understand customer payment issues and coordinate with them to facilitate timely repayment.
Support collection teams in achieving monthly recovery targets and reducing delinquency.
Track overdue accounts, payment commitments, and collection performance.
Analyze collection reports and identify accounts requiring priority follow-up.
Coordinate with field collection executives, team leaders, and internal departments for effective recovery.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, payment commitments, and collection activities.
Ensure all collection activities comply with company policies, applicable RBI guidelines, and fair practices.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly collection performance reports for management review.
Eligibility Criteria
MBA / PGDM graduates from the 2025 or 2026 batch.
Freshers with a specialization in Finance, Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields are preferred.
Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.
Willingness to work in a target-driven environment.
Ability to handle customer interactions professionally and work effectively in a team.
Required Skills
Communication and negotiation skills
Customer relationship management
Analytical and decision-making skills
Target orientation and result focus
Time management and teamwork
Basic financial and numerical understanding

Description:
Role: SAP FICO / SAP Finance & Controlling / S/4HANA FICO Consultant
Experience: 4-5 Years | 5-9 Years | 9-18 Years
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli

Roles and Responsibilities
Provide expertise on SAP FICO modules such as General Ledger (GL), Cost Center Accounting, Asset Accounting, and Internal Orders.
Assist in implementing and configuring SAP FI/CO projects from initiation to go-live phase.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of financial processes within the organization.
Conduct training sessions for end-users on SAP FICO modules and provide post-implementation support.
Analyze business requirements and develop solutions using SAP CO/Controlling/Profitability Analysis tools.
Desired Candidate Profile
4-9 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or similar role.
Bachelor's degree in Any Specialization (B.Tech / B.E., CS).
Strong understanding of accountancy principles, accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, cost center accounting, asset accounting concepts.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
Job Purpose
The ITI Fitter is responsible for executing preventive and breakdown maintenance of heavy plant machinery within the AAC block manufacturing unit. The primary focus is to ensure optimum machine availability, minimize production downtime, and assist in the smooth operation of specialized concrete processing equipment

Key Responsibilities
Equipment Maintenance & Repair: Perform routine, preventive, and emergency breakdown maintenance on core AAC plant machinery, including:
Raw Material Section: Jaw crushers, ball mills, and slurry pumps.
Dosing & Mixing Unit: Weighing hoppers, heavy slurry mixers, and pouring systems.
Cutting Line: Cutting machines, wire-changing mechanisms, and tilting cranes.
Curing Section: Autoclave doors, high-pressure steam valves, pipelines, and track networks.
Utility & Handling: Conveyor belts, gearboxes, hydraulic presses, pneumatic actuators, and transfer cars
Education: ITI (Fitter / Mechanic) trade certificate passed from a recognized NCVT institute. A Diploma in Mechanical Engineering is also acceptable.

Experience: 1 to 4 years of proven hands-on experience in an AAC Block plant, Cement factory, Fly Ash plant, or heavy industrial manufacturing unit. (Freshers with exceptional practical ITI training may be considered)

Job Title: Manager - Training
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


The Manager - Training at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for developing and implementing effective training programs for staff across various departments. This role involves assessing training needs, creating instructional materials, and delivering training sessions to enhance employee skills and knowledge. The Manager will collaborate with leadership to ensure alignment of training initiatives with company goals and will evaluate the effectiveness of training programs to drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop training programs that address identified skill gaps and enhance employee performance.
- Conduct training needs assessments and work closely with department heads to tailor training initiatives.
- Facilitate training sessions using a variety of teaching methods such as presentations, workshops, and e-learning.
- Monitor and evaluate training program effectiveness through feedback and assessments.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and best practices in training and development.
- Coordinate with external training vendors and manage relationships to optimize resources.
- Prepare training manuals, guides, and other instructional materials.
- Prepare reports on training activities and present findings to senior management.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with employees at all levels.
- Proficiency in training design and delivery methodologies.
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to assess training effectiveness and implement improvements.
- Familiarity with e-learning platforms and tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Experience in the insurance or financial services industry is preferred.
- Leadership and team management skills to guide and mentor training staff.
- Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design.

This position offers an opportunity to contribute to the professional development of employees and enhance organizational capabilities at Axis Max Life Insurance.

# Job Description (JD) CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
### Stainless Steel Fabrication / Sheet Metal Manufacturing Industry

**Job Title:** CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
**Department:** Engineering, Fabrication & Operations
**Location:** [Location]
**Reporting To:** Operations Manager / Production Manager

---

## Job Summary

The CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator is responsible for developing CNC programs for laser cutting, punching, and bending machines while coordinating daily production activities across design, stores, fabrication, machining, and dispatch departments. The role ensures efficient machine utilization, material optimization, production scheduling, and on-time project execution.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### CNC Programming

- Create CNC programs for Laser Cutting, CNC Punching, and CNC Press Brake machines.
- Prepare nesting layouts to maximize sheet utilization and reduce scrap.
- Generate machine programs from CAD drawings and engineering designs.
- Optimize cutting paths and machine cycle times.
- Verify programs before production release.
- Maintain CNC program libraries and revision records.
- Support operators during program setup and troubleshooting.

### Technical & Engineering Support

- Interpret fabrication drawings, CAD files, and customer specifications.
- Coordinate with design engineers to resolve technical issues.
- Prepare production drawings and job files.
- Ensure manufacturability of designs before production release.
- Support design modifications and engineering changes.

### Operations Coordination

- Coordinate daily production schedules with fabrication and machining teams.
- Monitor work orders and production progress.
- Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, and programs.
- Coordinate between Stores, Production, Quality, and Dispatch.
- Track and expedite priority jobs to meet delivery commitments.
- Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

### Production Planning & Monitoring

- Prepare daily and weekly production plans.
- Track machine loading and capacity utilization.
- Monitor production output against targets.
- Generate production status reports for management.
- Ensure adherence to delivery schedules.

### Material Optimization

- Optimize sheet utilization through efficient nesting.
- Minimize raw material wastage and scrap generation.
- Review cutting plans for cost effectiveness.
- Coordinate material requirements with stores and purchase departments.

### Quality Control Support

- Ensure programmed dimensions conform to approved drawings.
- Support first article inspection (FAI).
- Assist in resolving dimensional and fabrication issues.
- Coordinate corrective actions for production non-conformities.

### ERP & Documentation

- Update production data in ERP systems.
- Maintain CNC program records and revision control.
- Generate production reports and machine utilization reports.
- Maintain job tracking sheets and production schedules.

### Safety & Compliance

- Follow company safety procedures and machine operating standards.
- Support implementation of 5S and lean manufacturing initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with quality management systems and SOPs.

---

## Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
- Certification in CNC Programming, CAD/CAM, or Nesting Software preferred.

---

## Experience

### Junior CNC Programmer
- 2-4 years experience

### CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
- 4-8 years experience in sheet metal fabrication and CNC programming

### Preferred Industry Experience
- Stainless Steel Fabrication
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Electrical Enclosure Manufacturing
- Pharma Equipment Manufacturing
- Food Processing Equipment Manufacturing
- Industrial Fabrication

---

## Technical Skills

### Software
- AutoCAD
- SolidWorks
- SigmaNEST
- TruTops
- Metalix
- RADAN
- NC Express
- ERP Software
- Microsoft Excel

### Machinery
- Laser Cutting Machines
- CNC Punching Machines
- CNC Press Brake Machines
- Bending Tools & Die Selection

### Technical Knowledge
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Nesting Optimization
- Fabrication Drawings
- Production Planning
- Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
- Quality Control Processes

---

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |
|------|---------|
| Production Schedule Adherence | 95% |
| Sheet Utilization Efficiency | 95% |
| CNC Program Accuracy | 98% |
| On-Time Job Release | 95% |
| Machine Utilization | 85% |
| Rework Due to Programming Errors | 1% |
| Delivery Schedule Compliance | 95% |
| ERP/Data Accuracy | 99% |

---

## Key Deliverables

- Error-free CNC programs.
- Maximum sheet utilization and reduced scrap.
- Timely release of jobs to production.
- Smooth coordination between departments.
- High machine productivity and on-time delivery.
- Accurate production tracking and reporting.

## Career Progression

**CNC Operator CNC Programmer CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator Team Lead Operations Operations Manager Plant Manager**

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.

Duties and Responsibilities


The role of the Credit Manager will require a strong understanding of industry knowledge market intelligence and underwriting processes at BFL to ensure that only credit worthy firms Individuals are extended loans in line with BFLs risk policies.

BFL is currently in the process of scaling up its new car business and the incumbent for this role is expected to bring in industry level insights from credit, risk as well as process perspective.

1. FTL 2 New Car loans

Monthly disbursements are expected to cross INR 100 Cr in these businesses by September 2018.

This role reports to the Regional Credit Manager.

This role covers pan India strategy for new car loans from sale purchase, balance transfer as well as re-finance perspective.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Underwriting of new car loans business
2. Incorporate industry best practices with respect to processing turn-around, risk metrics and policy
3. To provide an inside perspective on under-writing as managed by the leading financiers in the industry
4. Drive ownership of internal processes compliance with underwriting policies
5. Support Business, Risk Operations in meeting the long term goals of the respective businesses




"1.Chartered Accountant / MBA with atleast 3 years of experience in financial services under-writing
2.Atleast 3 years under-writing experience in used car loans with a reputed bank/NBFC


Skills
1. High process orientation
2. Good analytical skills
3. Positive attitude.
4. Good communication skills, with proficiency in English.
5. Ability to interact and build common ground with various stake-holders in the business"

Meeting exceeding business goals/targets in different products ie. Loans Insurance bundled/Non-Bundled through Lead fulfilment Field Activity on existing Data Base Manage, control own all channels businesses.

Excellent Team Handling and problem resolving ability.
Good hands on experience and knowhow for working on Data Management and MS Office.
A good team leader to handle the team and achieve the set target.
Exceptionally high motivational levels and needs to be a self-starter.

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Description:
Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.
