Job Description

Work Mode : Hybrid/Any of the office location
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon.

Job Summary Consultant-Oracle with HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), and HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) experience, responsible for delivering functional solutions and support across Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and related workforce scheduling processes.
Candidate must have relevant experience of 5 to 9 Years.

Qualifications and Skills
Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Hands-on functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional).
Practical experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), including writing, testing, and troubleshooting formulas.- Functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) or similar workforce scheduling tools.
Familiarity with end-to-end HCM processes, including core HR, absence, and payroll interactions with Time and Labor.
Ability to document requirements, configurations, and test scenarios clearly and concisely.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business requirements into Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations.

Key Responsibilities
Work as a functional Consultant-Oracle for HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), ensuring accurate time capture, approvals, and integrations with payroll and absence management.
Configure, validate, and optimize HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional) to support complex business rules, calculations, and eligibility criteria across HCM modules.
Implement and support HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) to manage workforce scheduling, shift planning, and resource allocation.- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map them to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud capabilities, and design functional solutions for Time and Labor and workforce scheduling.
Perform end-to-end functional testing for OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS configurations, including regression testing for new releases and patches.
Support production incidents and service requests related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor, Fast Formula, and workforce scheduling, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, and user guides for Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud modules in scope.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions for HR, payroll, and operations teams on OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS functionalities.
Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, and extensions related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and scheduling solutions.
Ensure adherence to best practices, governance, and compliance requirements in all Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations and deployments.

Other Capabilities
Strong understanding of Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor processes, including time entry, approval workflows, and time valuation rules.
Ability to interpret and design complex Fast Formulas to support business-specific rules and calculations.
Experience working with workforce scheduling concepts such as shifts, rosters, rotation patterns, and resource optimization in Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler).- Good stakeholder management and communication skills to work with HR, payroll, operations, and IT teams.
Capability to work in a consulting environment, managing multiple assignments and priorities with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail in configuration and testing activities.

As an ABAP - Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Business Application Consulting team, specializing in SAP Technology. Within our Advisory practice, you will help clients optimize operational efficiency by analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This position offers the opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, while using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing SAP technology installations, configurations, and administration tasks
- Developing and maintaining SAP products and technologies to optimize operational efficiency
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for software development and customization
- Collaborating with teams to drive business transformation and process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori for enhanced data visualization and insights generation
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Applying strategic technology planning to align SAP solutions with client objectives
- Embracing change and fostering innovation within SAP technology projects
- Mentoring junior team members to enhance their technical skills and professional growth

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
Customer Support ExecutiveJob Responsibilities
Handle customer queries through calls, chats, and emails.
Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate and timely resolutions.
Manage order-related issues such as delivery delays, refunds, cancellations, replacements, and other service requests.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through professional and courteous communication.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, call logs, and case updates.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
Follow defined quality, productivity, and customer service standards.
Maintain professionalism and confidentiality while handling customer information.
Eligibility Criteria
Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi, both spoken and written.
Education: Undergraduate / Graduate from any stream.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Candidates must have a laptop/desktop with minimum 8 GB RAM and Windows 10 or above.
Stable Wi-Fi/internet connection is mandatory.
Comfortable working in 24/7 rotational shifts.
Comfortable with 6 days working and 1 rotational week off.
Comfortable using a personal phone for work-related calls through a system that masks the personal number.
Must be comfortable appearing on camera during interview, training, and working hours.
Training will be provided after selection, with certification required upon successful completion of training.
Working Hours
9 working hours per day
8 productive hours + 1-hour break
6 days working
1 rotational week off
24/7 rotational shifts
Salary
Apprentice: 16,700 per month
Freshers / Experienced: 18,800 CTC per month
Monthly salary: Approximately 13,558
Quarterly payout/bonus component: Approximately 17,134, as applicable
Salary Components / Deductions
PF: 1,717
ESIC: 500
Bonus: 1,192
Salary and payout components are subject to applicable company policies and statutory deductions.Training
On-the-job training will be provided.
Candidates are required to successfully complete the training and certification process.
Interview Process
HR Evaluation
Operations Evaluation L1
Operations Evaluation L2
Aptitude / Ambition Test
Final Client Evaluation
Important NoteNo fee is charged for the interview or joining process.

Role Title
EY- Assurance Senior Associate


The Opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.

Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success

Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Maintain day-to-day accounting records, including sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, and payments.
Prepare and maintain invoices, purchase bills, vouchers, debit notes, and credit notes.
Maintain Tally or other accounting software and ensure accurate ledger posting.
Perform bank reconciliation and monitor customer outstanding balances and vendor payments.
Maintain accounts receivable and payable records and follow up on pending payments from customers.
Manage inventory and stock accounting for solar panels, inverters, batteries, cables, electrical equipment, and other materials.
Maintain project-wise accounting records for solar installations and EPC projects.
Track employee advances, reimbursements, expenses, and salary-related accounting entries.
Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, profit and loss statements, and cash-flow summaries.
Maintain proper documentation of purchase orders, delivery challans, e-way bills, and other statutory documents, wherever applicable.
Coordinate with the management, vendors, customers, and Chartered Accountant for accounting, taxation, and audit requirements.
Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely completion of all accounting activities.


Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com) or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
24 years of practical experience in accounting, preferably in solar, electrical, trading, EPC, or manufacturing businesses.
Good working knowledge of Tally Prime, MS Excel, and accounting software.
Strong understanding of GST, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, purchase and sales reconciliation, and GST input tax credit.
Experience in bank reconciliation, ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, and vendor/customer account reconciliation.
Knowledge of inventory accounting, stock registers, purchase orders, invoices, delivery challans, and e-way bills.
Ability to maintain project-wise expenses, customer outstanding reports, cash-flow records, and monthly financial statements.
Familiarity with TDS, income tax documentation, and coordination with Chartered Accountants for statutory compliance.
Good numerical accuracy, attention to detail, honesty, and a responsible approach to financial records.
Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with management, vendors, customers, and other team members.
Candidates based in Prayagraj or willing to work in Prayagraj will be preferred.
Candidates with experience in a solar EPC company or electrical goods trading business will receive preference.

Perks and benefits

Salary as per candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
Opportunity to work with a growing solar energy and EPC business.
Professional learning and development opportunities in accounting, GST, taxation, and solar industry operations.
Supportive working environment with direct coordination with management.
Opportunity for long-term career growth based on performance.
Timely salary payments.
Paid leaves and holidays as per company policy.
Performance-based salary increments.
AboutCompany:
VHS Solar Enterprises (Veer Hanuman Shakti Solar Enterprises) is a solar energy and electrical solutions business based in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. We also undertake solar installation and project execution, providing solutions to meet customers' energy requirements.At VHS Solar Enterprises, we focus on quality products, reliable service, efficient project execution, and long-term customer relationships. We aim to contribute to the adoption of solar energy by delivering practical and dependable solar power solutions.We offer employees an opportunity to work in the growing renewable energy sector, gain practical experience in business operations, and develop their professional skills in a dynamic working environment.

Description:
Job Title
EY - GDS GRC Technology Oracle GRC- Staff
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too.
Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The Opportunity
We're looking for people with expertise in Oracle GRC Staff Consultant to join our EY-GDS GRC Technology Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
Your Key Responsibilities
Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholders.
Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems.
Skills and attributes for success
Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.
Ideally, you'll also
Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 1 to 3 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.
Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions.
Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
Some stakeholder management experience.
Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you
At EY, we will develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences.

Location - Noida, UP, IN, 201301

Key Responsibilities
Identify, research, and prospect potential sponsors, exhibitors, delegates, and partners through calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and industry databases.
Sell conference sponsorships, exhibition space, delegate passes, branding, and other commercial event opportunities.
Understand each clients marketing, branding, lead-generation, and business-development objectives; recommend suitable event participation packages.
Prepare professional sales proposals, sponsorship decks, rate cards, quotations, and customized participation plans.
Conduct outbound sales calls, virtual meetings, client presentations, and follow-ups to move leads through the sales pipeline.
Negotiate commercial terms, close deals, issue invoices, and coordinate with finance and event-operations teams for onboarding.
Maintain accurate lead records, sales forecasts, call reports, and client communication in the CRM or sales tracker.
Achieve individual monthly, quarterly, and event-wise revenue and exhibitor/sponsor acquisition targets.
Build long-term relationships with existing clients to secure repeat participation, renewals, and referrals.
Coordinate with marketing, content, and event-production teams to ensure sponsor deliverables, branding, and client requirements are fulfilled.
Support on-site event execution, client servicing, exhibitor coordination, and post-event feedback or renewal discussions.
Monitor competitor events, industry trends, and market opportunities to identify new prospect segments and sales angles.

Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, Events, Media, Hospitality, or a related field.
14 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in conferences, exhibitions, sponsorship, media, advertising, hospitality, or event sales.
Strong cold-calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate confidently with senior corporate stakeholders.
Target-driven mindset with strong follow-up discipline and ability to manage a high-volume pipeline.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and CRM tools.
Ability to research industries such as AI, fintech, healthcare, agriculture, ESG, manufacturing, and technology.
Willingness to work in a fast-paced event environment and support event days when required.

Preferred Skills
Prior experience selling sponsorships, exhibition booths, delegate registrations, or awards participation.
Familiarity with international event markets and cross-border client communication.
Knowledge of proposal design, sales forecasting, and account management.
Strong professional network in corporate marketing, communications, business development, or industry associations.
Key Performance Indicators
Revenue generated from sponsorships, exhibitions, delegates, and partnerships.
Number of qualified leads, meetings scheduled, proposals sent, and deals closed.
Conversion rate from lead to confirmed participation.
Client retention, repeat bookings, and referral generation.
Accuracy and timeliness of CRM updates, forecasts, and sales reports.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Join our Team
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.
What you will do:

- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.
- Support project execution including new node acceptance tests and technology rollouts.
- Drive automation and AI initiatives for predictive maintenance, proactive fault detection, and operational efficiency.
- Monitor and review TT, CR, and AT performance, ensuring adherence to MSTOP guidelines.
- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.
The skills you bring:

- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Job Summary
We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Developer with 2-6 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITOM modules, particularly Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB.

Support CMDB data quality, accuracy and governance initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in knowledge-sharing activities.
Follow ServiceNow development and implementation best practices.
Required Skills
26 years of experience in ServiceNow development/ITOM.
Hands-on experience with one or more ITOM modules, preferably:
Discovery
Service Mapping
Event Management
CMDB
Good understanding of MID Server architecture and configuration.
Knowledge of Discovery Patterns, Probes, Sensors and Discovery Schedules.
Understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) and CI identification.
Knowledge of CI classes, relationships and CMDB data model.

Description:
EY- Assurance Consultant

Contractual Role - 1.5-3 months

Open job locations - Pune/Noida/Kolkata

Eligibility - CA Qualified, CA Inter(With Articleship), ACCA Part-Qualified (9/13 papers completed), ACCA Qualified (13/13 papers completed), CPA Part-Qualified (2/4 papers completed), or CPA Qualified (4/4 papers completed).

B.com is mandatory

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the role requires the incumbent to proactively develop relationships with the global EY teams serving these engagements and supervise the delivery of GDS engagement management support activities.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with experience in carrying out routine substantive and controls-based assurance testing for the engagement teams during the financial year end for the Europe or US region.

Your key responsibilities
Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific review procedures as defined by the engagement teams
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential review issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the immediate supervisor
Collaborate with seniors and engagement teams to set goals and responsibilities
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the team members
Maintain a strong client focus, be responsive to team requests, and develop/maintain productive working relationships with team contacts
Where appropriate, challenge procedures used in the past by team members and attempt to enhance review techniques
Compare efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients and suggest ideas for improvement.
Contribute ideas/opinions to the assurance teams and listen/respond to other team members' views
Use technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery
Promote EYs ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality, especially when dealing with outsiders

Skills and attributes for success
Confident and outgoing individual with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure that work is of a consistently high standard
Ability to multi-task, pay attention to detail, prioritize projects and follow up on routine tasks diligently
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,
Ability to communicate with leaders and peers with ease
Plan ahead and anticipate potential issues before they arise
Good written and oral communication skills
Ability to work effectively in a team

To qualify for the role, you must have
Candidates with CA Completed / CA Inter with Articleship completed
6 months to 1 year of relevant work experience preferred.

Ideally, youll also have
Interest in business and commerciality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

Job Description: Business Development Manager / Enterprise Sales Manager Cloud & IT Sales and ServiceNow Sales
Company: InputZero Technologies
Experience: 3–6 Years
Job Locations: Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida
Employment Type: Full-Time
Domain: B2B Sales | Enterprise Sales | Cloud Solutions | SaaS | ServiceNow
About InputZero Technologies
InputZero Technologies is focused on delivering technology solutions and services that help businesses improve operational efficiency and accelerate digital transformation. We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Manager / Regional Enterprise Manager with experience in B2B technology sales, cloud solutions, SaaS, and ServiceNow to drive business growth and build strong enterprise relationships.
Role Overview
The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring enterprise clients, managing key accounts, and driving revenue growth across the assigned region. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of IT services, cloud sales, SaaS solutions, and enterprise business development, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and close strategic deals.
Key Responsibilities
Identify, develop, and acquire new B2B customers across enterprise and mid-market segments.
Drive business development and revenue growth for IT services, cloud solutions, SaaS products, and ServiceNow offerings.
Build and maintain relationships with CXOs, IT Directors, CIOs, CTOs, procurement teams, and other key decision-makers.
Develop regional sales strategies, account plans, and go-to-market initiatives to achieve business targets.
Generate leads through networking, cold calling, LinkedIn, referrals, industry events, and other prospecting channels.
Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, client meetings, requirement gathering, solution presentations, proposal preparation, negotiations, and deal closure.
Identify opportunities for ServiceNow implementation, consulting, licensing, and related enterprise technology services, where applicable.
Promote cloud solutions, SaaS offerings, and IT services based on client business requirements.
Prepare sales forecasts, maintain a healthy sales pipeline, and provide regular updates on opportunities and revenue projections.
Collaborate with presales, technical, delivery, and marketing teams to develop client-specific proposals and solutions.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
Required Skills and Qualifications
3–6 years of experience in B2B sales, enterprise sales, business development, or regional sales management.
Proven experience selling IT services, cloud solutions, SaaS products, or enterprise technology solutions.
Exposure to ServiceNow sales, consulting, implementation, or related enterprise solutions is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, lead generation, pipeline management, and deal closure.
Experience engaging with enterprise clients and senior-level decision-makers.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
Ability to achieve revenue targets and independently manage sales opportunities.
Familiarity with CRM tools, sales reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development activities as required.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience selling to enterprise and mid-market customers in the B2B technology ecosystem.
Existing network of enterprise clients and decision-makers.
Experience in regional business development, strategic account management, or territory sales.
Ability to identify new markets, develop strategic partnerships, and build a sustainable sales pipeline.
A target-oriented mindset with a strong focus on revenue generation and customer acquisition.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
New enterprise client acquisition.
Revenue generation and achievement of sales targets.
Qualified lead generation and pipeline development.
Conversion rates and successful deal closures.
Growth of strategic accounts and customer relationships.
Sales forecast accuracy and pipeline management.
Job Locations
Mumbai
Bangalore
Noida
Interested candidates with relevant experience in B2B enterprise sales, cloud sales, SaaS, IT services, or ServiceNow business development are encouraged to apply.

Job Title: SAP Basis-Senior

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS CONSULTING SAP BASIS SENIOR

At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity
As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
System /System copy
ABAP + Java-dual stack
Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
Kernel Upgrade
Client copies and export-import
TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
OSS Note application
Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.
Skills and attributes for success
Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.

Oracle Cloud Technical Job description:
As a Senior Manager, you'll lead a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP PLM Manager, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP supply chain and operations applications, analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and offering training and support for seamless integration and utilization. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will enable clients to optimize their supply chain processes, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will also address conflicts or issues, engaging in conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation of SAP supply chain and operations applications to optimize client processes
- Analyzing client needs and developing tailored software solutions to enhance operational efficiency
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
- Managing project planning, budgeting, and execution to achieve strategic objectives
- Guiding teams in the development and execution of supply chain transformation initiatives
- Utilizing data-driven insights to improve supply chain performance and decision-making
- Overseeing the deployment of procurement strategies and inventory management systems
- Collaborating with stakeholders to address operational challenges and drive process improvements
- Mentoring team members to develop skills and encourage professional growth
- Confirming data integrity and compliance within supply chain management frameworks

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi

We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Summary:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Salesforce QA to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of our Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation by performing thorough testing and validation of various Salesforce features and integrations. This role involves working closely with developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and test accordingly.
Key Responsibilities:
Test Planning and Design:
Collaborate with business analysts and developers to understand functional requirements and create detailed test plans and test cases.
Design and develop test scripts for functional, system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
Test Execution:
Execute test cases and document results for Salesforce applications, integrations and mobile testing 
Identify, document, and track defects and issues using appropriate tools and ensure their resolution.
Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionalities are unaffected by new changes.
Collaboration and Communication:
Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
Provide regular status updates and test results to stakeholders.
Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
Continuous Improvement:
Stay up to date with the latest Salesforce features and updates.
Recommend and implement improvements to the testing process and tools.
Experience:
48 years of overall IT experience with at least 3+ years in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ & Billing) implementation projects.
Proven experience in Mobile testing(both iOS and Android operating systems).
Understanding of Salesforce platform, including Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Billing, Revenue Cloud, and custom applications.
Hands-on experience in end-to-end Lead-to-Cash process covering quoting, pricing, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA, Confluence, ADO etc.
Skills:
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Experience working with Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud features and functionalities.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce Revenue Cloud QA - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in delivering client-focused solutions within our Salesforce practice. You will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and develop deliverables that meet client needs. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate ambiguity and use critical thinking to build meaningful client relationships and guide junior team members. You will be responsible for maintaining professional standards and using a broad range of methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on relationship building and managing others, while developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions within the Commercial & Service Excellence network. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.


Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Regular
Project Engineering
Science Engineering

Preferred candidate profile
AboutCompany: We are the second largest franchisee in the world (outside US) of carbonated soft drinks (CSDs) and non-carbonated beverages (NCBs) sold under trademarks owned by PepsiCo and a key player in the beverage industry. We produce and distribute a wide range of CSDs, as well as a large selection of NCBs, including packaged drinking water. PepsiCo CSD brands sold by us include Pepsi, Diet Pepsi, Seven-Up, Mirinda Orange, Mirinda Lemon, Mountain Dew, Seven-Up Nimbooz Masala Soda, Evervess Soda, Dukes Soda and Sting. PepsiCo NCB brands sold by us include Tropicana (100%, Essentials & Delight), Tropicana Slice, Tropicana Frutz, Seven-Up Nimbooz, Gatorade and Quaker Oat Milk as well as packaged drinking water under the brand Aquafina. In addition, we have also been granted the franchise for Ole brand of PepsiCo products in Sri Lanka. We have been associated with PepsiCo since the 1990s and have over two and half decades consolidated our business association with PepsiCo, increasing the number of PepsiCo licensed territories and sub-territories covered by us, producing and distributing a wider range of PepsiCo beverages, introducing various SKUs in our portfolio, and expanding our distribution network. We have been granted franchisees for various PepsiCo products spread across 27 States and 7 Union Territories (except Jammu & Kashmir and Andhra Pradesh) in India. Our share of PepsiCo beverages volume sales increased from ~ 26% in Fiscal 2011 to 80%+ now. Although, India is our largest market, we have also been granted the franchise for various PepsiCo products for the territories of Nepal, Sri Lanka, Morocco, Zambia and Zimbabwe. VBL has 30 manufacturing plants in India (Gr. Noida 1, Gr. Noida 2, Kosi, Sathariya 1, Sathariya 2, Bazpur, Jainpur & Hardoi in Uttar Pradesh, Bhiwadi & Jodhpur in Rajasthan, Nuh & Panipat in Haryana, Phillaur and Pathankot in Punjab, Kolkata in West Bengal, Guwahati Unit 1 & 2 in Assam, Goa, Mandideep in Madhya Pradesh, Bargarh & Cuttack in Odisha, Jamshedpur in Jharkhand, Bharuch in Gujarat, Mahul, Roha and Paithan in Maharashtra, Nelamangala in Karnataka, Palakkad in Kerala, Sri City in Andhra Pradesh, Sangareddy in Telangana and Mamandur in Tamil Nadu) and 6 manufacturing plants in international geographies (two in Nepal and one each in Sri Lanka, Morocco, Zambia and Zimbabwe). In addition, we have set up backward integration facilities for production of preforms, crowns, corrugated boxes, plastic crates and shrink-wrap films in certain of our production facilities to ensure operational efficiencies and quality standards. We are part of the RJ Corp group, a diversified business conglomerate with interests in beverages, quick-service restaurants, dairy and healthcare. Our Promoter and Chairman Mr. Ravi Kant Jaipuria has an established reputation as an entrepreneur and business leader and is the only Indian to receive PepsiCos International Bottler of the Year award, which was awarded in 1997.
